uz:
Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon. Kecha va kunduz (roman) 
 
 
2
Muhabbatning saroyi keng ekan, yo‘lni yo‘qotdim-ku,  
Asrlik tosh yanglig‘ bu xatarlik yo‘lda qotdim-ku. 
 
Karashma dengizin ko‘rdim, na nozlik to‘lqini bordir,  
Halokat bo‘lgusin bilmay qulochni katta otdim-ku. 
 
Ajab dunyo ekan bu ishq dunyosi, ayo do‘stlar,  
Bu dunyo deb u dunyoni bahosiz pulga sotdim-ku. 
 
Uning gulzorida bulbul o‘qib qon ayladi bag‘rim.  
Ko‘zimdan yoshni jo‘ aylab alamlar ichra botdim-ku. 
 
Qalandardek yurib dunyoni kezdim, topmayin yorni  
Yana kulbamga qayg‘ular, alamlar birla qaytdim-ku. 
 
Muhabbat osmonida go‘zal Cho‘lpon edim, do‘stlar,  
Quyoshning nuriga toqat qilolmay yerga botdim-ku.

uz: Har kim o‘z oldida bir narsa topib shunga ko‘z tikkan va u narsada Zebi — o‘z otasini, Qurvonbibi — o‘z erini, Salti — qovog‘idan doim qor yog‘ib turgan sovuq bir so‘fini ko‘rardi.
en: Each of them saw a singular impediment before their eyes: Zebi—her father, Qurvonbibi—her husband, and Saltanat from beneath her eyelids saw the old man as cold as snow.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu bulutli havoni ochmoq faqat onaning vazifasi edi:

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “When your father comes from his morning prayers,” she said looking at Saltanat, “let me try to reason with him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Otasi bomdoddan kirsin, — dedi u Saltiga qarab, — men o‘zim yotig‘i bilan aytib ko‘ray, yo‘q demas, — so‘ngra Zebiga yuzlandi: — Sen, qizim, uyga joy qil, o‘rtog‘ingni o‘tqiz, dasturxon sol.
en: He won’t refuse me.” Then she looked at Zebi: “You, dear, prepare the house, see your friend in, and set the table.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkala qiz ham og‘iz ochmay jim qolishdi. Chunki Razzoq so‘fining mijozini ularning ikkalasi ham yaxshi bilardi.
en: I’ll speak with your father over tea and tell him what you told me.” The girls remained silent because both knew Razzoq-sufi’s character well.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘figa eng ma’qul bir masalani bo‘lsa ham uqtirib roziligini olmoq uchun yo o‘zining piri, yoki katta bir davlatga ega bo‘lish kerak edi.
en: To get him to accept even the most agreeable of things one had either to be his master or be wealthy.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U odam o‘z tenglaridan hech birining hech qachon hech bir gapini tinglagan emasdi.
en: The man had never listened to a single word of advice from his equals.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayollardan maslahat, ayniqsa, o‘z xotinidan bir taklif eshitmoq uchun Razzoq so‘fining qayta boshdan bunyodga kelishi kerak bo‘lardi...
en: For Razzoq to accept advice from women, or, to be precise, one little suggestion from his wife, he would have had to be remade from head to toe.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuning uchun Zebi ko‘zlari andisha bilan kengayib ochilgani holda indamasdan joylarni yig‘a boshladi.
en: For that reason, Zebi’s eyes grew wide with worry as she stood silently in the house.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U o‘rinlarni yig‘ishtirib, nonushta joylarini tayyorlab bo‘lgandan so‘ng o‘choq boshida choynaklarga choy tashlarkan:
en: She began to cry. After she prepared the table for breakfast, she stuffed tea leaves into the pot by the hearth.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Otamdan darak yo‘q-ku? — deb so‘radi onasidan.
en: “No word of father?” she asked her mother.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qurvonbibi bir ko‘cha eshigiga, bir yonboshdagi daraxtlar orasidan ko‘tarilib kelayotgan quyoshga, bir o‘choqboshidagi qiziga qaragandan keyin:
en: Qurvonbibi, after looking first at the door to the street, at the sun rising up between the trees next to the door, and then at her daughter by the hearth, answered.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bilmadim, avrod cho‘zilibroq ketdimikin?
en: “I don’t know. Could prayers have gone late?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sen choyni jindek qo‘yib turib, chala qoldirgan yerlaringni supiratur, kelib qolar, — dedi.
en: Put the tea down quickly, finish sweeping the spots you missed, and come here.”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi shu topda yana qaytib qo‘liga supurgi olishni istamasada, o‘rtog‘ining «bu qiz enasining gapiga kirmas ekan», degan o‘yga borishini o‘ylab, indamasdan supurgini qo‘liga oldi va bir qo‘lini bir tizzasiga qo‘yib, sahn betini supura boshladi.
en: Though she had no desire to take up the broom again, she dreaded that her friend might think that she wasn’t an obedient daughter. She silently took the broom in one hand, put her other hand on her knee, and started to sweep the ground.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining choy damlab kelishini kutib, uyda — dasturxon boshida o‘tirgan Salti ikkala qanoti ochiq turgan eshik orqali bu holni ko‘rganidan keyin o‘rnidan turib, o‘rtog‘ining yoniga chiqdi.
en: Having waited for Zebi to start the tea, Saltanat got up from her place behind the table in the house and went out to check on her friend.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi uni uzr aytib qarshi oldi:
en: Zebi ran up to meet her and apologized.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘rtoqjon, — dedi, — otam avrodda o‘tirib qoldi, shekilli, shunaqa odati bor.
en: “Friend,” she said, “Father is still at prayers. That’s his way.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endiyoq kirib kelsa kerak.
en: He should come any minute.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xafa bo‘lmang-a? Bu so‘nggi kalta jumlaning aytilishidagi samimiyat bir-biri bilan yaqin o‘rtoq tutishgan yosh qizlardagina bo‘ladi.
en: Don’t be upset.” The sincerity with which Zebi uttered her request could only be expressed between young girls in a close friendship.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Xafa bo‘lmang-a?» deb turgan vaqtida Zebining yuzini ko‘rish kerak edi, bir qo‘lida supurgi, bir qo‘li tizzasida, supurgi ham yerdan uzib olingan emas, faqat bosh yuqori ko‘tarilganu butun vujud Saltining ixtiyorida!
en: One had to see Zebi’s face as she said that “don’t be upset” with the broom in one hand and the other hand on her knee, never lifting the broom from the ground and only holding her head up to know that her whole being was submitted to Saltanat’s will.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘ngil, orzu, sevgi, sevinch... bular hammasi Saltiga tomon uchadi, unga tomon otiladi, uni o‘rab, uni aylantirib, uni quchadi!
en: Her soul, her aspirations , her love, her joy. All of these flew towards Saltanat; they were shot at her, they wrapped her up, moved her, embraced her!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining yuzlaridagi — oyday tiniq va quyoshday yorug‘ bu holat moddiy haqiqatlar qadar ochiq ko‘rinardi.
en: Zebi’s face, clear as the moon and bright as the sun, openly revealed the truth of her being.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘rtog‘ining bu samimiyatini Salti ham ko‘z bilan ko‘ribgina emas, ko‘ngil bilan sezib anglagan edi.
en: Saltanat didn’t see her friend’s sincerity with her eyes, but understood it through her heart.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuning uchun u Zebining so‘ziga javob ham berib o‘tirmasdan , birdaniga uning qo‘lidagi supurgiga yopishdi.
en: She understood so well that she didn’t bother to answer Zebi, but suddenly grabbed the broom in her friend’s hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘z ko‘nglida, supurgini olib, bir oz supurishib bersa, haligi samimiyatga yarasha javob bergan bo‘lardi.
en: She knew that if she could take the broom and sweep some for her friend, then that would be a sufficient response to Zebi’s sincerity.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi supurgini qo‘ldan oldirdi, lekin o‘rtog‘i supura boshlagandan so‘ng:
en: Zebi released the broom, but quickly said, “Voy, what are you doing!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Voy, bu nimasi! Qo‘ying, o‘zim supuraman!
en: Put it down, I’ll do it myself!” and seized the broom.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb yana supurgiga yopishdi. Salti bermadi, bu olmoq istadi; Salti qochdi, bu quvladi; shunday qilib, sahnni supurish o‘rniga bu ikki o‘rtoq butun hovlini boshlariga ko‘tarib, shovqinlar va qiyqirishlar bilan dunyoni buzib, bir-birlarini quvlashib ketdilar...
en: Saltanat didn’t give it back; Saltanat ran, she chased; lost in themselves, instead of sweeping the courtyard the two friends turned Zebi’s home on its head, their noise and shouting disturbing their whole world as they chased one another.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘z uyining qabristonlar qadar jimjit, xonaqohlar qadar unsiz, o‘z ko‘ngli qadar tund va xo‘mraygan bo‘lishini istagan Razzoq so‘fi xuddi shu ola-to‘polon ustiga kirib keldi! Eshikdan kirar-kirmas ovozining boricha:
en: Razzoq-sufi, who preferred the quiet of a graveyard, the silence of a mosque, whose very soul was coarse and frowning, returned to this chaos!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bu nima qiyomat!!! — deb shovqin solishi ikkala yosh qizni, chaqmoq tekkan daraxtday, turgan joylarida qotirib qo‘ydi.
en: A voice emerged from the doorway: “What is this hell?!” he bellowed like lightning striking a tree, petrifying the two young girls in their places.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘qsa, so‘fi erining dindor xotini bo‘lgan Qurvonbibi ham «bas endi!» deb ozmuncha qichqirmagan edi...
en: Qurvonbibi , ever faithful to her husband, had already shouted, “enough already!” a few times herself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Agar bu sovuq so‘fi kirib kelgan bo‘lmasa, ikki yosh qizning qish bo‘yi to‘plangan ko‘ngil g‘ashliklari bir oz sho‘xlik bilan ancha yozilgan bo‘lardi.
en: If the cold old man hadn’t returned, the two young girls’ pent up tension from the long winter would have expanded with the warmth of spring and produced even more mischief.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zotan, ularning o‘zlarini unutar darajada bir-
en: In fact, the girls had completely forgotten themselves.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: birlari bilan bu xilda o‘ynashuvlari o‘sha g‘am-g‘ashlar pur-jinasining bo‘shalishi, siqintilar oqimining to‘g‘onini buzib, oldinga tomon yo‘l solish emasmidi?
en: How could their games with one another not release the coiled spring of their agitation, not break the dam holding back the flood?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bunday telbalarcha ko‘pirib-toshuvlarni to‘xtatmoq uchun ham, albatta, telbalarcha hayqirishlar, chaqmoq qadar quvvatli zarblar lozim bo‘lardi.
en: To stop such madness from overflowing, of course, equally mad screams and thunderously powerful force were needed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Razzoq so‘fida unday quvvat ortig‘i bilan bor.
en: ... Razzoq-sufi had such power in excess.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu odam, jadidnamo bir hamshahrining deganidek, «ko‘rgazmaga qo‘yilaturgan antiqa maxluqlardan edi». Aytishlaricha, uni ona qornidan sihat-salomat tushirtirgan va birinchi daf’a yo‘rgaklagan kampir hazilkashligi va sho‘xligi bilan xotin-xalaj o‘rtasida dong chiqargan Hamro enaymish.
en: This man, as a jadid denizen of the city said of him, “was one of those ancient monsters put out for display.” The old woman that shot him from her womb perfectly healthy and swaddled him for the first time was named Hamroh.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: She had a reputation for jokes and mischief.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bolani yo‘rgaklaganidan keyin hali u qadar odam kepatasiga kirmagan yuzlariga tikilgan va mana bu so‘zlar bilan erkalatganmish: — Aylanay, mehmon, kimdan xafa bo‘lib tushdingiz?
en: After swaddling him, she looked at the face of her child, which hadn’t yet been disfigured by manhood, and coddled him with these words: “My dear guest, who has upset you?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kim ozor berdi sizga?

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayting!
en: Tell me!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qovog‘ingizni ochsangiz-chi!
en: Unfurrow your brow!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yorug‘ dunyoga keldingiz!
en: You have come into the bright world!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shukur qiling!
en: Give thanks!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Se-vining!
en: Be happy!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mundoq bir kuling!
en: Laugh a little!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kulimsirang!
en: Smile!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Iljaying!.. O‘shanda kulmagan Razzoq so‘fi undan keyin ham kulmay o‘tdi.
en: Grin!” Razzoq-sufi, who hadn’t laughed then, still has not laughed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kulish bilan yig‘lash orasida katta farq bor.
en: There is a big difference between laughing and crying.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kulish bilan kulmasdan tekkina jiddiyat saqlab turish orasida ham anchagina masofa bor.
en: There is again a great distance between laughing and maintaining quiet gravity.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun Razzoq so‘fining kulishlarini kulish, deb bo‘lmaydi.
en: It cannot be said that Razzoq-sufi ever laughed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kulmasdan chidab bo‘lmaydigan maqomlarda u ham kuladi, lekin u kulish — kasal odamning kulishiday og‘ir, bir xil sovuq hazillarday malol keltiruvchi, yolg‘on xushomadlarday ko‘ngilga uruvchi bo‘lardi. Bir kun Zebining juda jiddiy bir chehra bilan:
en: He “laughed” in situations where laughter couldn’t be avoided, but his laugh was pained like that of a sick person; it was unpleasant like a cold joke, injurious like false well wishes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Otam kulmas ekan-da! — deganini eshitib, Qurvonbibi koyib bergan edi.
en: One day Zebi said with a serious face: “Father has never laughed.” As soon as she heard her daughter’s words, Qurvonbibi scolded her.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu haqiqatni aytgani uchun qizidan alayna-oshkor koyingan Qurvonbibi, bu haqiqatni o‘zi o‘z ko‘nglida necha marta takrorlagan bo‘lsaykin?..
en: She openly scolded her daughter for speaking the truth, but how many times had Qurvonbibi repeated the same truth to herself in secret?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Til bilan birovning aybini aytish oson, o‘z tili bilan o‘z aybini aytadiganlar juda kam, Qurvonbibi har qancha so‘zga epchil xotin bo‘lsa ham, uni bu kamlar orasiga qo‘shib bo‘lmaydi.
en: It is easy to speak of someone else’s faults with a sharp tongue, but those who can speak of their own faults with their own tongue are rare, and though Qurvonbibi had a very sharp tongue, she couldn’t count herself among that rare class.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qurvonbibi so‘zga qancha epchil bo‘lsa, Razzoq so‘fi shu qadar kamgap, indamas, damini ichiga solgan, zikna odam edi.
en: As sharp as her tongue was, Razzoq-sufi was to the same extent a reticent, tight-lipped, boring man who kept to himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tashqari olamda, ya’ni o‘z hovlisidan tashqarida uning doimiy va birdan-bir vazifasi: o‘zidan ulug‘ va kuchlilar gapirsa — «hovva-hovva», demak, o‘zidan past va kuchsizlar gapirsa — «yo‘q, yo‘q», degan ma’nida bosh chayqash bo‘lardi.
en: In the outside world, that is the world outside his home, his sole, ever-present task was to answer “yes, yes” to those who were more powerful than he and to shake his head “no, no” to those less powerful.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uyida vaqtida uning og‘zidan odam bolalari o‘rtasida yuraturgan tuzuk, ma’nilik va «gap» desa bo‘ladigan bir so‘z chiqmas edi.
en: While he was at home, not one word that could be called meaningful , healthy speech which an adult uses around children ever left his lips.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Umuman, so‘fining bu bobda o‘ziga ko‘ra asoli bir maslagi bor: u o‘zi maqtanib aytganiday, xotin-xalaj oldida og‘iz ochib til qaldiratishni ravo ko‘rmaydi.
en: He didn’t think it necessary to move his tongue in the presence of womenfolk, and his muteness before his family members was a point of pride.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Bu til, — deydi so‘fi, — doim xudoning zikri bilan qaldiraydi.
en: “This tongue,” he told himself, “moves only in remembrance of God.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu og‘iz hamma vaqt xudoning zikriga ochiladi.
en: This mouth opens only for God.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Og‘iz bilan til — bandaning jismida eng aziz va tabarruk a’zolar.
en: The mouth and tongue are the dearest and most blessed parts of a believer ’s body.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Should they really be embarrassed by being used in front of such a low creature as a woman?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ularni xotin kishiday past maxluq oldida xor qilinadimi?
en: If they were meant to be used with women, then God on high would have granted dogs speech!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bo‘lmasa, haq taoloning bandalari it bilan ham gaplasha bersin!
en: No, only the most necessary phrases should be used with women.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘q, xotin kishiga juda zarur gap aytiladi, u toifa bilan zarurat yuzasidangina gaplashiladi.
en: Those creatures should only be spoken with concerning the most urgent matters and that’s all!”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Vassalom!» O‘zbekda axir har bir erkak o‘z xotinini — o‘z halol juftini qizi yo o‘g‘lining nomi bilan atab chaqiradi.
en: Every Uzbek man calls his wife—his lawful partner in life—by his daughter or his son’s name.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘z xotinining ismini aytib chaqirish yaramaydi.
en: It just won’t do to call his wife by name.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xo-tinining ismi Maryam, qizining ismi Xadicha bo‘lsa, mo‘min-musulmon: — sharmu-hayo yuzasidan bo‘lsamikan?
en: If his wife’s name was Maryam and his daughter’s Xadicha, a faithful Muslim wouldn’t bring shame on himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — xotinini «Xadicha» deb chaqiradi.
en: He would call his wife Xadicha.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aksar ona-bola baravar «labbay!» deydi; shunday-da, oilaning haqiqiy egasi bo‘lgan ota: «Kattangni aytaman, kattangni!» deydi.
en: Most mother-daughter pairs would both answer, “yes, sir!” and the true head of the family would specify: “I mean the elder, the elder!” But he would never say Maryam.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Our Razzoq-sufi, our faithful Muslim didn’t observe this tradition.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hatto shunda ham «Maryamni», demaydi...
en: He always called his lawful partner in life Fitna.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bizning so‘fi mo‘min-musulmonning bu urfiga ham amal qilmaydi, u o‘z halol jufti Qurvonbibini hamma vaqt «Fitna» deb chaqiradi: «Fitna, sallamni ber!», «Fitna, qiz o‘lguring qani?», Fitna, puldan uzat!» Qurvonbibi, so‘figa achchiq qilib bo‘lsami yo o‘zining yaratilish hamrida shu narsa bormi, har qalay fitnalikdan, ya’ni makr va firibdan xoli emas.
en: “Fitna, bring me my turban!” he would declare. “Fitna, where is your damn daughter?” “Fitna, give me some money!” Whether she caused havoc in her husband’s life on purpose or it was just her nature, Fitna wasn’t an inaccurate label for Qurvonbibi, who was no stranger to guile and perfidy.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Erining xotin-xalaj oldida gapirmaganiga uncha xafa bo‘lmasa ham, lekin o‘z halol xotini oldida gapirmaganiga kuyadi va shu kuyish orqasida firib yo‘li bilan so‘fini gapirtiradi; ba’zida tillarini burro qildirib sayratadi.
en: Even if she wasn’t all that upset by the fact that her husband didn’t speak a word in front of womenfolk, she suffered from his not speaking to her, and she knew how to use all manners of tricks to coax words from him and even excite his tongue into singing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Buning uchun so‘fining achchig‘ini keltiradigan emas, uning bir oz g‘ashini qo‘zg‘ataturgan bir gap aytib qo‘yadi.
en: With one word, she would not just upset her husband: she would enrage him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ana shunda xotin-xalaj oldida og‘iz ochib til qaldiratishni so‘fidan ko‘ring!
en: Just look at how Razzoq-sufi wags his tongue in front of the womenfolk! Oh my!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bay-bay-bay! — Eshon bobom sizdan dilgir emishlar, — deydi bir kun Qurvonbibi so‘figa.
en: “They say your elder master is quite upset with you,” Qurvonbibi said to Razzoq-sufi one day.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fining toshday qattiq va buyumdek harakatsiz yuzi birdaniga turlituman  o‘zgarishlar va harakatlarga javlongoh bo‘ladi: — Nima deding, Fitna?
en: Razzoq-sufi’s face, normally hard and motionless like a stone, suddenly came to life with various movements and changes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nega dilgir bo‘libdilar?
en: “What did you say, Fitna?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nazir qilgan kokilini kestirishga kelgan bir bolaga xushomad qilibsiz...
en: Why was he upset?” “You flirted with a boy who came to have his braid cut.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu bas!
en: …” That was it!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi, bizning so‘fi so‘zga usta bir xatibga aylanadi.
en: Razzoq-sufi, normally a master of brevity, turned into a preacher.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ishq ikki xil bo‘ladi, Fitna.
en: “Love is of two kinds, Fitna.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tushunmay gapirma! Ishqi ma’joziy, ishqi haqiqiy...
en: Don’t speak of what you don’t understand!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qurvonbibi bu so‘zlarga tushunmaganligidan erini sayratib qo‘yib, o‘zi darrov zerikadi.
en: There is miraculous love, true love.” Qurvonbibi, not understanding her husband, suddenly became bored.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun u: — Ha, shundaymi?
en: “Really, is that the case?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Men bilmabman.
en: I didn’t know.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Omiman-da, — deb tezroq qochish harakatiga tushadi.
en: I’m the ignoramus,” she said, trying to avoid a long diatribe.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xotini burilib ketganidan keyin so‘fi ham so‘zdan to‘xtaydi.
en: After his wife had turned around and left, Razzoq-sufi quieted down.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunday qilib, so‘fi joyi kelganda va g‘ashiga tegilganda, — go‘rda ham gapiradi.
en: Suffice it to say, when he became angry, he would talk himself into the grave.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ham gapirganda qanday!
en: And oh, how he would talk!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uyida vaqtida Razzoq so‘fi yo ariq bo‘yidagi ko‘katlarni yulib, yo eshik va darvozalarning bo‘shalib qolgan zanjirlarini mahkamlab, yoki hovlida o‘tin qirqib, yo bo‘lmasa — ikki qo‘li orqasida, dam ichkariga kirib, dam tashqariga chiqib, dam hovliga o‘tib, lablarini ari chaqqan odamday og‘iz ochmasdan, indamasdan yura beradi...
en: When Razzoq-sufi was at home, he was usually picking weeds by the creek, locking the door and gates, cutting firewood; or, if not, he would continuously walk inside with his hands behind his back, then outside, then into the courtyard, keeping his mouth sealed shut as if his lips had been stung by bees.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: In the summer, he normally slept in the afternoon; in the evenings, he lay awake, screaming “idiot!” to himself in a loud voice so that neither his family nor his neighbors could sleep.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yoz faslida, ko‘proq kunduzi uxlaydi, kechalari, tong otguncha, o‘zi yolg‘iz, baland ovoz bilan «Oblohu!» aytib, o‘z oilasini va qo‘ni-qo‘shnini uxlatmaydi.
en: On those days when his elder master wasn’t present he, according to neighbors, would sit in the cool prayer hall and sleep with great satisfaction.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Eshon bobo bo‘lmagan kunlari salqin xonaqoda juda maza qilib uxlaydi, deydilar.
en: Sometimes the other murids would throw him into the mosque’s pool.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ba’zida boshqa muridlar uni ko‘rpa-to‘shagi bilan hovuzga tashlar ekanlar. Uyda bo‘lsa, uni — xonaqo singari — salqin qildirib, undan keyin cho‘ziladi va peshindan keyin uyquga ketgan bo‘lsa, shomga borib zo‘rg‘a turadi: shunda ham Qurvonbibining qichqirishlari bilan...
en: When he was at home, he would cool the house, like he did his lodge, lie down, and if he had fallen asleep after the early afternoon prayer, he would just barely wake up in time for dinner, usually to the sound of Qurvonbibi’s screaming.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Namozgar, aksari, uyquga qurbon bo‘ladi, shu orqada o‘z xotinidan ko‘p ta’nalar ham eshitadi.
en: The late afternoon prayer usually fell victim to his naps, for which he heard all kinds of reproaches from his wife.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: But his tongue wasn’t up to it, and he wouldn’t say a word.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ammo bu xususda tili qisiq, indayolmaydi...
en: In the winter, he would fall asleep in the evenings.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qish faslida bo‘lsa, kechasi uxlaydi. «Bir siqim kun bor, uxlab o‘tkazsam, Qashqardan ham olis qish kechasini qanday o‘tkazaman?
en: “If I spend the scarce winter daylight sleeping, how will I spend the winter evening that is longer than the Kashgar?6 Sleep is life’s measure!” he told himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uyqu — umrning tanobi!» deydi; bu buyuk falsafa loyiq va munosib kishilarga aytiladi.
en: He shared this philosophy only with worthy and dignified people.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bechora oila a’zolari, umuman, xotin-xalaj bu uyqu falsafasini bilishdan mahrum!
en: His poor family members and womenfolk in general were deprived of this great philosophy, derived from sleep!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shaharda bo‘lsa, o‘z uyidan boshqa joyda bir kecha ham yotmaydi.
en: If he was in the city, he never spent a night in a place other than his home.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Eshon boboning qaysi bir to‘yida, tong otishga yaqin, uyiga kelib yotgan ekan...
en: At whatever celebration his elder master was, he would come home towards dawn.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shahardan tashqariga yurishi kam.
en: He rarely went outside the city.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat eshon bobo bilan birga (faqat o‘sha kishi bilan!) to‘ylarga, katta ziyofatlar, qovun va meva sayillariga boradi.
en: Only together with his elder master (only with that one person!) did he go to celebrations, large parties, fruit and melon festivals.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unda, albatta, besh-to‘rt kun uyidagi ko‘rpa-to‘shagi sovuydi.
en: While at those events, his bed at home went cold for four to five days.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qurvonbibining so‘zicha, «dam oladi», Zebining ta’rificha, «yayraydi». Bir marta qaysi bir to‘y bir haftaga cho‘zilib ketgach, oltinchi kuni bizning so‘fi eshondan so‘ramay qochib kelgan!
en: In Qurvonbibi’s words, “he is relaxing,” and in Zebi’s, “he is enjoying himself.” One time, after one celebration dragged out nearly a week, on the sixth day our Razzoq-sufi left for home without asking his master!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘shanda eshon bobo bir necha vaqtgacha so‘fidan dilgir bo‘lib yurganlar.
en: That left his elder master upset with him for quite some time.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu munosabat bilan Qurvonbibi yana bir marta oldi:
en: With that in mind, Qurvonbibi pressed him on another occasion.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hast1 eshon bilan birga borib, u kishi tufayli shuncha izzat-ikrom ko‘rib, noz-ne’matga serob bo‘lib... hast eshondan burun qochib kelganingiz nimasi?
en: “Why did you run away from your master after you left together with him? You’ve seen all the respect he is given and received from him an abundance of blessings.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shaharda ochilmagan do‘koningiz yo to‘xtab qolgan objuvozingiz bormidi? So‘fi yana past toifa oldida muborak og‘zini ochib, aziz tilini qaldiratmoqqa majbur bo‘ldi.
en: Do you have a store in the city that didn’t open on time or a watermill that suddenly stopped?” Razzoq-sufi was forced to open his blessed mouth and wag his prized tongue in front of the lesser sex.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Badbaxt Fitna!
en: “Wretched Fitna!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qo‘yasanmi, qo‘ymaysanmi, axir?
en: Will you let me alone or won’t you already?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Hubbil vatani minal-imon», deganlar — «vatanni sevish imondan», axir! Bilmasang bekor-da, Vatani yo‘q — dunyoda lo‘li, xolos.
en: Ḥubb al-waṭan min al-Īmān, that is, ‘love of home comes from faith!’ If you don’t know that, you’re hopeless.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Meni bevatan, deb bildingmi? So‘fi bir oz qizib ham ketdi:
en: Only gypsies have no home in this world.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bu hovli-joy otangdan qolgani uchun o‘zimniki deysanmi yo?
en: Are you calling me homeless?” Razzoq became a bit heated and continued.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unday desang, boshput olib, o‘rusvoyning religa2 tushib, «hayt!» deb...
en: “Do you want to say that because this house was your father’s, that it is yours?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Makkatulloga jo‘nab qola-man! Hovling boshingdan qolsin, Fitna!
en: If that’s what you’re saying, then I’ll get a passport and get on the Russians ’ rails and I’ll go to Mecca!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu safar Qurvonbibi yalinib-yolvorib zo‘rg‘a tinchitdi. Chinakam, so‘fida hajga borish niyati kuchli.
en: May you lose your house, Fitna!” This time Qurvonbibi begged and pleaded, just barely managing to talk him out of it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har yili javraydi. Birikki  marta pasport ham oldi.
en: Truthfully, Razzoq-sufi’s desire to go on the hajj was strong.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat, nima uchundir, oyog‘ini o‘z shahrining tuprog‘idan uza olmaydi.
en: Every year he brought it up. Once or twice he even got a passport.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu to‘g‘rida ham — «vatanni sevish imondan», deb — «vatani»dan kechib ketolmaydimi? Har qalay, bir siri bor.
en: Only, for some reason, he could never separate his feet from the soil of his city.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning ma’lum bir kasbi, hunari yo‘q. Na savdo-sotiq qiladi, na dehqonchilikka urinadi, na kosib-hunarmandlik peshasini tutadi.
en: Regarding his reproach—“love of home comes from faith”—was it true that he really couldn’t leave his “home”?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu bilan birga, dasturxoni nonsiz, qozoni issiqsiz qolmaydi...
en: There’s a secret to that. He did not have a single professional skill or craft.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qaysi bir yil olis bir qishloqdan o‘gay akasi kelib, uch-to‘rt kun qo‘nib ketgan edi.
en: He neither traded, nor farmed, nor wrote for a living.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U ham o‘ziga o‘xshagan mo‘min-musulmongina chol bo‘lganidan juda topishdilar.
en: Nevertheless, his table was never without bread and his pot was never cold.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har kun xonaqoga birga borardilar. — So‘fi, bir kasb peshasini tutmay o‘tib ketayotirsiz-a?
en: One year his brother came from a faraway village for three to four days.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi unga 1 Hast – «hazrati» so‘zining aytilishi.
en: Because he too was a faithful old man, they got on well.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ammo bu safar jiddiy bir masalani ko‘tarib kelgan edi. Bir-ikki kun mehmon bo‘lgandan so‘ng gap ochdi:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — So‘fi, o‘zingiz «vatan», «vatan» deysiz-u, vataningizni bilmaysiz.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi shu «bilmaysiz» degan narsaga tutoqib ketdi:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: One or two days after the guest arrived they started conversing: “Razzoq, you yourself say ‘home, home,’ but you don’t know your own home.” Razzoq-sufi fumed at “you don’t know.” “Why don’t I know, brother?!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nega bilmas ekanman, aka! Bilib gapirsangiz-chi!
en: Please tell me!” “Don’t get angry.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Jahlingiz chiqmasin.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bilib gapirayotirman. Vataningiz — otaonangiz  o‘tgan, o‘z kindigingizdan qon to‘kilgan, ota-ona arvoyiga sham yoqiladigan joy emasmi?
en: Is your home not the place where your parents passed, where your umbilical blood was spilt, where you light a candle for the spirits of your parents?” Razzoq-sufi was silent.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi jim qoldi. Hatto, ko‘zlariga yosh kelganday bo‘ldi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimaga indamaysiz? — deb so‘radi akasi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Haq gapga nima deyman?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qiziqsiz...

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bo‘lmasa, vataningiz — o‘sha o‘zimizning qishloq. — Ha, o‘sha qishloq...
en: …” “In that case your home is our village.” “Yes, our village.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkovi ham bir nafas jim qolishdi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi misvagini qinidan chiqarib yana sekingina solib qo‘ydi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Chol tizzasiga tushgan xazon bargini sopidan ushlab pildiratarkan, dedi: — Men sizni o‘sha qishloqqa olib ketay, deb keldim.
en: His brother took the autumn leaf that had fallen on his knee by its stem and twirled it, saying: “I came to take you back to our village.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siz, axir, men bilan bir shapaloq yerni talashib, shu to‘g‘rida nari-beri bo‘lishib, shu tufayli shaharga kelib qolgan edingiz... So‘fi xo‘rsinganidan ovozi qaltirab, dedi:
en: We once fought over the land left to us by our parents, decided to split it, and then you left for the city.” Razzoq-sufi’s voice wavered as he sighed: “Why do you bring up what’s already been decided?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: The past is the past.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Eski gaplarni qo‘zib nima qilasiz? Bo‘lar ish bo‘lib o‘tdi...
en: … Let the land dry up and the inheritance too.” “No, Razzoq!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yeri ham qursin, merosi ham... — Yo‘q, so‘fi!

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unday demang! Akaning bu so‘zi keskin ovoz bilan, qo‘monda singari aytilgan edi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi boshini ko‘tarib, akasining yuziga tikilib qoldi, akasi davom etdi:

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yerdan aziz hech narsa yo‘q! Otamiz rahmatlik, bobolarimiz, undan naridagilar — hammasi bir shapaloq yerdan rizqini chiqarib kelgan...
en: Our deceased father, our grandparents , our ancestors—all of them received their subsistence from that parcel of land.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Rostmi?
en: True?” Razzoq-sufi responded, barely audibly, “True …” “Why do you flee from the land?” Razzoq-sufi couldn’t manage another answer to this important question other than: “Where is there land for me? You have your parcel of land and it’s not enough for you.” His brother gave a brave answer; while starting his answer, his face involuntarily smiled and his toothless, bare mouth opened with joy.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi eshitilar-eshitilmas qilib: — Rost...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi. — Siz nega yerdan qochasiz?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi bu to‘g‘ri savolga boshqa javob eplay olmadi. — Yer qani menga?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi. — Bir shapaloq yeringiz bor, o‘zingizga yetmaydi...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Akasi dadil javob berdi; javobga boshlarkan, uning yuzlari kulgan, tishsiz — kemtik og‘zi sevinch bilan ochilgan edi:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Soyning narigi yuzidagi do‘ngni sekin-sekin olib tashlab, yer qildim. Yana bir shapaloq suvlik yer bo‘ldi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi jim bo‘ldi. So‘ngra akasi davom etdi:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qolganiga asbob olamiz. O‘z yerimizning yoni-beridan bir parcha yana yer topamiz...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Enaxon!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Jonim o‘rtog‘im! Bormisiz?
en: My best of friends!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb paranjisini qo‘liga olib Salti yugurdi. Quchoqlashib ko‘risha ketdilar.
en: Is that you?” cried Saltanat, taking her paranji in her hand and running in.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Boshqa qizlar bilan naridan beri qo‘l uchini tekkizib ko‘rishgach, Enaxon yana Saltiga yopishdi va ikkalasi qo‘ltiqlashib ichkariga tomon yurdilar.
en: They embraced one another. After greeting each of the girls, Enaxon again took Saltanat by the hand, and the two of them headed inside.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkala o‘rtoqning sharaq-sharaq gaplashgan, bir-birlariga sevinch bildirishgan quvnoq va baland ovozlari boshqa hamma unlarni bosib ketdi...
en: The voluminous voices of the two friends’ reunion drowned out all other sounds.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat ko‘chada — arava ustida boshqa hangomalar bo‘layotgan edikim, bulardan haligi ikki baxtlining hech bir xabari yo‘g‘idi: Saltining onasi bilan katta onasi uni o‘zi tenglik yosh qizlar bilan birga olis joyga yuborarkan, ehtiyot tomonini ham unutmagan edilar.
en: But outside on the cart, a catastrophe was taking place, about which the two happy friends hadn’t a clue. Saltanat’s mother and grandmother, knowing that they were sending their child to a faraway place, hadn’t forgotten to take a few precautionary measures.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning oyisi o‘z qaynonasiga: — Yosh qizlarning o‘zlarini yuborib, bo‘ladimi, qalay?
en: “Can we really send such young girls so far away by themselves?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bittayarimtamiz  birgalashmasak bo‘lmas? — deb o‘zining eslik xotin ekanini bildirgan vaqtida, qaynonasi juda keskinlik bilan javob bergan edi:
en: Can’t one of us join them?” asked Saltanat’s mother of her mother-in-law.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Albatta, aylanay! O‘zlari yolg‘iz borishadigan bo‘lsa, javob yo‘q!..
en: Her mother-in-law answered decisively: “Of course, my dear!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tandir oldida kuyib-pishib, shabnam donalariday yirik-yirik terlarga botib, Zebi bilan birga patir yopayotgan Saltiga bu maslahat juda yomon qattiq tekkan va u ham darhol o‘z ovozini eshittirgan edi: — Bizni bo‘ri yermidi?
en: If we let them go by themselves, we can’t expect them to behave!” The conversation between her elders hurt Saltanat, who was standing in front of the tandoor oven, baking a flatbread with Zebi, perspiring large droplets of dew-like sweat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh narsalaga qarilarni aralashtirib nima bor?
en: She suddenly spoke up: “Will a wolf eat us?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siqilib o‘lmaydimi odam?..
en: Why mix old women with girls?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Katta ona nevarasining bu erkaligiga faqat erkalik debgina qaragan, shu uchun:
en: A person could die from the boredom of it!” Her grandmother ignored her cheek.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Aylanay, bolam, patiringni yop! Kechga qolayotirsiz.
en: “My dear, my child, finish making your bread!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu siz aralashadigan ish emas!
en: You’ll be late.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb qo‘yib yana o‘zining «eslik» kelini bilan maslahatini davom ettirgan edi.
en: This isn’t your business!” she said and continued to advise her daughter-in-law.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Maslahat natijasida qaynona bilan kelin uyda qoladigan bo‘lib, ikkiuch  oydan beri bularnikida yashaydigan qarindoshlardan Savribibi degan kampir qizlarga ko‘z-quloq qilib berilgan edi.
en: Their conversation resulted in both women staying home. They sent Savribibi, an old woman who had been living near them for about two or three months, in their place, to be their eyes and ears.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu qari kampirning qo‘shilganiga qizlar xafa bo‘lmagan, balki, aksincha, sevingan edilar.
en: The girls weren’t upset that this old woman had joined them. On the contrary , they were quite glad.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu kampir, aravaga oyoq qo‘yar-qo‘ymas, qizlarning o‘rtasiga joyla-nib olib, Zebining tizzasiga bosh qo‘ygani holda uyquga ketgan va shu bo‘yicha qishloqqa kelib yetganda ham ko‘zini ochmagan edi...
en: As soon as she set foot in the cart and found her place among the girls, the old woman put her head down on Zebi’s lap and fell fast asleep, not opening her eyes until they arrived at the village.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qizlar o‘zlarini tappa-tappa aravadan tashlab, eshikdan ichkariga kirarkan, Zebi sekingina kampirni uyg‘otdi: — Enajon, turing, kelib qoldik!
en: While the girls were jumping from the cart and entering the house, Zebi slowly woke the old woman.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Enajondan javob bo‘lmadi. Zebi o‘sha past ovoz bilan yana bir uyg‘otdi, enajon hali ham jim edi.
en: “Auntie, get up, we’ve arrived!” There was no answer from Savribibi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aravaning oldi tomonidan kelib, aravakash ham yordamlashdi:
en: Zebi again softly tried to wake her, but she remained silent.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ho‘... xola, turing, kelib qoldik!
en: O’lmasjon made his way around the cart to help.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Erkak kishining kuchlik ovozi bilan kampir ko‘zini ochdi, lekin uyqusirab turib: — Hozir aylanay... xo‘p, turaman...
en: “We’re here, get up, auntie!” The old woman opened her eyes from the bass male voice, but answered sleepily, “just a moment, my dears … ok, I’m getting up …,” and went back to sleep.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — degandan keyin yana uyquga ketdi. Zebi kamoli hayron bo‘lganidan aravakashning nomahramligini ham unutib, haligi tangriqosh nazari bilan unga qaradi.
en: Flustered and tired, Zebi completely forgot that the cart driver was nomahram to her, and looked at him silently.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu vaqtda oy anchagina yuqori ko‘tarilib qolgan edi.
en: The moon had risen high in the night sky.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aravakash yumshoqqina kulimsiradi.
en: O’lmasjon laughed softly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh yigitning bu yosh shirin tabassumini oy yorug‘ida alayna ko‘ra olgan yosh qiz butun badanlaridan muloyimgina durkirash kechganini payqadi va qizarib, teskari qaradi...
en: The young girl, seeing the sweet smile of the young man under the moonlight, felt a tremble pass through her body. She blushed and looked away.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U qarash aravakash yigitchaga ham boshqacha ta’sir qilgan bo‘lsa kerak, kampirni turtib uyg‘otmoq uchun qo‘lini yuqori uzatdi.
en: Her look must have had a different effect on O’lmasjon. He reached up to help wake the old woman.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunda kampirning boshidagi qo‘l boshqa bir qo‘lning o‘ziga kelib tekkanini boyagidan kuchliroq bir durkirash bilan sezdi.
en: His hand on top of the old woman’s head felt the touch of another hand, and a new tremble, greater than before, washed over both hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Erkak zoti bilan birinchi marta bu xilda uchrashgan yosh qiz shu paytda bir oz gangragan edi.
en: The young girl, who only today had encountered a man without others around, fell into a trance.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuning uchun qo‘lini darrov tortib olmasdan, o‘ziga kelganidan keyin, birdaniga jerkib tortdi.
en: She didn’t immediately withdraw her hand, jerking it away only when she came to.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat yosh yigitning kuchli qo‘llari uni mahkam ushlab, kampirning boshidan pastroq tushirdi va ikkala yosh, shu bo‘yicha, turgan joylarida turib qoldilar...
en: But the young man’s strong hands seized it tightly, lowering it below Savribibi’s head. The two youths stood like that for several moments.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ichkarida o‘tirgan baxtli mehmon o‘zidan baxtli izmon bilan birga, ho‘... ancha vaqt o‘tgandan so‘ng yo‘qolgan ikki mehmonni izlab, ko‘chaga chiqqan vaqtida, ko‘chadagi ikki yosh vujud qo‘llarini birbirlaridan  hanuz ajratib ololmagan edilar.
en: The happy guest and her hostess sitting in the ichkari together only after some time went out to check on the two missing guests. When they stepped out, the young pair had still not released one another’s hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kampir esa ikki yoshning bu talvasali uchrashuviga quruq gavdasi bilan guvoh bo‘lib, hali ham shirin uyquda dang qotib yotardi...
en: As for the old woman, she was still soundly asleep, unaware that her whithered body had played host to such a vexsome meeting.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qizlarning bu «itdek» poyloqchisini ko‘plashib uyg‘otdilar, ko‘plashib aravadan tushirdilar.
en: The girls gathered to wake their “most attentive” guard and help her down from the cart.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U Salti bilan Enaxonning qo‘ltig‘iga kirib, ko‘zi uyquda, davdiray-davdiray ichkariga yo‘l soldi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi ham boshqa o‘rtoqlariday, aravadan o‘zini «tapp!» etib tashlamoqchi bo‘ldi, faqat qamchili yigit kelib, yana qo‘lini uzatdi va shuning uchun shuncha baland aravadan o‘zini tashlagan eng so‘nggi mehmonning oyog‘ tovushi hech kimning qulog‘iga qoqilmadi...
en: She slumped into Saltanat and Enaxon’s arms, her eyes still showing signs of sleep, and babbled something as she entered the house. Zebi went to jump off the cart, but the young man came around and offered his hand to help her down.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mehmonlar osh-suv taraddudiga yo‘l qo‘ymasdan, sut-qatiq bilan quruq choy ichib, darhol o‘tirgan joylari-ga uzandilar va aravada urinib kelganlari uchun uzanar-uzanmas uyquga ketdilar.
en: There was no thud of feet on the ground that had accompanied the other girls’ disembarking. They drank tea with milk and then lay out to sleep where they had eaten.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aravakash ichkaridan chiqqan ikki non bilan bir piyola qatiqni ichib oldi-da, otni tashqariga bog‘lab, o‘zi arava ustiga cho‘zildi.
en: O’lmasjon drank the cream and ate the bread that had been brought for him, tied up the horse, and lay down on the cart.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uyqusi qochgan edi...
en: Sleep eluded him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miyasi-da, umrida birinchi martaba o‘laroq, ajib va shirin xayollar aylanardi.
en: Strange and sweet thoughts unlike any in his life before filled his mind.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘qdagi oyga qarab, yerdagi oyni o‘ylar va boyagiday shirin-shirin qulimsirardi... Ichkaridagilar ham dong qotdilar.
en: He looked up at the moon in the sky and contemplated the moon on earth and laughed sweetly as he did before.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat, oralari-da, xuddi ko‘chadagi yosh yigitcha singari, uyqusi ochilgan, ko‘kragidagi yangi, begona va shirin hislarni anglayolmasdan xayron bo‘lgan birov bor edi.
en: Those inside slept soundly. Only there was one girl, who, in her surprise at these new, strange, sweet feelings, had suddenly woken up.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U ham ko‘kdagi oyga qarab, yerdagi «toy»ni o‘ylar va yuzlari anorday qizarardi...
en: Looking longingly at the moon, she contemplated her earthly existence with a sigh and her cheeks turned red like a pomegranate.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu topda, qishloqning darbadar itlari avjga kelgan, har tomondan hurishlarini yuksaltirganlar; tor ko‘chaning tugalishidagi soy hamma uxlab jim bo‘lganda, haybatli ovozini boricha qo‘yib yuborib, och yo‘lbarsday «guv-guv» bo‘kirardi...
en: The stray dogs of the village had taken over the streets, barking ever more fiercely from all sides; the creek at the end of the street began to roar like a hungry tiger.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: III Enaxon yo‘qsul bir oilaning qizi edi.
en: 3 Enaxon was the daughter of a poor family.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Otasi muning yoshligida o‘lib ketgan, onasi ikkovi birgina akaning boqimiga qarab qolgan edilar.
en: Her father had died when she was young, so her mother turned to Enaxon’s brother for help.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Akasi Xolmat esini tanigandan beri mehnat peshida chopadi.
en: Her brother Xolmat had been working for as long as he could remember.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hali eng o‘yinqaroq bola vaqtlarida ham butun qishloqning podasini boqib, oilaning ehtiyojlariga biror narsa qo‘shib turardi.
en: Even in the playfulness of youth he looked after the entire village’s herd and aided his family in what ways he could.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning podachi bo‘lgan vaqtlarini hali ham qishloq odamlari havas bilan eslashadi. Ko‘cha-qo‘yda unga yo‘liqqanlar:
en: Many of the villagers still fondly remembered his time as a herder.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Podamizni yetim qilib qo‘yding-da! — deb boshlarini afsus bilan chayqab o‘tishadi.
en: When they met him on the street, they would say: “You’ve orphaned our herd by leaving us!” They’d shake their heads and walk past.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tez-tez bo‘lib turadigan bu xil gaplar uning yuzini kuldirib, ko‘nglini ko‘taradi, tinmasdan ishlash uchun bilagiga darmon va quvvat beradi.
en: Such jokes always put a smile on his face, raised his spirits, and healed his always busily working hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning o‘z bisotida bir shapaloqqina sholipoyasi bor; u ham marhum qaynatasidan tekkan, bor kuchini shunga sarf qiladi; hammadan burun ish boshlab, hammadan kech tugatadi va hammadan ko‘p urinadi.
en: His wife’s dowry gave him a small rice field, and he spent all his energy tending to it; he started work before everyone, came home well after them, and worked harder than them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu bilangina olti jondan birikkan katta bir oilani naridan-beri tebratib keladi.
en: He was barely able to support his six-person family.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Onasi qarib, mukchayib qolgan, bir qizi bilan bir o‘g‘li hali yosh go‘dak, ro‘zg‘orning butun ishi xotini bilan singlisining bo‘ynida.
en: His mother had aged and started to stoop; his son and daughter were still babies, so the housework fell to his wife and sister.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U ikkovi dala ishlarida unga yordam berishdan ham bosh tortmaydilar, ularning dalada ham foydalari ko‘p tegadi.
en: The two of them did not neglect to help Xolmat with his work in the field either. They had their uses in the field.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xolmat o‘zi shuncha tirishib ishlab, katta ro‘zg‘orni yolg‘iz boshila tebratgani uchun xotini ham, singlisi ham uni boshlariga ko‘taradilar.
en: Xolmat put so much energy into his work, and because he was supporting the household by himself, the two women tried to accept his every demand gladly without offence.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har to‘g‘rida uning talablariga xursandlik bilan ko‘nib, hech bir ishda ko‘nglini qoldirmaslikka tirishadilar.
en: What kind of exacting demands could a poor man, who knows nothing but his work, have, you might ask?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mehnatdan boshqa hech narsani bilmagan bu yo‘qsil yigitning qanday zo‘r talablari bo‘lar edi deysiz?
en: All his passions, needs, and thoughts, whatever they might be, must have revolved around his family.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Butun havaslar, talablar va o‘ylar — har nechuk bo‘lsa ham shu oilani tebratib o‘tish tegrasida aylanadi...
en: Of course, his wife and sister were still young things; they weren’t without their youthful caprices and desires.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Albatta, kelin ham, qiz ham — yosh narsalar; yoshlarning nozlari, injiqliklari bo‘lmaydi emas...
en: It wouldn’t be right to say that their caprices were completely without merit.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Since Sultonxon had joined their household, her lips didn’t exit from between the closed vice of her teeth, her eyes teared up at the slightest thing, and in her chest, lay one of those stones that demons toss about.

en: After Xadichaxon’s laconic yet veritable words the two sat in silence, chewing on dry bread, while Poshshaxon thought these things over.

en: With the youngest co-wife now shining on mingboshi’s silver belt like a flawless ornament, Poshshaxon knew she had to recognize her now harmless rival’s innocence, comfort her broken heart, and with that, win Xadichaxon to her side. Now was the time for the two, who had been made equal before the third, to take their revenge.
