license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ular borgan joylaridan charchab kelishib, o‘tirgan o‘rinlarida shundoqqina uzanib qolgan edilar.
en: They were tired from their travel around the village, from the parties, and lay down to sleep immediately.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Erta bilan nonushta chog‘ida Enaxonning onasi qiziga qarab: — Qizim, bugun mehmonlaringni Sultonxonlarnikiga olib chiqarsana ?
en: Enaxon’s mother looked at her the next morning during breakfast and said, “My girl, are you taking your friends to Sultonxon’s today?” She couldn’t have just said that!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb qolmasinmi! Bu savol qizni ham, kelinni ham shoshirib qo‘ydi, chunki kechagi xabar hali hech kimga eshittirilmagan edi.
en: The question caught the daughter and her sister-in-law off guard because they still hadn’t had time to tell anyone.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uni nonushtadan keyin Saltanatxonning o‘zigagina izhor qilmoqchi emasmidilar?
en: They were going to tell Saltanat herself after breakfast once they had gotten up the courage.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi bu sodda kampir u "dard"ni ko‘pchilik oldida ochib qo‘ydi.
en: Now this simple old woman put their pain on display for everyone.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qiz, talvasasini berkitishga tirishgani holda, kelinbibisiga qaradi.
en: The girl, trying to contain her alarm, looked at her sister-in-law.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kelinbibisi bu qarashning ma’nosini darhol angladi va kampirga javob qaytardi:
en: The latter immediately knew what her glance meant and answered the old woman.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sultonxonlarniki sal chuchmal bo‘lib turibdi...
en: “There’s been something of a misunderstanding with Sultonxon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi, mehmonlarimiz qaerni xoxlasalar, o‘sha yerga olib boramizda...
en: We’ll take our guests wherever they want to go.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bo‘lmasa, shu yerning o‘zida yana yozilishib o‘tiramiz. Kampir o‘rinsiz savoldan yana to‘xtamadi:
en: If needed, we can always stay here and have a good time.” The old woman didn’t stop with her unnecessary questions.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sultonxonlarniki nega chuchmal bo‘ladi? Enaxon bilan kelin endi haqiqatni ochmoqqa majbur edilar.
en: “Why was there a misunderstanding with Sultonxon?” The two girls now had to tell the truth.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Enaxonga qarab olgach, kelin davom etdi:
en: The daughter-in-law looked at Enaxon and then continued.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sultonxonning onasi birdan notob bo‘lib qolibdi, qizini kecha oldirib ketgan ekan.
en: “Sultonxon’s mother fell ill with something and called her daughter to her village last night.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zi u yoqda, qanday bo‘lar ekan, deb turibmiz. Saltanat endi og‘iz ochdi:
en: If she’s there, what can we do?” Saltanat now opened her mouth.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Biz aravani qo‘shtirib jo‘nasak ham bo‘lar edi. Shaharlik qizlardan ikkitasi bu fikrga qo‘shilishdi.
en: “We could just ready the cart and leave now.” Two of the city girls announced their agreement.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat Zebi Saltanatning yelkasiga turtib, qulog‘iga sekingina shivirladi: — Muncha shoshilasiz?
en: But Zebi pushed on Saltanat ’s shoulder and whispered into her ear, “What’s the hurry?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nimangiz qolibdi shaharda?
en: What did you forget in the city?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Necha yildan bir kelib ham tuzukroq yozilmaylikmi? Shu vaqtda, salom berib, mingboshining qizi Fazilatxon kelib kirdi.
en: Since we’re here, shouldn’t we enjoy it?” Just then the mingboshi’s daughter, Fazilat, walked in, greeting everyone .
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yoshlar uni o‘rinlaridan turib qarshi oldilar-da, dasturxonga taklif qildilar.
en: The young girls got up, greeted her, and invited her to the table. The girl, however, refused.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qiz ko‘nmadi, ayvonning yonginasiga kelib to‘xtadi-da, tik turgani holda dedi:
en: She stopped at the edge of the porch to announce: “I have come to invite guests.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Men mehmonlarni aytgali chiqdim. Sultonxon ayam onalari kasal bo‘lib, ketib qoldilar.
en: Sultonxon’s mother has taken ill, and Sultonxon has left.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Oyim bilan Poshshaxon ayam mehmonlarni o‘zlari chaqiradigan bo‘lishdi.
en: My mother and her co-wife Poshshaxon had no choice but to invite you themselves.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bugun kechqurun, albatta, chiqasizlar! So‘ngra xayrlashib, chiqa boshladi.
en: This evening you must come!” She bid farewell and left.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uni to ko‘cha eshigigacha uzatib chiqqan Enaxonning besaranjom ko‘ngli yana o‘rniga tushgan, tashvishlik yuzlariga sevinch qizilliklari yugurgan edi.
en: Enaxon, who saw their unexpected guest off through the door, felt a wash of calm come over her anxious heart, and a joyous redness covered her cheeks.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: V Akbarali mingboshining belida kumush kamari, yonida kumush sopli qilichi, ustida zarbof choponi bo‘lmasa, hech kim uni amaldor demaydi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Oddiy kiyimda ko‘rganlar yo oddiy bir qishloq boyi, yo Yettisuv bilan aloqasi bor qo‘ychi, yo bo‘lmasa, yaylov tomon bilan ish ko‘radigan tuyachi, deb o‘ylaydilar.
en: 5 If it weren’t for the silver belt on Akbarali mingboshi’s waist, the silver-hilted sword on that belt, and the gold-brocade robe on his shoulders, no one would
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Chakka suyaklari turtib chiqqan, peshona — bo‘yiga tor, eniga keng va ham uzun-uzun uch chuqur ajinga ega..
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Burun o‘rtacha, lekin qanshari past...
en: have taken him for an official.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘z qisilibroq kelgan, parda tomirlaridan ikki-uchtasi va ham ikkala ko‘zining bir yonida jindak joyi hamma vaqt qizil, bir ko‘zida picha shapag‘liq asari ham bor... Iyak — keng, jag‘ — sergo‘sht.
en: Those who saw him in ordinary clothes would have said that he was a village merchant or a cattle-driver with connections to Semirech’e; or, if not that, then a camel herder constantly in search of grazing pastures.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Juda siyrak bo‘lgan soqol iyakning o‘rtasigagina to‘planib echkiniki singari, pastga tomon sangillab tushgan.
en: His cheekbones were sharp, his forehead low and covered in wrinkles . His nose was of average size, but it was crooked at the end.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zi qoraroq xotin uchrab, bir chang solsa, hech narsa qolmaydi!
en: His eyes were slanted and had inflamed red webs of veins in the corners.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mo‘ylov ham soqol singari siyrak.
en: The first signs of cataracts were visible in one.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Usta To‘xtashning «asirdiyda» do‘kati ikki kunda bir qirib turganligidan lab ustidan kalta va tekis bo‘lsa ham, umuman o‘zi, yarmidan ko‘pi yiqitilgan daraxtzor singari, xunuk ko‘rinadi, ikki uchida oltitadan o‘n ikkita uzun qil, sichqonning dumiday, ingichka bo‘lib pastga cho‘zilgan...
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Do‘kat bilan ikkala tomonga ikki marta qo‘l tegizilsa, u sichqon dumlaridan asar qolmaydi, shu bilan mo‘ylov masxaraboz kepatasidan chiqib, odam nusxasiga kiradi.
en: His chin was wide, his jaw meaty. His sparse beard thickened in the middle of his chin and extended down like a goat’s.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: San’atiga berilgan usta To‘xtash taassuf berilgan narsani yig‘ishtirib qo‘yib, «san’at—san’at uchun» degan nazardan qarab...
en: If a particularly belligerent woman on the street were to seize it and pull, there would be nothing left!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Akbarali mingboshiga mo‘ylov to‘g‘risida haligi taklifni qilgan bo‘lsa-da, shunday katta bir amaldor ham xalqning ta’nasidan qo‘rqib, usta To‘xtashning taklifini rad kildi.
en: There wasn’t much more to his mustache. Even though it was short and smooth thanks to the barber To’xtash’s efforts, it somehow looked ugly, like a forest with half its trees felled.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu bilan u masxara mo‘ylovlar ayanch bir kepatada sangillagancha qolib ketdilar...
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshini bu baland darajalarga ko‘tarib, uning vositasi bilan o‘z dimog‘larini ham chog‘ qilib turadigan shahardagi to‘ralar, uning ikki chakkasida sangillab turgan u ingichka «kokil»larni «ikki osilganlar», deb piching qilardilar...
en: Long thin hairs on either side hung down like mouse tails. He once thought to take a razor to both sides so that Akbarali might look like a real person rather than a mustachioed clown.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu soddadil «sart» amaldori muningdek pichinglarga tushunmasa ham, piching qiluvchi to‘ralarning o‘zlari mashhur rus adibining5 «Yetti osilganlari»dan ham so‘zda, ham ishda juda yaxshi xabardor edilar...
en: To’xtash, a man dedicated to his craft, gathered those wretched things, whispering to himself “art for the sake of art.” Akbarali mingboshi, hearing his suggestion to do away with the mustache, immediately rejected it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Akbarali mingboshi o‘zi yolg‘iz qolib «vijdoni» bilan qarshima-qarshi kelgan vaqtlarida, Miryoqubning ulug‘ xizmatlarini insof bilan esga olar, unga har to‘g‘rida minnatdor bo‘lganini o‘z «vijdoni» oldida iqror qilardi.
en: What would the people think of an official without a mustache?13 For that reason, the hairs continued to hang in their ridiculous fashion.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Chinakam, burungi mingboshiga yaxshi bir uloqchi otni bekorga olib bergani uchun ellikbo-shilikka istihqoq qozonganidan keyin, rosa olti yillik umri o‘z qishlog‘i bilan mingboshining mahkamasi o‘rtasida daftar ko‘tarib, ot chopish, qishloqdan odam haydab chiqib, katta yo‘lga suv septirish bilan o‘tdi.
en: The Russian nobles in the city, who had helped mingboshi climb to his current rank, had their fun at his expense, joking that his thin “braids” were like “two men hanged.” Although this simpleton sart official didn’t understand their insults, the nobles themselves were familiar with the famous Russian author’s “seven men hanged,” both in word and in deed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu olti yilning mobaynida bir uloqchi otning emas, necha uloqchi otlarning hissasi chiqarilgan, burungi besh-to‘rt tanob yerga yana bir necha besh-to‘rt tanob yer qo‘shilgan bo‘lsa-da, ellikboshilik, har qalay, mehnat, urinish va yugurib-yo‘rtishni talab qiladigan amallardan edi...
en: … In those moments that Akbarali mingboshi found himself alone with his conscience, Miryoqub’s great services to him came to mind, and he couldn’t but admit his gratefulness to his beloved servant. To be honest, it was thanks
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu chun mingboshi bir yil kuz faslida Ostanaqul boyning katta bir qovun sayil qildirganini sira esidan chiqarolmaydi, Miryoqub bilan o‘sha sayilda uchrashib tanishgani uchun sayilni esdan chiqarishga «vijdoni» yo‘l qo‘ymaydi... Bu orada ko‘p narsalar mingboshining xotiridan faromush bo‘lganlar...
en: to Akbarali’s gift of a colt to the previous mingboshi that he received the title of ellikboshi, after which he spent the next six years galloping between the mingboshi ’s office and the various villages with a notebook, evicting villagers and redirecting water where needed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U, faqat qovun sayildan ikki kun keyin Miryoqubning uyiga ikki arava qovun-tarvuz bilan ikki zambar uzum, ikki chorakkina qayroqi bug‘doy yuborganini eslaydi.
en: Over the course of those six years, he earned himself the cost of not just one colt but several, and his four or five tanobs of land transformed into several plots.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Agar xotirasi yanglishtirmasa, shundan keyin biror oy o‘tar-o‘tmas, bir kun erta bilan kumush kamar bog‘lab uydan chiqqanini, undan bir kun burun, kechasi darvozasi oldida shon-shalopli bir mirshabning poyloqchi bo‘lib chiqqanini biladi.
en: Yet his work as ellikboshi still didn’t allow him much rest. For that reason, Akbarali mingboshi couldn’t forget the spring festival organized by the merchant Ostanaqul one fall because it was precisely at that festival that he met Miryoqub for the first time.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi bo‘lganidan keyin oz fursatda Miryoqub turgan qishloqdan hozirgi hovlini sotib olib, u yerga ko‘chib bordi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Boshqa gaplar allaqachon esidan chiqib ketgan...
en: Since that time mingboshi had forgotten many things.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yurtning keksa odamlari o‘zaro so‘zlasharkan, bu mamlakatda hech bir xon va xonvachchaning muncha uzoq yurt so‘ramaganini so‘zlaydilar.
en: But he always remembered how just two days after the festival, Miryoqub sent him two carts of melons, two wheelbarrows of grapes, and two choraks of unwatered wheat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: 5 Leonid Andreevning «Yetti osilganlar qissasi» nazarda tutilyapti Mallaxonlar, Xudoyorlar, Nasriddinbeklar yurt ustidan bahor bulutlari kabi kelib ketgan edilar.
en: If his memory didn’t deceive him, not a month passed after having walked out of his house one morning with his new silver belt on that he had an armed guard greet him at his gate that evening.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Akbarali mingboshi, mana, o‘n uch yildan beri shu masnadida o‘tiradi, davlati, obro‘si, nufuzi tobora oshsa oshadiki, kamimaydi. — Xudo bergan-da, xudo!
en: After he was appointed mingboshi, he bought his present house in Miryoqub’s village and moved there to be close to him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deyishadi keksalar. — Xudoyo «ol, qulim», desa, hech gap emas.
en: He forgot other things, but not this.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundayda ba’zi bir yosh-yalanglar:
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xudo hadeb shunaqa insofsizlarga berar ekan-da! Biz, bechoralarga ham bir narsa uzatsinchi!
en: The elders of the village, talking among themselves, said that no previous khan had ever ruled their land so long.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb qolishadi. Buni eshitgan keksalar tayoq ko‘tarib, yosh-yalang ustiga yugurishadi, bechora yoshlar tayoqdan o‘zlarini olib qocharkan, bir-birlariga qarab piching otishadi:
en: Mallaxon, Xudoyor, Nasriddinbek, and the like had come and gone seemingly with every movement of the spring clouds. But Akbarali mingboshi had now thirteen years occupied his post, and all the while his wealth, esteem, and power grew unabatingly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimaga qochasan? Xudo senga ham berayotir, olmaysanmi?..
en: “God granted him to us, God!” said the elders.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yurtning keksalari butun bu davlat, hukumat va ulug‘likning — bir og‘iz gapini silliq va yoqimli qilib gapirolmaydigan sodda va to‘ng odamga birdaniga «nasib va ro‘zi» bo‘lib qolishida Miryoqub akaning katta hunari bor ekanini yaxshi bilishadi.
en: “God told him, ‘Take it, my servant,’ and that’s all there was to it.” Some of the youth couldn’t help themselves: “God gives to such unjust people!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun Miryoqub aka ko‘chakuyda  ko‘ringanda, unga beriladigan salom va qilinadigan ta’zimlar, mingboshinikidan kam bo‘lmaydi.
en: Why does he not throw us poor a little something?!” Having heard this, the elders ran after the youth, brandishing sticks, and the youth fled.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat shu qadarisi borki, mingboshi u yoq-bu yoqqa juda kam yuradi, yursa ham mirshablarini orqasiga ergashtirib, kechasi yuradi; kunduzlari bo‘lsa, faqat shahardagi ulug‘vor chaqirtirganda, zarbof choponlarini kiyib va tatti samanni yo‘rg‘alatib o‘tadi.
en: “Why are you running? God will give you yours, come and get it!” The elders well knew that this wealth, esteem, and power weren’t granted by God to a simple and coarse person that could hardly form a sentence without Miryoqub’s help.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unga salom berish va ta’zim qilishdan bellarga og‘irlik kelmaydi: chunki oyda bir, o‘n kunda bir egilib qo‘yish hech gap emas.
en: The greetings and bows that Miryoqub received every time he appeared on the street were no less than those given to the mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ammo Miryoqub akaning yurishi ko‘p!
en: In fact, they were probably more.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U, aksari, piyoda yuradi, yurganda ham negadir shoshilib yuradi. «Assalomu alaykum!», deb dona-dona qilib salom bersangiz, shoshilganidan bo‘lsa kerak, «vass...», debgina qo‘yadi.
en: Mingboshi was very rarely seen on the street, and when he was, it was at night behind several guards; during the day, he only went out in his gold-brocade robe to see the city’s notables on his thoroughbred.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu bilan birga, siz tomonga bo‘ynini qiyshaytirib, juda kichiklik bilan alik oladi, doim kulimsirab turgan ko‘zlarini siz tomonga qiyagina bir tashlab olib, yo‘rg‘alaganicha ketadi...
en: No one strained themselves too much greeting and bowing to him because bending over once every month or, hell, once in ten days is no hard thing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Jinqarchaday hammavaqt va har qayda ko‘rinib qoladigan bu «asl mingboshi»ga salom bermoqdan bellaringiz toladi...
en: But Miryoqub was always on his feet and always on the streets. Most of the time he walked, but he was always in a hurry.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Do‘konidan har narsa topiladigan bir baqqolga «farang baqqol» deb nom qo‘ygan keksalar har ishda qo‘li bo‘lgan bu odamga «Miryoqub epaqa» laqabini berib, xato qilmaganlar.
en: If you offered him an “Assalom alaykum!” you would only receive a “Vaalaykum” in return, probably because he was hurrying .
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zlari ham bu laqabning to‘g‘riligini osongina isbot qiladilar:
en: If he turned his head in your direction and greeted you, it was always with a glance of his smiling eyes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — U aralashmagan ish epaqaga kelmaydi... Mingboshining yer-suvi shu qadar ko‘pki, hisobini o‘zi ham bilmaydi.
en: Your back really would give out bowing to this “real mingboshi” whose business took him every which where at all hours of the day.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Unlike their previous efforts at nicknaming—they called a local grocer “European grocer”—the village elders weren’t mistaken in awarding Miryoqub the moniker “Miryoqub the sly.” They justified their choice with ease: “nothing comes out right if his hand hasn’t touched it.” The mingboshi owned so much land and water that he himself couldn’t keep track of his holdings.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lekin xudo bu sevgili quliga davlatni ikki qo‘llab uzatsa-da, farzand to‘g‘risida bir oz o‘ksitib qo‘ygan.
en: But although God had granted his favorite servant such wealth and supported him in everything, He left him in arrears regarding children.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Darhaqiqat, katta xotinidan bo‘lgan qizi Fazilatdan boshqa uning farzandi yo‘q.
en: In fact, he had no children other than his eldest wife’s daughter, Fazilat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.
anchor_note: A8: katta xotinidan <-> eldest wife’s daughter

uz: Muncha katta davlat kimga qoladi?
en: To whom would he leave all that wealth?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yetti yot begonalarga, zurriyoti yo‘q ayollargami?..
en: To his childless wives, to complete strangers?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi, mana shu amalga iloj axtarib bo‘lsa kerak, bir-ikki yil ichida yosh xotin oldi. Boladan darak yo‘q...
en: His constant marriages must have been his strategy to rectify the inheritance problem, but even then, he had no luck.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Sequestering himself alone in his house, where not even a shadow could hear him, he would tell himself: “that damn girl better not be from another man.” Miryoqub, as mingboshi got older, sometimes asked himself: “was it not mingboshi’s hopeless situation that caused his womanizing?” One day at noyib to’ra’s, they were sitting with the host drinking when noyib to’ra’s wife unexpectedly brought their grandson in.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu chun, ba’zida, o‘zi yolg‘iz qolib, mehmonxonaga berkinganida va hatto o‘z soyasining ham eshitmoq ehtimoli qolmaganda:
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — «Bu qiz o‘lgur ham boshqadan bo‘lmasin...» deb qo‘yadi...
en: He was golden-haired, round like a watermelon, chubby, and white like cotton.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub uning yoshi anchaga borib qolganda, bunday xotinparast bo‘lib ketishiga shu farzand xususidagi noumidlik sabab bo‘lmadimikan? deb ba’zi-ba’zida o‘ylab qo‘yadi.
en: Mingboshi suddenly took the boy in his hands, and, despite the boy being an infidel and a Russian, embraced him closely and kissed him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir kun noyib to‘ranikida (uezd hokimining o‘rinbosarinikida) ichkilik qilib o‘tirishgan edilar, ichkilik quyilmasdan oldinroq noyibning onasi o‘z nevarasini olib kirib qoldi.
en: The boy must have been frightened by the mingboshi’s unpleasant face because he started sobbing uncontrollably. They took the boy out.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U — tilla sochli, tarvuzday dumaloq, o‘zi lo‘ppigina va oppoq momiqday bir bola edi.
en: Immediately after, mingboshi poured himself a full glass of vodka, downed it, and then another, and another.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi bolani darhol qo‘liga oldi va, o‘z aqidasicha, «kofir»ning va «o‘rus»ning bolasi ekaniga qaramay, mahkam bag‘riga bosib o‘pdi...
en: Miryoqub’s nudging, gesturing, the hosts’ reprimands and later threats—none of it had any effect. Once mingboshi was completely inebriated, he asked them to bring the boy in again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bola mingboshining basharasidan qo‘rqqan bo‘lsa kerak, jon achchig‘ida yig‘lay boshlagan edi...
en: His mother had no desire to give her little lamb to a drunk, but mingboshi began to beg.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bolani olib chiqib ketdilar.
en: He even started weeping.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan so‘ng mingboshi bir-bir ustun quyib icha berdi, icha berdi... Miryoqubning imolari, ishoratlari, uy egalariga eshittirmay qilgan tanbehlari, hatto do‘qlari... hech bir ta’sir qilmadi.
en: Noyib to’ra ordered that the boy be woken up and delivered, but mingboshi had already lost consciousness and collapsed on the divan by the time the boy came in.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi tamom mast bo‘lgach, «Bolani olib kelinglar», deb so‘radi. Bolaning onasi bu badmast odamga o‘z to‘qlisini bermoq istamas edi.
en: Deprived of both child and wits but buried in land, water, money, and other riches, mingboshi was entirely in Miryoqub’s hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nihoyat, mingboshi yalinib-yolvorib so‘ramoqqa majbur bo‘ldi. Hatto ko‘zlariga yosh oldi...
en: Mingboshi never knew the amount of the harvest that came from his lands nor how much made its way to Miryoqub’s coffers.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra noyibning amri bilan bolani uyg‘otib keltirdilar.
en: When necessary, mingboshi actually asked Miryoqub for money.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat bu vaqtda mingboshi o‘zidan ketib, divanga ag‘anagan edi...
en: If his household needed flour, rice, meat, oil, or anything else, Miryoqub took care of it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Farzanddan va esdan mahrum, lekin yer-suv, pul va boshqa boylikka ko‘milgan bu odamning butun borligi Miryoqubning qo‘lida edi.
en: Mingboshi, who since receiving his appointment knew nothing but life’s pleasures, never asked Miryoqub how he managed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yerdan chiqqan hosilning qanchasi o‘z qo‘liga kirib, qanchasi Miryoqub omboriga to‘kilganini mingboshi o‘zi hech qachon bilgan emas.
en: Miryoqub would hardly have earned the name “sly” if all his work had been for mingboshi alone.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kerak bo‘lganda, mingboshi Miryoqubdan pul so‘rab olar, un, gurunch, go‘sht, yog‘ va ro‘zg‘orning boshqa keraklarini bo‘lsa ichkarining talabiga qarab yana
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub tayyorlab berar, shu uchun jonning rohatidan boshqani bilmagan mingboshi undan narisini surishtirmas edi.
en: He received the name because there was no profitable opportunity that he didn’t have his hands in.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqubning topishi yolg‘iz shu mingboshi orqali bo‘lsa, unga «epaqa» nomini qo‘yish to‘g‘ri bo‘larmidi?
en: In the village there were two groceries , a butcher shop; and, in the district, two teahouses.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqubning qilmagan ishi yo‘qligidan shu nomni bergan edilar.
en: People in the know said that four of the five ran by Miryoqub’s initiative alone.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qishloqda ikkita baqqollik, bitta qassoblik do‘koni, guzarda ikkita samovar bor.
en: In the city, a new cotton factory had recently opened shop along the main road.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bilgan odamlar bu besh muassasadan to‘rti Miryoqubning kuchi bilan aylanganini so‘zlaydilar.
en: Its warehouses were so big that at harvest time the cotton had to be weighed on three scales.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shaharda katta yo‘lning bo‘yiga — qo‘rg‘on tashqarisiga bir yangi paxta zavodi tushdi, zavodning kattakon bir paxta saroyi ham bor-ki, paxta terim vaqtida uch tarozi bilan paxta oladi.
en: They said that Miryoqub was a shareholder in that factory. It couldn’t have been a coincidence that his two-wheeled yellow phaeton and chestnut mare were usually hitched there.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ana o‘sha zavodga ham Miryoqubni sherik, deydilar. Voqean, uning ikki g‘ildirakli sariq faytonchasi va sariq yo‘rg‘asi aksar zavod oldida bog‘langan bo‘ladi.
en: He was a member of one of the big banks’ auditing commissions and conducted meetings once a week in that capacity.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shahardagi katta bankalardan birida «uchyot qo‘mitasi»ning a’zosi, haftada bir majlis o‘tkazadi...
en: On top of that, no one ever saw him pay the smallest of taxes or buy one license.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu bilan birga, uning biror joyga chaqa soliq to‘laganini, biror kasbga biror marta «qizil qog‘oz» (patent) olganini hech kim bilmaydi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshining boshiga ne qora kunlar kelmadi!
en: What kind of misfortunes didn’t occur with mingboshi?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yaxshi advokatlar tomonidan bitilgan g‘alati arizalar qanday tergovchilarni keltirmadi! Qanday zo‘r to‘ralar chaqirib so‘ramadilar!
en: What kind of strange accusations written by skilled lawyers didn’t bring investigators over to mingboshi?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hokim necha martalar g‘azab bilan chaqirtirmadi!
en: How many times did the district governor call him in?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unday vaqglarda mingboshi Miryoqubning ta’limi bilan hamma savollarga «bilmayman», deb javob berar yoki biror aybisnod  qilinsa, tonib tura berardi.
en: In such times mingboshi, taught well by Miryoqub, always answered “I don’t know” and denied any fault in the matter.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Rasmiy so‘roqlar bu xilda borganda, orqadan Miryoqub g‘ayrirasmiy yo‘llar bilan so‘roq berar, bir-ikki kun shaharda qolib, qishloqqa qaytganida, mingboshining ustidan har qanday og‘ir tog‘ ham ag‘anagan bo‘lardi.
en: And while those official interrogations were conducted, Miryoqub always conducted a few of his own unofficial ones. After staying in the city for one or two days, he would return to the village, having cleared mingboshi of all charges.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi qaysi bir to‘ranikiga borsa, Miryoqub, albatta, birgalashib boradi; «bu nimaga kerak?» deb so‘ragan odam yo‘q. Axir, Miryoqub amaldor bo‘lmasa, loaqal mingboshiga mirza yo tilmoch bo‘lmasa, o‘zi o‘rus tilini tuzuk-quruq bilmasa... nega munaqa mingboshining ketidan elchib yurardi?
en: If mingboshi went to one of the Russian nobles, Miryoqub, of course, accompanied him, and no one ever asked, “Why is he here?” After all, Miryoqub wasn’t an official and wasn’t a secretary or interpreter for mingboshi, nor did he even know Russian.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Why did he always follow mingboshi like a tail?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nega?
en: Why?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqubning ko‘p umri mingboshinikida o‘tadi, o‘zining hovlisi ham shu qishloqning o‘zida-ku, lekin chekkaroq joyda.
en: Miryoqub spent a good part of his time at mingboshi’s home, though his house was in the same village.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kechalari uning hovlisida bir-ikki mirshabning poyloqchilik qilib chiqqanini gapiradilar, faqat muni o‘z ko‘zi bilan ko‘rgan kishi yo‘q, bo‘lsa ham ochib gapirmaydi, yo... gapirolmaydi!
en: They say that his house was guarded every night by one or two policemen, only no one had ever seen them, and even if they had seen them, they wouldn’t, no, couldn’t talk about it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir kun Miryoqub noyib to‘raning uyida edi.
en: One day Miryoqub was at noyib to’ra’s house.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu safar olib borgan hadyasi to‘raga nihoyat darajada yoqib ketgan bo‘lsa kerak, to‘ra uni uzoq olib o‘tirib, ko‘p narsalarni gapirib berdi.
en: The gift he had brought this time must have finally so impressed the nobleman that the latter sat him down and talked of several things.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘raning tili charchab, Miryoqubning og‘zida birinchi esnash asarlari ko‘ringan ediki, tashqaridan bir odam kirib keldi.
en: When the noble’s tongue tired and the first signs of a yawn appeared on Miryoqub’s face, a person came in from outside.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikki tomon yoqasiga tilladan bolg‘a surati o‘rnatilgan, novcha bo‘yli, mosh-birinch soqolli, xushmo‘ylov va bir ko‘zi jindak g‘ilaydan kelgan bu kular yuzli odam ma’ruf injenerlardan edi.
en: On his shoulders were two gold hammers; he was tall and had a greying beard and thick mustache. His smiling face was marred by one eye that was constantly squinting.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Noyib to‘ra bilan betakalluf ko‘rishdi, Miryoqub bilan ko‘rishib o‘tirmasdan, to‘ppato ‘g‘ri stolning to‘g‘risiga o‘tirdi va yumshoq kursini bir qo‘li bilan qattiqqina qimirlatib ko‘rgandan keyin, avval bilagidagi tilla soatga qaradi, so‘ngra «da-da» deb cho‘zib qo‘yib, kursiga o‘zini tashladi.
en: He was most certainly one of those educated engineers common in Turkestan. He exchanged pleasantries with noyib to’ra, but said nothing to Miryoqub and quickly moved towards the table in front of him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan keyin noyib to‘ra Miryoqub tomonga ishorat qilib va yangi mehmonga tomon burilib:
en: The guest attempted, unsuccessfully, to move the chair with a powerful jerk of his hand.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bizning Miryoqub bilan tanishmisiz, azizim? Noyob odamlardan!
en: He then looked at his watch and threw himself down on the chair.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Noyib to’ra gestured at Miryoqub and turned to his guest, “Are you acquainted with our Miryoqub, my friend?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — degach, u odam o‘tirgan o‘rnida sekingina bosh silkib qo‘ydi.
en: He is a rare one!” The guest lightly nodded in Miryoqub’s direction.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub g‘ururining kaltaklanishidan kelgan bir zaharxanda bilan kuldi, injener esa burungi kular yuzini ham no‘qtalab oldi.
en: Miryoqub smiled, revealing his irritation and injured pride, while the engineer, a moment ago smiling, suddenly scowled.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Muni noib to‘ra yaxshi payqadi shekilli, Miryoqubga xuddi mehribon otaning sevimli bolasiga qaraydigan qarashi bilan iliq va muloyim kulib qaradi.
en: Noyib to’ra must have sensed this, and laughed softly and warmly, glancing at Miryoqub as a loving father looks at his favorite son.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub ham erka o‘g‘ildek muqobala qildi.
en: Miryoqub, like a pampered son, answered noyib to’ra with a smile.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu bilan bu suhbatning Miryoqub aralashgan ko‘rinishlariga parda tortildi-da, ikkala bilimdon so‘zga tushdi.
en: With that, the curtain descended on Miryoqub’s participation in the interaction, and the two Russians talked among themselves.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Injener, bulbul singari, sayray ketdi, sayray ketdi!
en: The engineer hummed and hummed like a nightingale!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub advokat xalqining mahmadonaligini bilardi bu odamning advokat emas, injener bo‘lganini ham ajrata olardi.
en: Miryoqub knew that lawyers were a talkative bunch, but he never expected such garrulity from an engineer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun boshda ularning tobora qizishayotgan suhbatlariga u ham qiziqib qaradi. Keyincha to‘ra ham, — mehmondan yuqdimi nima?
en: Gradually, he started to catch something of their Russian conversation.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — tillarini burro qilib so‘zlashga, mehmonning ko‘p da’volarini aksi da’volar bilan sindirmoqqa tushib ketgach, bizning Miryoqub sekingina qo‘l uzatib, stolning bir chetida turgan katta bir kitobni oldi.
en: When noyib to’ra noticed that Miryoqub was listening intently, he started to orate in a fine tone, perhaps to match the guest’s. At that point, our Miryoqub stretched out his hand and took a large book from the table.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kitob surat bilan liq to‘la edi, hech sharpa qilmasdan, uni bitta-bitta varaqlay boshladi.
en: The book was full of pictures. He began to leaf through it noiselessly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘ra Miryoqubni unutdi, go‘yo u bu yerda yo‘q kabi...
en: The nobleman forgot Miryoqub as if he wasn’t there at all.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Injenerning og‘zidan, ba’zi-ba’zida sartlarga og‘ir keladigan so‘zlar chiqib ketganidagina, to‘ra boyagi qarash bilan Miryoqubga qarab qo‘yar, lekin unday fursatlarda uning ikki ko‘zi kitobda bo‘lsa ham ikki qulog‘i,
en: Only when a few slurs about sarts came from the engineer’s mouth, did noyib to’ra direct at Miryoqub his fatherly glance. Even though Miryoqub’s eyes were on the book, his ears, like a snake stalking its prey, were fully on the conversation.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: avrashga tushgan ilonday, dikkayganini to‘ra bilmas edi.
en: Noyib to’ra didn’t notice.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uzoq cho‘zilgan bu suhbatda Miryoqubning qulog‘i bir marta juda g‘alati dikkaydi, hatto uning qop-qora chiroyli ko‘zlarida allaqanday sehrli olovlar yondi.
en: In that now quite drawn-out conversation, Miryoqub’s ear caught hold of something very strange, and his jet-black eyes burned with a charmed fire.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning boshi ham kitobdan ko‘tarilib, yuzlaridan yengil bir qizillik yoyilib o‘tdi.
en: His head lifted involuntarily from the book, and his cheeks flushed red.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘sha joyda sartlarni kamsitadigan gap o‘tmaganligidan bo‘lsa kerak, to‘ra ham uzr so‘ragan qarash bilan Miryoqubga qaramadi.
en: This time they must not have said anything derogatory about sarts because the nobleman didn’t look Miryoqub’s way.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkala suhbatdosh o‘sha joyda Miryoqubning quloqlarini dikkaytirgan so‘zlarni unga va u mansub bo‘lgan xalqqa aloqasiz bir narsa deb qaradilar, shekilli, xuddi Miryoqub shu yerda bo‘lmaganday, o‘z oralaridagina o‘tkazib yubordilar...
en: The two interlocutors must have thought that their topic had nothing to do with Miryoqub and his people because they didn’t interrupt themselves, continuing as if their sart listener wasn’t in the room.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Injener turib chiqib ketgandan keyin Miryoqub o‘rnidan turdi va ketishga ijozat so‘radi.
en: After the engineer left Miryoqub stood up and requested to depart.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘ra u bilan xayrlasharkan, injenerning boyagi kamsitishlari uchun yana-tag‘in uzr so‘ragan bo‘ldi.
en: When noyib to’ra saw him out, he remembered the engineer’s uncouthness and asked Miryoqub’s forgiveness repeatedly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub faqat kulibgina qo‘ydi, boshqa hech narsa demadi.
en: Miryoqub only smiled, not saying a word.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘ra bu kulishni Miryoqubning xursand va rozi ekaniga yo‘ydi va ko‘ngli o‘rniga tushdi.
en: The nobleman took Miryoqub’s smile as a sign that he was satisfied and had calmed down.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat Miryoqubning ko‘ngli bir necha kungacha o‘rniga tushgani yo‘q.
en: But Miryoqub could hardly calm down.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir injenerning (u, axir, noyib to‘ra singari katta amaldor emas!), nihoyati bir injenerning bir-ikki marta sartlarni kamsitishi Miryoqubni shuncha bezovta qildimi?
en: Could an engineer (after all, he wasn’t a nobleman like noyib to’ra), a simple engineer, touch Miryoqub to the quick? No, those insults were like those he heard every day!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘q, unaqa kamsitishlar har qadamda bor! Hammasiga bezovta bo‘la bersa, Miryoqub bechora to‘rt kunda sil bo‘lib qolmaydimi?
en: If he took offense to everything, would he not come down with consumption in just four days?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘q, yo‘q!
en: No, no!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kamsitishlar o‘sha onning o‘zidayoq unutilgan, o‘tgan yilgi qordek erib yo‘q bo‘lgan, bahordagi yomg‘ir kabi asari ham qolmagan...
en: He had forgotten the insults the moment they had been pronounced. They were gone forever like last year’s snow; like after a spring rain there was no sign of them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Injener o‘sha suhbatda yangi — hali sir bo‘lgan bir xabarni aytib edi: shu shahardan boshlab falon-falon joylarga poezd yo‘li tushar ekan.
en: The engineer had said something new, something previously secret, in that conversation: the Russians were preparing to build a rail line down from this city to such-and-such a place.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir shirkat planlarini Peterburgdagi katta mahkamalarga topshirgan, ular tasdiq qilishga va’da berganlar.
en: A company had already submitted its plans to the appropriate Petersburg chancelleries, and they had promised to approve them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Allaqaysi bir bankka pul bermoqchi bo‘lgan, tekshirish uchun yaqin orada injenerlar chiqar ekan. Imorat — bino ishlariga o‘sha injenerni chaqirganlar.
en: The company would take out a loan from some bank, and engineers would come soon to check on the project.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub poezdning qaerlardan o‘tishini bilib olgan edi.
en: That engineer had been sent here for the construction.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘sha suhbatda uning qulog‘i bir dikkaydi, juda ajoyib dikkaydi, lekin!
en: Miryoqub knew immediately where the railroad would be laid.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ana o‘shanda poezdning o‘tish joylarini miyasiga joylashtirgan edi.
en: He had formed a plan just as soon as his ears pricked up during the conversation.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Oradan bir hafta o‘tar-o‘tmas, bezovtalik harakatga va ishga aylandi.
en: Not a week went by before Miryoqub set to work.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir oyga yetar-etmas, o‘sha kelajak poezd yo‘li bo‘ylaridan Miryoqub juda ko‘p — bir necha yuz desatin yer sotib oldi.
en: In less than a month, Miryoqub had bought several hundred tanobs directly along the path of the future track.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yerlarning hammasi deyarlik suvsiz, noobod, tashlandiq yerlar edi. Shuncha ko‘p yerga qancha oz pul
en: Almost all of the lands had no access to water, were barren and abandoned, so they cost nothing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: ketdi. Ko‘plar bu shoshilish savdoni bil-madilar; bilganlar Miryoqubni «jinni bo‘libdi», dedilar.
en: Many of the owners had never seen such swiftness in the exchange of property, and others started saying that Miryoqub had lost his mind.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shirkat poezd yo‘li solishga ijozat olib, tayyorgarliklarga kirishgandan keyingina, Miryoqub qilgan ishini noyib to‘raga aytdi.
en: Once the company received permission to lay rail track and began the preparations, Miryoqub informed noyib to’ra of what he had done.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sen xuddi bir amerikalikka o‘xshaysan, Miryoqub! — dedi to‘ra.
en: “You’re just like an American, Miryoqub!” said the nobleman.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Lekin ko‘nglingga og‘ir olma, chakki shu sartiya ichida tug‘ilib qolgansan!
en: “Don’t be offended, but you shouldn’t have been born a sart!”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub ko‘ngliga og‘ir olish tugul, bu gapga sevindi balki, yuzlariga yana o‘sha yengil qizillik yugurdi.
en: Miryoqub not only was not offended but was actually pleased and blushed again as before.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yangi yo‘lning allaqaysi bir joyida ko‘z ilg‘amas bir cho‘l bor edi.
en: Along the new track’s path was a boundless desert. A desert, a completely arid desert.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Cho‘l, qup-quruq cho‘l... Suv — pastda, chuqurda.
en: It had water, but only deep underneath the earth’s surface.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Atrofdagi dehqonlardan ba’zilari u yerni ekin yeriga aylantirish uchun turli davrlarda yakka-yakka urinib ko‘rgan, lekin hamma qilgan mehnatlari bekor ketib, u yerdan xafsalalari pir bo‘lgandi.
en: Farmers around it over several generations had tried to make the land arable, but their efforts had been in vain, and all hopes for the land only met with disappointment .
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hali ham u cho‘lda unumsiz qolgan odam mehnatining asarlari, to‘g‘risi, xarobalar ko‘rinadi: ariqlar, ekin, pollari, marzalar, bir necha tup qurigan tut daraxtchalari... Miryoqub oz pul, ko‘p ustalik sarf qilib o‘sha cho‘lni o‘z nomiga o‘tkazdi.
en: The ruins of these fruitless attempts at working the land, however, were still visible: canals, sown areas, controlled-burn lands, land boundaries, a few dried mulberry trees.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat bu vaqtlarda poezd yo‘lining rejalari tortila boshlaganligidan, odamlar Mir-yoqubni «jinni» demadilar, balki «bu — bir narsani bilib qiladi», dedilar.
en: Miryoqub with a little money and a lot of ingenuity managed to acquire this desert. When news of the track began to spread, no one called Miryoqub crazy anymore.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Poezd yo‘li solinib bitmasdan turib, u cho‘lga necha tegirmonlik katta suv chiqdi.
en: Before construction of the railroad had finished, Miryoqub brought water to the surface with the help of pumps.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Avvalo o‘z cho‘ntagining, qolaversa, otaxon mingboshining yordami bilan cho‘lning o‘rtasidan katta bir ariqni o‘tkazib qo‘ydi.
en: Miryoqub paid out of his own pocket and, when needed, from mingboshi’s, to construct a canal through the middle of the desert.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan keyin yersiz dehqonlarga chek bo‘lib bera boshladi.
en: Then he began to rent out the land to landless farmers.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘p o‘tmay, u yerda bir qishloq paydo bo‘ldi va suv chiqargan odamning shahardagi otaxoni nomiga atalib «Parpi cheki» bo‘ldi (noyib to‘raning nomi Fyodor, sartlar «Parpi to‘ra» deydilar.) Keyincha cho‘lning bir chetiga poezd stantsiyasi tushdi, yoni-beriga choyxonalar, do‘konlar, saroylar solina boshladi.
en: In not much time a village appeared there, and it was named for the patron who had supplied the water—“Parpi village” (noyib to’ra’s name was Fyodor, and the sarts called him “Parpi to’ra.”)16 One end of the village was chosen as a site for the train station, and next to it teahouses, stores, and other buildings started to go up.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Poezd yo‘li ochilgandan keyin o‘sha joydan paxta zavodi uchun yer tanladilar.
en: After the rail line opened, a commission chose a nearby site for a cotton factory.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bolgariyalardan iborat uch kishilik bir shirkat yana o‘sha joydan ancha yer sotib olib, kattakon bir mevalik bog‘ va zo‘r bir sabzavot polizi vujudga kel-tirdi.
en: A group of three Bulgarians also bought land in the village for their company and put a fruit orchard and vegetable garden into operation.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har qalay, poezd o‘tgandan keyin, bir necha yil orasida Miryoqubning qo‘lida juda oz yer qoldi, hammasi har kimga o‘tib ketdi.
en: However it happened, just a few years after the train began running, Miryoqub had very little land left. Everything had passed to other people.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub yerni uncha sevmaydi, yer qo‘ldan chiqsa, xafa bo‘lmaydi.
en: Miryoqub had no particular love for land, and its loss didn’t upset him much.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuncha yer qo‘ldan chiqqan bo‘lsa, uning baravariga qancha davlat qo‘lga kirgandir, muni
en: The land may have gone, but Miryoqub was all the wealthier for it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: xudo biladi-yu xudoning sevimli bandasi qorako‘z Miryoqub biladi!..
en: How much he had made only God and his favorite servant, black-eyed Miryoqub knew! ...
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Mingboshi o‘zining rus mirzasi Sokolov, inoq mirshabi Mirzabobolar bilan birga saman yo‘rg‘a ustida o‘z darvozasiga kelib to‘xtaganda, qorong‘i tushgan, ko‘chada o‘ynovchi bolalarning onalari eshik tagiga chiqib, «Bemahalda bas endi», deya tergay boshlagan edilar.
en: Darkness had already set in when the mingboshi on his dun horse, along with his Russian secretary Sokolov and the police chief Mirzabobo, approached the gates of his home. The mothers of the children playing on the street had begun to call their children—“enough already, it’s late.” Before mingboshi could
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: even stop his horse, the police guards outside ran over and opened the gates.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshining oti to‘xtar-to‘xtamas, tashqaridagi mirshablar yugurishib borib, darvozani ochdilar, katta darvozaning bir qanotidan chiqqan ingichka qiytillash ovozi muazzinlarning xunuk va qo‘pol tovushlariga qorishdi...
en: The creak of one leaf of the gates merged with the piercing drone of the call to prayer. The bellowing of the cows and the light bleating of separated calves longing for their mothers mixed in with these sounds, creating a somber yet pleasant melody.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu ovozlar orasida bolalariga qovushgan sigirlarning og‘ir mo‘lashlari bilan onalarini sog‘ingan buzoqlarning erka ma’rashlari mungli va yoqimli eshitilardi. Mingboshi, otdan tushar-tushmas, so‘radi:
en: Without dismounting, the mingboshi asked, “Has Miryoqub come?” Mingboshi’s Muslim secretary Hakimjon, putting his hand on his chest out of respect, answered, “Yes, he is here.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Miryoqub keldimi? Mingboshining musulmon mirzasi Hakimjon qo‘l qovushtirib turib, javob berdi:
en: He is sleeping in the front room.” The mingboshi smiled, obviously happy with himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, shu yerda. Mehmonxonada uxlab yotibdi.
en: “That impudent scoundrel dares to sleep so early!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi o‘zidan xursand, kuldi: — Noinsofning kech kirganda uxlashini qarang!
en: Go, wake him up!” The two police guards began to help mingboshi dismount.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bor, uyg‘otib chiq!
en: He continued laughing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikki mirshab mingboshini yechintirmoqqa boshladi.
en: “Hey you, impious one.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
