en: Her mother, only her mother.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: … But her mother was powerless before her cold-hearted father’s limitless obstinacy … just one weak soul … The conversation continued inside.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘zning ketishiga qarab ovozlar dam ko‘tarilar, dam bosilardi.
en: From time to time, voices were raised and then suppressed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Siz nima dedingiz, siz? — deb so‘radi kampir.
en: “What did you say?” asked the old woman.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning bu savolidan ochiq bir bezovtalik sezilardi: «Bu so‘fi o‘lgur unab qo‘ymadimikan?!» Razzoq so‘fi indamasdan, miyig‘ida kulimsirab turardi.
en: The tone of her voice undoubtedly betrayed her agitation: “He couldn’t possibly have agreed to their offers?!” she thought.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu kulimsirashda bir mug‘ombirlik asari, «Men bo‘lamanu indamay qolamanmi?» degan ifodalar boridi...
en: Razzoq-sufi said nothing and only chuckled. In that chuckle was a hint of playfulness: “It was me.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kulimsirash bilan yana ham xunukroq kepataga kirgan basharasini kampir tomon ko‘tarib turib:
en: How could I have said nothing?” it seemed to say. He turned to his wife with another uncomforting look.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘sha betavfiq, benamozga qiz beramanmi, qalay? — dedi.
en: “Would I really give my daughter to that impious, immoral man?” he said.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu so‘zlardan so‘ng kampirning ko‘ngli bir oz o‘rniga tushdi.
en: A sense of relief washed over the old woman.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xayriyat...
en: “Thank God.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunday dedingizmi? So‘fi bu daf’a nodon xotinini masxara qilib kuldi.
en: You said that?” Razzoq this time mocked his ignorant wife.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ahmoq!
en: “Idiot!” he said.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi u. — Ularing allaqaylardan daromad qilib kelib, zo‘rg‘a ipning uchini chiqardi-yu, men «yo‘q!» deb tomdan tarasha tushganday javob bera-manmi? — Ha, nima dedingiz?
en: “They only hinted at it, just barely tossing a thread out to start a deal, and I am supposed to say ‘no’ suddenly like a chip falling from the roof?” “Then what did you say?” “They well know that I don’t need that man as a relative.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ishqilib mingboshi bilan quda bo‘ladigan joyim yo‘qligini yaxshi bilishdi... Yana nima kerak?
en: What else is needed?” The conversation stopped there.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Suhbat tamom bo‘lib, kampir tashqariga chiqqanida Zebi holsiz va darmonsiz darparda yoniga cho‘zilgan, uning hali juda yosh va jonli ko‘zlarida ko‘p yillik mehnat va qiynalishlarning og‘ir bir horg‘inligi ko‘rinardi.
en: When the old woman exited the room, she found Zebi lying by the door like an invalid. Her young and lively eyes reflected years of labor and suffering.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Razzoq so‘fining behuda taqvodorlikka suyangan so‘zlari va Qurvonbibining qayta-qayta ishontirishlari ila Zebining ko‘ngli bir qadar tinchlandi.
en: ... Razzoq-sufi’s words, full of false piety though they were, and Qurvonbibi’s attempts to regain her trust, managed to calm Zebi a little.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hovuz bo‘yida, yosh tollarning ko‘m-ko‘k bargchalari ostida, hali ham allaqanday belgisiz bir tashvish va hadiksirash bilan sizlab yotgan ko‘ksini yumshoq shabadaga berib, kashtasini tikarkan, uning g‘amli ovozi g‘amli kuylarni shabadaga qo‘shib, olislarga uzatardi.
en: She sat under the green leaves of the young willows by the pool with her embroidery, and a light breeze fanned her chest, which was filled with some indeterminate anxiety. As she sang, her somber song joined the unhappy melodies of the wind and rode beyond the walls of their home.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Arava bi-lan u yoqbu  yoqqa qatnaydigan O‘lmasjon o‘sha kundan beri yo‘lni bu tarafga solganligidan bu g‘amli ovoz uning qulog‘iga ham ba’zi-ba’zida kirib qolardi.
en: Her despondent voice often reached the ear of O’lmasjon, who had made it a habit to come by since the day of their return.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh yigit otining qorinbog‘isini mahkamroq bog‘lash ba-honasi ila aravani devor yoniga to‘xtatar, qo‘li ot tegrasida aylangan holda butun vujudi devor oshib o‘tayotgan qadrdon va yoqimli unni ovlashga tirishardi.
en: Pretending he needed to adjust the saddle, he would stop his cart near the wall of her house and try with all his might to follow that pleasant and dear sound. On one occasion, he put his whip on his belt and climbed on the cart as if to
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir kun qamchisi belida bo‘lgani holda, devor osha qo‘ringan toldan xipchin sindirmoqchi bo‘lib, arava ustiga chiqdi, unda ham bo‘yi yetmagach, tinch turmagan kegaylarga oyoq qo‘yib, g‘ildirakka tirmashdi...
en: break off a branch that hung over the wall. Even then he wasn’t tall enough, so he climbed still higher onto the wheel.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir qo‘li bilan devorga osilib, yana bir qo‘lini tolga uzatgan vaqtida ko‘z uchi Zebiga tushdi: bu vaqtda sayrashdan to‘xtagan u tutqun qushcha butun mehrini kashtaning ilang-bilang kunguralariga qo‘ygan edi.
en: With one hand, he grabbed the top of the wall, and while stretching the other out to the willow, Zebi caught his eye: the caged bird had stopped singing and put all her love into the stitches of her embroidery.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘tgan-ketganlar gumonsiramasin, deb, yigitcha, ko‘z uchi hamon hovuz bo‘yida bo‘lgani holda, bir qo‘li bilan kichkina bir tol novdasini sindirishga urinardi.
en: So that passersby didn’t take notice, O’lmasjon tried to break off the branch of the tree, all the while keeping his eyes on Zebi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nihoyat, kichkina novda qirs etib singach, Zebi ham boshini ko‘tarib qaradi, devorda erkak kishining qo‘lini ko‘rganidan keyin:
en: Finally, the branch gave way. Zebi lifted her head to see a man’s hand hanging over the wall.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Voy, o‘la qolay!
en: “Voy, God take me now!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Erkak kishi!
en: A man!” she cried.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb qichqirdi... Va ov yegan qushday, kashtasini tashlab, ichkari tomonga qochdi.
en: Like a trapped bird, she threw down her embroidery and ran inside the house.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu xil natijani sira kutmagan yosh yigit, gavroni qo‘lida, hayron bo‘lib qoldi.
en: The young man, who didn’t expect anything of the like, was astonished.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat o‘sha topda ko‘chadan o‘tayotgan bir taqvodorning:
en: Just then a cry came from one of the faithful on the street.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hoy, bola, tush bu yoqqa! — degan sovuq ovozi uni sarosimalikdan uyg‘otib yubordi...
en: “Hey, son, get down from there!” said a cold voice that woke him from his daze.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: G‘ildirak ustidan o‘zini aravaga tashlagan vaqtida taqvodor yo‘lovchi hali ham so‘ylanmoqda edi: — Qanday behayo bolasan!
en: As soon as he had jumped down from the wheel of the cart, the person approached him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kap-katta to‘ng‘izday bo‘lib qolibsanu, sharmu hayo qilmasdan, nomahram bor hovliga qaraysan-a!
en: “What a shameless child you are! You should know better, big as you are.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi ko‘rgunday bo‘lsa, «go‘sht ketti!» qiladi. Ha!!!
en: Shamelessly looking into a home with nomahram women!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh yigit ikki beti qip-qizargan holda eshitilar-eshitilmas bir ovoz bilan zo‘rg‘a-zo‘rg‘a: — Otimga gavron sindiray, degan edim-da...
en: If that Razzoq-sufi saw you, he would rip you to pieces!” The young man, both his cheeks red, said with a voice barely audible, “I wanted to break off a whip for my horse.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deya oldi. So‘ngra noumid qarash bilan yana bir marta devor tomonga ko‘z yugurtirgach, arava ustidan otga hatlab, yo‘liga ketdi.
en: …” He ran his eyes over the wall again with a look of hopelessness before saddling his horse and setting off.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘nggi xabar bilan yuragi siqilganini bahona qilib, bir kun Zebi ham Saltanatxonlarnikiga yo‘l oldi.
en: Saying that she could no longer stand the four walls around her, Zebi one day left to see Saltanat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi oldida o‘zini aybdor sanagan va shuning uchun ko‘nglidan xijolat tortgan Saltanat o‘rtog‘ini ortiq darajada zo‘r hurmat bilan qarshi oldi.
en: Saltanat, feeling embarrassed and guilty before Zebi, accepted her friend with the utmost ceremony.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning o‘z o‘rtog‘iga qilgan muomilalarida hatto «pistoqi ta’-zim» qabilidan bir turli yasamalik asarlari ham ko‘rilardi.
en: In her overly courteous behavior , something affected and feigned was detectable.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qishloqdagi voqealarning tagidan bexabar bo‘lgan Zebi Saltanatning bu qadar mehribonlashganini o‘z ko‘nglida boshqa narsaga yo‘yar va... chin ko‘ngildan xursand bo‘lardi.
en: Still unaware of how much Saltanat knew about the events in the village, Zebi interpreted Saltanat’s unprecedented kindness as something else. And was only overjoyed by it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nima uchun xursand bo‘lardi bu yosh qiz?
en: Why was our Zebi so happy?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U bilardikim, O‘lmasjon Saltanatlar oilasining yon qo‘shnisigina emas, balki ona tomonidan bir qadar qarindoshi va bu xonadonning eng qadrdon bolasi.
en: She knew that O’lmasjon wasn’t just a neighbor of Saltanat, but also a relative of Saltanat’s mother and one of the favorites of their household.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra Zebilar oilasi singari bu oilada ham erkak bola yo‘q, shu uchun qo‘shni va qarindosh bo‘lgan bu bola hamma vaqt shu hovlida, u hovlidan ko‘ra ko‘proq bu hovlining dastyori va yugurdagi.
en: Like Zebi’s family, Saltanat’s didn’t have a son, and, for that reason, this boy was always in their home and was practically one of their own. The boy had now become a young man.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U bola endi kap-katta yigit bo‘lib qolgan... hozir uylantirish to‘g‘risida ayni og‘iz soladigan vaqtlari...
en: Now was precisely the time when relatives and neighbors began to talk of a wife for him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Saltanat o‘zining bu sevimli qarindoshiga bu sevimli o‘rtog‘ini olib bermoq istamaydimi?
en: Did Saltanat not wish to marry her favorite relative to her best friend?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Saltanatda bu istak bo‘lgandan keyin, uni onasi bilan katta onasi bilmay qoladimi?
en: Could Saltanat’s mother and grandmother not be aware of their daughter’s desire?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Onasi bilan katta onasi Zebini yomon ko‘radilarmi?
en: They couldn’t possibly dislike Zebi, could they?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yomon ko‘rsalar, o‘z qizlarini unga muncha jonajon o‘rtoq qildirib qo‘yarmidilar?
en: If they did, would they have let their daughter become so close with her?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi Saltanatdan ko‘rgan ixloslarni uning onasidan va katta onasidan ko‘rmaganmi?
en: Did Zebi not receive the same affection from Saltanat’s relatives that she did from her friend?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayniqsa, shu safar?
en: Particularly on this occasion?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu safar Saltanat uning tegrasida gir-gir aylangan bo‘lsa, u ikki keksa xotin o‘z yoshlariga yarasha pirpirashgan emasmi?
en: While Saltanat was constantly revolving around Zebi, serving her in every possible way, her mother and grandmother were also busily doting on their guest.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebiday bir qizning kelin bo‘lib kelishini kim istamaydi?
en: Who wouldn’t want a girl like Zebi as their daughter-in-law?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qaysi hovli Zebini o‘z quchog‘iga olishdan tortinadi?
en: What home would not welcome Zebi into its embraces?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uchta xotin ustiga mingboshi ham talab bo‘libdi-ku!..
en: After all, mingboshi wanted her in addition to his three wives!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bechora qizning butun bu shirin xayollari shu birgina «mingboshi» so‘zi kelib chiqishi bilan bir varaqasiga parishon bo‘lib sochiladi, to‘kilgan tariq kabi, har tomonga tirqirab ketadi.
en: The thought of mingboshi immediately interrupted Zebi’s string of happy fantasies. They scattered like millet spilled and spread in all directions.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Haligi shirin xayollar bilan kulib, to‘lib, cho‘g‘day qizarib turgan yuzlari, garmsel tekkan ekin kabi, bir nafasda so‘lib, o‘lib, uchug‘dek bo‘zarib qoladi...
en: Her face, which was earlier smiling and red with anticipation, now went pale, withered, and died like leaves touched by a hot wind.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har qalay, sevimli o‘rtog‘idan va uning onalaridan ko‘rgan ixlos va hurmatlari uchun haligi mulohaza orqasida Zebi xursand, uning xursandligini ko‘rib, o‘z gunohlarining kechirilganini yo bo‘lmasa, ancha yengillashganini o‘ylagan Salti va uning onalari xursand...
en: Saltanat, who must have thought that the respect she and her relatives now showed Zebi would expiate her guilt before her friend, was in seventh heaven. Engrossed in her own thoughts, she had no idea of Zebi’s torments.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkala tomon ham bir-birining ko‘nglidan bexabar, shu xilda xursandlikka ko‘mildi. Zebining bu xursandligi, albatta, kuzatgan maqsadiga erishmoq bilangina poyidor bo‘lardi.
en: Zebi’s goal in coming, to return to our story, was to see the young man who had hung over her wall and broken a branch.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U maqsad ham, dovon oshuv qadar zo‘r bo‘lmasdan, nihoyati de-vorga osilib, gavron sindirgan yigitni bir ko‘rishdan iborat edi...
en: But just try to find a merchant or a cart driver at home! It had been four months since O’lmasjon had begun his work as a cart driver.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat chorbozorchi bilan aravakashni uyida uchratmoq oson narsami?
en: In those four months, had he spent as many as four full days at home?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘lmasjonning ara-vakashlikka kirishganiga faqat to‘rt oy bo‘ldi, lekin shu to‘rt oy ichida to‘rt marta butun kechakunduzni  uyida o‘tkaza oldimi?
en: He left early in the morning, returned around midnight, and that was only if he stayed within the city! If not, he might spend two to three nights away from home.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sahar chiqib ketadi, yarim kechada kirib keladi, agar olisga ketmasa! Olisga ketsa, ikki-uch kun o‘tkazib keladi.
en: The same day that Zebi had come to Saltanat’s home, O’lmasjon’s mother in the neighboring home complained of her son’s vagrancy.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bolasining darbadarligiga achingan ona o‘sha kuni
en: “To hell with his career!” she said. “I don’t see my poor son all day!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Zebi Saltanatlarnikiga borgan kuni:
en: And what does he get for all that work?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hunar bo‘lmay o‘lsin!
en: What does he bring home?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deya so‘zlandi.
en: Not a scrap.
