en: “Why are you so tense?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Dunyo buzilibdimi?
en: What happened?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zi uchun Miryoqubdan boshqa chin ko‘ngiddan kuyadigan odam yo‘qligini mingboshi yaxshi bilardi. Shu uchun uning bu kungi harakatini sira anglayolmay qoldi.
en: Has the world ended?” Mingboshi well knew that there was no one who cared about him more sincerely than Miryoqub, so he was puzzled at this behavior.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aravasidan tushmay turib, «Xo‘jayin, sizni gazetga uribdilar!» dedi, so‘ngra o‘sha gazetni (o‘sha gazetning o‘zini) uzatdi...
en: Without even getting down from the cart, he had handed him the newspaper and said “Master, they’re slandering you!” with a smile.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu nima gap?
en: What was that?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tushimi, o‘ngimi?
en: Was he dreaming ?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo ishongan tog‘i ham ag‘darilmoqchimi?
en: Or was his most reliable of fortresses crumbling?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo Miryoqub ham boshqa yoqadan bosh ko‘tarmoqchimi?
en: Was Miryoqub plotting against him?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqubsiz uning kuni kun bo‘ladimi?
en: Could he get by without Miryoqub?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu davlatlar, obro‘lar, amallar, kattaliklar... hammasi qamishning to‘zg‘og‘iday bir nafasda to‘zib ketadimi?
en: Were all his wealth, esteem, and honor—all of it!—about to be carried away by the wind like the fuzz from a reed?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub burungi Miryoqub bo‘lsa, to mingboshi o‘zi gap ochmaguncha, bu qora xabar to‘g‘risida gap ochishga ham botinolmasligi lozim kelardi...
en: If Miryoqub was the same as he always was, then he wouldn’t have spoken of this news until mingboshi himself brought it up.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Albatta, ko‘ngillarida hech gapni saqlamaydirgan og‘zi bo‘sh odamlar bo‘ladi.
en: Of course, there are such people that cannot keep their mouths shut.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lekin unaqa odamlarning nomlari «Miryoqub», ayniqsa «Miryoqub epaqa» bo‘lmaydi.
en: But they wouldn’t have gone by the name Miryoqub and especially not Miryoqub the sly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqubning tishlari, har holda, lablaridan kuchliroq-ku!
en: Miryoqub’s teeth were stronger than his lips!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lablarini tishlari orasiga olsa, tili o‘lgur, bir oz ko‘milib turardi-ku...
en: And if he could bite his lips, then he could certainly bite his tongue.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat Miryoqub hech bir ishni bilmasdan qilmaydi!
en: But Miryoqub never did anything unintentionally!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Haligidek bema’ni vahimalardan so‘ng, nihoyat, mana shu keyingi natijaga kelganidan keyingina, mingboshi esini boshiga to‘pladi va Miryoqubning yuziga gazetni irg‘itgani uchun o‘z-o‘zidan koyidi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning tirriq ta’bi ham tezgina o‘rniga tushdi, yuzi kuldi... — Hazilingni qo‘y endi, — dedi u oddiy va hatto bir daraja muloyim ovoz bilan.
en: After calming his fears with this final conclusion, mingboshi recovered and then cursed himself for throwing the newspaper back at Miryoqub.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Menga bir maslahat top. Yetti iqlimga yomon nomim ketdi...
en: His playful nature returned, and he smiled.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub juda tinchlik bilan, kulib turib, bemalol gapirardi: — Ha, balli, mana bunday deng!
en: “Stop your joking now,” he said in an ordinary, perhaps even soft voice, “Give me some advice.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Jahl bilan, g‘azab bilan, tutoqish bilan bu to‘g‘rida hech narsa qilib bo‘lmaydi.
en: They dragged my name through the mud.” Miryoqub, still smiling, spoke calmly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu mahkamangizdagi qora fuqaro bilan bo‘ladigan ish emaski, chaqirtirib kelib, Mirzaboboga buyursangizu, yerto‘laga olib tushib, qichigan yerini qashlasa!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yozgan odam o‘sha berkitilgan maktabning domla-si... jadid!
en: “Yes, that’s what we should have done earlier.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U allaqachonlar o‘z yurtiga yetib oldi, gazet bo‘lsa, gazetchisi bilan birga Toshkentda...
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siz-bizning emas, bizdan kattaroqlarning ham bo‘yi yetmaydi. Gazet yozadiganlar, odatda, zakonchi bo‘ladi...
en: The matter can’t be discussed while angry and fuming.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ular bilan yarim poshshoga o‘xshagan ulug‘ odamlar olishmasa, uncha-muncha odamlar bekor kelmaydi. Jadidlar hammasi mahmadona keladi...
en: This is not a matter with some poor man where you can just call him before you and have Mirzabobo throw him in the dungeon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Jadiding nimasi? Nima degan gap o‘zi?
en: You can’t just scratch away this kind of itch.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Maktabini yoptirgan vaqtingizda aytib bergan edim-ku. — Esda qolgan, deysanmi?
en: The person that wrote this is the teacher at the school you closed: a jadid!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Jadid degani «yangi» degani bo‘lsa kerak. Yurt orasida yangilikni rasm qilarmishlar...
en: He’s already gone home to his town and had their newspaper people contact those in Tashkent.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yangi o‘qish, yangi maktab, yangi urf-odat, yangi kiyim, har narsa yangi...
en: Even those more powerful than us can’t deal with this by ordinary means.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Eskicha bo‘lsa, kimga zarari tegar ekan? — Unisini bilmadim...
en: And those who write in the newspapers usually know the laws and stick to them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ishqilib, jadidlarning qasdi shu emish... — Yangi mingboshi, yangi qozi ham, desang-chi!
en: Only those close to the governor general have a say.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Albatta, o‘ziga mos keladigan mingboshi bo‘lsin, deydi jadid...
en: Those jadids sure are know-it-alls.” “What’s a jadid?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Darvoqe, Shamsiddin mingboshi bilan To‘raqul bo‘lus to‘g‘risida hech narsa yozishmaydi-ku jadidlaring... Nimaga mening to‘g‘rimda yozishadi?
en: What does that mean?” “I told you when you closed the school.” “So I should remember it?” “Jadid must mean ‘new.’ They supposedly bring new things to us.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Abdusamat mingboshini osmonga ko‘tarib yozganlaridan xabaringiz yo‘qmidi?
en: A new way of reading, new schools, new customs, new dress, everything new.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, aytgancha, bulturmidi?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, bulturidi. Qanday maqtab yozishdi.
en: “Were old things bad?” “I can’t say.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: In a word, the goal of the jadids is to bring new things.” “Like a new mingboshi and new judges?” “Well of course they would like a more favorable mingboshi.” “By the way, your jadids didn’t write anything about Shamsiddin mingboshi and To’raqul, the district boss.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Jadidlaringga tushunolmay qoldim-ku! Men butun umrimda to‘rtta xotin olibman.
en: Why did they write about me?” “You haven’t heard how they praised Abdusamat mingboshi?” “Ah, you mean last year?” “Yes, last year.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning ham bittasi o‘z ajali bilan o‘lgandan keyin...
en: Oh, how they commended him.” “I just can’t understand your jadids!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Abdusamat bir o‘nta-cha xotin oldi...
en: I’ve only taken four wives in all my life.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hali ham to‘rttasi qo‘lida — naqd... Nega uni yozmadi jadiding?
en: And one of them had already died by the time I took the others.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Mening jadidim emas, xo‘jayin!
en: Abdusamat has had around ten.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunday bo‘lsa ham, mening bilishimcha, jadidlar yangilikni mayl qiladigan odamni yaxshi ko‘radilar.
en: Four of them are still alive. Why doesn’t your jadid write about him?” “He’s not my jadid, master!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, aytgancha, Abdusamat o‘z qishlog‘iga yangi tartib maktab ochgan emasmi? Durust...
en: As far as I know, jadids like those who support new things.” “Yes, you’re right.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Abdusamat mingboshi hovlisida muallim saqlab, o‘g‘illarini o‘qitadi. Jadid maktabiga pul bilan qarashadi.
en: Wasn’t it Abdusamat who opened a new school in his village?” “Abdusamat mingboshi keeps a teacher in his home to educate his boys.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Odamlarning bolalarini yubortiradi. O‘zi jadid gazeti o‘qiydi...
en: He funds a jadid school and encourages local parents to send their children.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Shuning uchun jadidlarning ko‘zi uning o‘nta xotinini ham ko‘rmaydi, degin. — Shunday, Jadidlar, yangi maktabga qarashmagan boylarni, «nodon, johil, u-bu» deb so‘kishadi.
en: He even reads the jadid newspaper.” “That’s why the jadid eye doesn’t fall on his ten wives.” “Yes, jadids curse the wealthy men who don’t take care of their schools as ‘stupid, ignorant,’ and this and that.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ularning maktabiga ozgina yordam qilgan boyni «hamiyatlik boylarimizdan falon, falon...», deb osmonlarga ko‘tarib yozishadi...
en: The rich man who gives just a little bit of help is raised to the sky as better than our esteemed wealthy men in such and such a way.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siz ham jadid maktabini yoptirmasdan, og‘iz uchida, «ha-pa» deb qo‘ysangiz, sizni ham maqtab yozishardi. Mingboshi shu yerda Miryoqubga tomon egildi va pastroq ovoz bilan dedi:
en: They would have written the same things about you if you hadn’t closed the school and just said yes to a few of their demands.” Mingboshi leaned over to Miryoqub and whispered, “Noyib to’ra wouldn’t allow it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Noyib to‘ra qo‘ymadi-da, qandoq qilay. — Noyib to‘ra ham ayyor odam.
en: What was I supposed to do?” “Noyib to’ra is a tricky one.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zi buyruq berib yoptirsa bo‘lardi, unday qilmadi. O‘zi bir chekkada turib, siz orqali qildirdi...
en: He could have ordered it closed himself, but he didn’t.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tayoq endi kelib, sizning boshingizda sindi!
en: He had you do it so you would take the blame.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yo‘q, shoshma, men noyib to‘raning yonlariga boraman, «Ilojini qiling, o‘zingiz aytgansiz», deyman. Qani, yo‘q desin-chi!
en: Now the stick has come and broken over your head!” “No, wait, I’ll go to noyib to’ra and tell him to fix this.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yo‘q deyishdan qo‘rqarmidi?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘q, deydi, tonib tura beradi... — Nega, axir?
en: He told me to do it, after all.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nega? — Bugun tonadigan bo‘lmasa, o‘sha vaqtda o‘zi o‘z buyrug‘i bilan yoptirmasmidi?
en: How can he say no?!” “Do you think he’s afraid to say no?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Tonganiga qo‘yamanmi? — Nima qilardingiz?
en: He’ll say no and give you nothing.”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Urarmidingiz?
en: “Why?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Urib bo‘ladimi? — Nima qilardingiz?
en: I did what he asked.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi jim bo‘ldi. Bir qo‘lini chakkasiga olib borib, boshini
en: Why?” “Because otherwise he would have closed the school himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: qashladi... Ikkalasi ham bir oz jim qolgach, yana mingboshi gap boshladi:
en: He won’t give you a thing.” “And you think I’ll let him say no?” Mingboshi said with a smirk.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bir maslahatini topmasak bo‘lmaydi. Men bu ishni shunday qoldirib ketolmayman...
en: Miryoqub answered mingboshi’s smirk with a quip of his own: “What will you do?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shamsiddin, To‘raqul, Abdusamatlar qo‘sh karnay bilan jar solishadi... Bilasanmi?
en: Hit him?” “Can you hit such a man?” Mingboshi clearly hadn’t thought through his suggestion.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bu gapingiz rost, xo‘jayin. Ularnikida kechadan beri to‘y!
en: “Then why ask?” Mingboshi was silent.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘sha maktabdor domlani toptirib kelib, Mirzaboboga topshirsamu, yerto‘lada bir burov solsa, deb edim.
en: He put his hand to his temple and began to scratch. The two were silent for some time until mingboshi spoke again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunda, ehtimol, ko‘nglim bir oz o‘rniga tusharmidi...
en: “We have to think of something. I can’t just let this go unpunished.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Boya aytdim-ku, endi uning arvohini ham topolmaysiz.
en: … Shamsiddin, To’raqul, Abdusamat. They trumpet their accomplishments.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nima qilamiz bo‘lmasa? Miryoqub javob bermadi.
en: … What do you think?” “You’re right, master.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U aytmoqchi bo‘lgan so‘zini fikr tarozisiga solib o‘lchamoqda edi. Nihoyat, mingboshi tomonidan haligi savol yana qaytarilgandan ke-yin:
en: They’ve been celebrating too long!” “If I could just have Mirzabobo bring that teacher here, shackle him up in our dungeon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nima qilardingiz, tishni-tishga qo‘yasiz, xo‘jayin! — dedi.
en: Maybe then my heart would have some peace.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi irg‘ib o‘rnidan turdi. — Tishimni-tishimga qo‘yadigan hezlardan bo‘lsam, ma, ol, bu shopshaloplarni !
en: …” “I told you already, you won’t even find his ghost around here.” “Then what can we do?” Miryoqub didn’t answer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi u baland ovoz bilan.
en: He was weighing their options.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Menga pasport olib ber, Makkatulloga jo‘nayin!
en: After mingboshi repeated the question he spoke.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘tiring, xo‘jayin!
en: “What can you do, master?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi Miryoqub, uning ovozi ham bir oz ko‘tarila tushgan edi.
en: You’ll just have to grind your teeth and endure.” Mingboshi shot up from his place.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘shqirish bilan, zarda bilan bitadigan ish emas bu. O‘ylaylik, bir chora topaylik!
en: “You think I’m so impotent to just endure it, just take their blows?!” he said, raising his voice.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra o‘rnidan turib, ayvonga bordi; u yerda choynak bilan piyola turgan edi, sovuq choyni piyolaga to‘ldirib quygach, bir shimirishda tamom qildi.
en: “Get me my passport, I’ll just go to Mecca!” “Sit down, master!” said Miryoqub, having raised his voice some as well.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra orqasiga qaytarkan, odatdagidan qattiqroq va tezroq so‘zlandi:
en: “This isn’t something to be done with bile and screaming.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Gazetni shaharda ko‘rdim.
en: Let’s think.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan beri tadbir axtaraman. Hech bir tadbir topolmaganim uchun nochor-noiloj kulgiga zo‘r bergan edim.
en: We’ll find something.” Miryoqub got up and went to the porch; a teapot stood there, and, after pouring cold tea into a cup, he drank it in one gulp.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Katta ariqdan xatlayolmagan vaqtingizda kulgingiz keladi... Bilasiz-mi?
en: He returned to his place and began speaking quicker and more assuredly than usual.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bilaman. — Yiqilgan polvon ham achchig‘ini kulib yengadi, — dedi yana Miryoqub.
en: “I saw the newspaper in the city and started thinking there.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi bir oz jim qolgach: — Ishqilib, bir chora topmasang bo‘lmaydi, — dedi.
en: I haven’t been able to find an answer, so I’ve been laughing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat bu keyingi jumla quturgan darrandaning emas, suvga pishilgan mushukning og‘zidan
en: It’s better to laugh than cry when you can’t cross a wide canal, you know?” “I know.”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: chiqmoqda edi„. O‘yga botgan Miryoqub boshini ko‘tardi:
en: “The hero who fails overcomes grief with laughter,” added Miryoqub.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘zimizning gazetga kelishtirib bitta javob yozamiz.
en: Mingboshi was quiet for a moment.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Jadid gazetda sizni so‘kkan bo‘lsalar, o‘z gazetamizda biz maqtaymiz, muallimni yomonlaymiz. Shu bilan tarozining biz tomon pallasi bosib tushadi.
en: “Whatever, we still have to do something.” This last sentence no longer sounded like the roar of an enraged beast, but rather the complaint of a cat doused in water.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Abdusamatlarning karnayi bolalar chaladigan qamish nayga aylanib qoladi. Shu bas!
en: Miryoqub, still thinking, raised his head.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, mayli! — Durustmi?
en: “We’ll write a response in our newspaper.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb yana qaytarib so‘radi Miryoqub. — Durust!
en: If the jadid mocked you in his newspaper, then we’ll praise you and revile him in ours.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi mingboshi. — O‘zing yozasanmi?
en: The scales will tip back in our favor.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bilib gapirasizmi, xo‘jayin? Men gazetning o‘zini tuzuk-quruq o‘qiyolmayman-ku, unga xat yozish qayoqda!
en: Those trumpets that they’re playing for Abdusamat and the others will be nothing but reeds.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Muni o‘z ahli, o‘z ustasi yozadi. Shaharga tushganimda, to‘g‘rilab chiqaman.
en: That will be enough!” “Yes, great!” “You’re agreed?” Miryoqub made sure.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bo‘pti, — dedi mingboshi.
en: “Agreed!” said mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “You’ll write it yourself?” “Do you think about what you’re saying, master?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ishqilib, o‘zing epla.
en: I can barely read the newspaper.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra o‘rnidan turib, Miryoqubga yaqin keldi va uning qulog‘iga egilib:
en: How would I write something? We’ll find a writer, a man of the pen.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: I’ll do it when I go to the city.” “Fine,” said mingboshi, “just take care of it.” Then he got up from his seat and went over to Miryoqub, leaned down, and spoke directly into his ear.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Pul kerak bo‘lsa, ayama lekin! — dedi.
en: “If money is needed, don’t worry.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Pul degan narsa topilib ketadi, obro‘ topilmaydi, obro‘!
en: Money we have. Respect is another thing, respect!” ...
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Oradan ikki hafta o‘tgandan keyin Miryoqub sart tilida chiqadigan hukumat gazetasining bir nusxasini keltirib, indamasdan mingboshining quchog‘iga tashladi.
en: Two weeks after that conversation Miryoqub brought the government-run sart-language newspaper to mingboshi and silently handed it to his master.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U nusxada quyidagi maktub bosilib chiqqan edi: «Hurmatli gazet muallifi to‘raga salomdan so‘ng andog‘ arz qilinurkim, jadid nom toifaning shaharlarda chiqarilaturg‘on gazetida Akbarali mingboshi xususida noloyiq iboratlar bilan ta’rif qilingan bir noma chop qilindi.
en: The following letter was printed in it: After the delivery of warm greetings to the respected nobleman editor of the newspaper, I have the honor to announce that in the newspaper of the jadid class, a letter was printed in which undignified addresses were directed towards Akbarali mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu xususda haqiqat yuzasidan izoh qilib ayturmizkim, Akbarali mingboshi qariyb o‘n to‘rt yildan buyon oq podshohimizning azamat davlatlariga sadoqat bilan xizmat qilib, shuncha zamon mobaynida hech qanday sarzanishga mustahiq bo‘lmadilar.
en: In answer to this impertinence it is incumbent upon us to comment with regard to the truth. For nearly fourteen years, Akbarali mingboshi has served His Highness the White
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Tsar loyally and has never in that time been deemed deserving of reprimand .
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shahar va uezd hokimi to‘ralar va fuqaro va boyonlar va ahli ilm toliblar va hokazo hech kimsa mazkur mingboshidan jiddiy norozi bo‘lganlari yo‘qdur.
en: The governing nobles of the city and uezd, the rich and the poor, the most esteemed and educated and so on have never expressed dissatisfaction with the aforementioned mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Va balki hamisha uning haqida xayri duodadirlar.
en: To the contrary, he has been a constant presence in their prayers and well wishes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ul beodob maktabdor bo‘lsa, hamma fuqaroning nazarida past va haqir ko‘rilgan edi.
en: As concerns the uncouth schoolteacher, he appeared only petty and miserable to our citizenry.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zi namoz o‘qimasdan va maktabda go‘dak bolalarga yer mudavvardur, ya’ni misli tarvuz
en: He, no doubt, is impious and ignorant of his duties as a Muslim.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: yumaloqdur, deb shariatga xilof ilmlarini ta’lim bergani vajhidan fuqaro bezovta bo‘lib, har xil qiliqlar paydo bo‘lib, yurtning osoyishiga xalal kelganidan mazkur maktabdorning maktabini janobi Akbarali mingboshi berkitib erdilar.
en: He told the students of his school such things contrary to the teachings of Islam. For example, that the earth is round, that is to say like a watermelon, as a result of which the citizenry became upset and caused disturbances.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu vajhidan tamom fuqaro va alalxusus boyonlar, tolibi ilm mullabachchalar, mudar-rislar, imomlar, shayxlar va zokirlar, so‘filar bag‘oyat mamnun bo‘lib, ul shahanshohi jahon oq podshohimizning va ham ul ulug‘ martabalik yarim podshoh janoblarining hakdariga duo aylab, shunday odil va insoflik fuqaroparvar amaldorlarni qo‘yganlari uchun ularga minnatdorlik izhor qiladurlar, vallohi a’lam bissavob, tammattammat  tomon yozguvchi kamina xolis fuqarodin mulla Rivojiddin a’lami mulk badiy».
en: The esteemed Akbarali mingboshi, in the interests of the protection of our land’s general peace, closed said teacher’s school. Rich and poor, teachers and students, imams, eshons, and murids are grateful for his conscientiousness and foresight and direct their prayers for His Highness the White Tsar and his representative, the governor-general because they have appointed as their servitors in our land such lovers of justice and truth, such protectors of order.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Buni o‘qitdirib eshitgandan keyin mingboshi juda xursand bo‘ldi. Endi to‘y bu tomonda boshlandi.
en: God’s most humble servant mullah Rivojiddin, God save him from slander, had the honor to write of this righteous man.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi buning karnayi dunyoni buzajak, narigilarniki bo‘g‘ulajak edi.
en: After the letter was read to him, mingboshi was beyond glad.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi yetti kishvar, yetti iqlimda Akbarali mingboshining qanday yaxshi amaldor bo‘lganini bilajaklardi.
en: Now the celebration had come to his street. His trumpets would bring down the sky and drown out all others.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Oq podshoh bo‘lsinu, yetmish ikki toifaning tilini biladigan tilmochlari bo‘lmasin!
en: Now all the world across its seven continents would know what an excellent official he was.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U tilmochlar tomonidan tarjima qilinib berilgandan keyin, bu maktubni oq podshoh albatta, o‘qitib eshitajak... balki o‘zi o‘qiyajak... balki o‘zi gazetning tiliga tushunsa... qo‘l ostida shuncha toifa yashaydigan bir podshoh o‘z fuqarolarining tilini bilsa ajabmi?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mulla Rivojiddin o‘zi ajab bir xushtahrir odam! Yozishini ko‘ring: suvday ravon!
en: The White tsar must have translators for all the seventy-two languages in the empire.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hamma uqadi, hamma anglaydi! Oq podshoh nega anglamasin?
en: After it is translated, the White tsar will hear the letter himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan keyin Peterburgdan Toshkentga — yarim podshohga telegramma kelsa: «Mening shunday yaxshi amaldorim bor ekan, qadriga yetib, hol-ahvolidan xabardor bo‘lib turibsanmi?» Ana, shundan keyin, Toshkentdan chopib keladigan katta to‘ralarni ayting!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U vaqtda shahardagi hokim va pristup to‘ralar Akbarali mingboshiga «chas» («chest») beradigan bo‘ladi!
en: Maybe he will even read it himself. Maybe he won’t need a translation and read it in the original.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unda narigilar mingboshi emas, kech kuzdagi chivindan ham battar bo‘lib qolishadi!..
en: After all, would it be unexpected for the tsar to know all the languages of the people he ruled?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu safar gazetni bag‘riga bosib, shu xil shirin xayollarga botgan mingboshi irg‘ib turib, qarshisida o‘tirgan Miryoqubni quchoqlash va butun davlatini unga tutib yuborishdan o‘zini zo‘rg‘a to‘xtatib qoldi.
en: Mullah Rivojiddin was such an excellent writer! Just look at how he writes: clear like water, whoever reads it will understand and be enchanted!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bunday odamga qancha qilsa va qancha bersa oz.
en: Why won’t the White tsar understand ?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Soon a letter will come from Petersburg to Tashkent, to the viceroy: “They say I have an unsurpassed official there, follow his example, serve me like he does.” And then, oh and then, you’ll look and the nobles will come to him from Tashkent!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunday bir xursandlik ichida suzgan mingboshiga Miryoqubning yana boshqa arzlari bor edikim, ular ham ahamiyat jihatidan gazetdagi maktubdan sira qolishmasidi.
en: The city governor and his chief of police will honor him! Then his enemies will seem no more important than a buzzing mosquito.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xo‘jayin, ko‘nglingiz o‘rniga tushdi, shekilli?
en: This time he held the newspaper to his breast.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi u bir turli g‘urur bilan, lekin bu so‘zlar ortiqcha «moylanish» va xushomaddan yiroq edi.
en: He wanted to leap up, his head swirling in these fantasies, and embrace Miryoqub, who was seated across from him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi boyagi kayfni to‘la aks ettirib, javob qildi: — Nimasini aytasan!
en: He wanted to share with him all his wealth, but stopped himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bo‘lmasa, naryog‘ini eshiting. — Naryog‘ini?
en: However much you give such a man, it is too little.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Miryoqub had new business for his master, but mingboshi, who was swimming in joyous thoughts, couldn’t have devoted anything to matters other than the newspaper.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “Master, it looks like you are satisfied, correct?” asked Miryoqub with a little pride, though his words were devoid of any greasy, sly obsequiousness.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshining ko‘ngliga darhol iztirob tushib ulgurgan edi.
en: Fully expressing his joy, mingboshi nodded in agreement.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunday yaxshi bir xabardan keyinga qoldirilgan arz, albatta, xayriyatdan gapirmaydi. Agar yaxshi gap bo‘lsa, Miryoqub uni gazetdagi maktubdan burun aytmasmidi?
en: “What can I say?” “Well then listen further to what I have to tell you.” “What further?” Mingboshi immediately forgot his joy as a wave of anxiety fell over him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Xo‘jayinning besaranjom ko‘nglini tinchitay, undan keyin yotig‘i bilan bu xabarni eshitdiray», degan bo‘lsa-chi?!
en: No good message could come after this happy news. If it was something good, wouldn’t Miryoqub have told him before the letter?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘q, amali ham qursin, obro‘si ham! Mingboshilikning shop-shalopi og‘ir bo‘lmasa ham, o‘ziga yarasha og‘ir tashvishlari bor...
en: He must have thought, “I’ll calm him down first and then deliver the bad news.” No, to hell with these thoughts of honor and duty!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Katta odam bo‘lish ham qiyin!.. Mingboshining haligi so‘ng savolida butun shu iztiroblarning mazmuni bor edi.
en: The privileges that came with his title were little when compared with its difficulties.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Epaqa» laqabini tashiydigan tulki u savolning ostida yotgan behuda tash-vishlarni darhol payqadi.
en: Heavy weighs the crown! In his question, “What further?” mingboshi hinted at all the fears that ate at him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun darrov: — Bugun sizning to‘yingiz!
en: The fox named Miryoqub sensed the anxiety in those two words.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb qo‘ydi. Va so‘zida davom etdi.
en: He wasted no time.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Masala Qumariq paynovidan suv ichadiganlarning hokimga bergan arizalari xususida edi.
en: “Today you can celebrate!” he announced and then continued.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ariza berganlarning boshida kimlar turganini o‘tgan safar noyibning mingboshiga aytgan so‘zlaridan anglab olgan Miryoqub Qumariqning etaklarigacha borib kelib, hamma gapni bilganini va tegishli tadbirlarni o‘tkazib kelganini gapirdi.
en: The matter concerned the petitions from those Qumariq peasants, who complained that their lands received no water. Miryoqub told of how, after their last conversation, he had gone there, found everything out, and taken the appropriate steps.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ariza egalarining adabini berish vazifasi uning o‘z bo‘yniga yuklatilganligidan, haligi «o‘tkazilgan tadbirlar» bilan u o‘sha vazifasini ham bajarib kelgan edi.
en: The “appropriate steps,” of course, included a little education of the petitioners as well.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yaxshi.
en: “Good.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ariza berganlar Yodgor echki bilan Umarali puchuq ekan. Aniq bilibsan.
en: You said Yodgor the goat and Umarali the noseless were behind it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xo‘sh, endi, qani gapir-chi, ular xususiga nima tadbir qilding?
en: Now you’ve learned that for certain.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub kuldi: — Nima tadbir qilding, deysizmi?
en: Now tell me what you did about them.” Miryoqub smiled.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, nima tadbir qilding, deyman. Mingboshi butun diqqatini shu nuqtaga to‘plab, Miryoqubga tomon bir oz egila tushgan edi.
en: “What did I do, you ask?” “Yes, what did you do?” Mingboshi, emphasizing these last words, leaned over to Miryoqub.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub kulishida davom etib:
en: Miryoqub continued, smiling.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “I told your mirobs, ‘Give a little water now and then to the low-lying lands.’” Mingboshi raised his voice, “that was how you taught them a lesson?”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bolalarga tayinlab keldim: pastdagi yerlarga ham uncha-muncha suv berib turinglar, dedim.
en: “Would I have done that if I hadn’t already taught them a lesson?” said Miryoqub, smiling again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi yana ovozini ko‘tara tushdi: — Shu adab berganing bo‘ldimi?
en: “Then what did you do?” “Have a conscience, master!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Adab berganim bo‘lmasa, shunday qilarmidim, qalay? — deb Miryoqub yana kuldi.
en: We can afford to give Qumariq some water after your lands have been irrigated.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nechuk ya’ni? — Insof ham kerak axir, xo‘jayin!
en: There’s more than enough water.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sizning yerlaringizni sug‘orib bo‘lgandan keyin suvni yana Qumariqqa ochib qo‘ysa bo‘ladi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ancha suv ortadi.
en: No one will raise a fuss.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hech kim dod demaydi. Ayb chorakor bolalarda.
en: It was your mirobs who were guilty.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sizning obro‘yingizga tayanib, beparvolik qilganlar. — Nimaga?
en: They relied too much on your esteem and became complacent.” “Why?” “Simply because.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimaga bo‘lardi. Ular yerlarni sug‘orib bo‘lgandan keyin Qumariqqa yana qaytib suv ochmas ekanlar.
en: After they watered your lands, they didn’t turn the water toward Qumariq.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuncha suv yondagi eski ariqlarga, pastliklarga tushib, ekinsiz yerlarni ko‘llatib yotar ekan.
en: All that stored water filled the old canals and started to turn the unused lands into swamps.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Pastdagilar o‘zlaricha kelib, suvni ochgani qo‘rqishar ekan.
en: Those downstream were afraid to direct the water themselves.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mirob bo‘lsa, og‘iz ocholmaydi. — Ortiqcha suv bo‘lsa, mayli bersin, — dedi mingboshi.
en: And your mirobs did nothing.” “If there’s too much water, then fine, let them have it,” said mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hech narsa demayman.
en: “I won’t say anything.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lekin haligi ikkovining adabini berish kerak edi.
en: But those two still need to be taught a lesson.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nimaga mening ustimdan ariza tashlaydi? — Adabini berish kerak bo‘lsa, tutib olib uramizmi?
en: Why did they complain about me?” “If there’s a lesson to be taught, will we lock them up and beat them?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo ko‘pchilik oldida xo‘rlab so‘kamizmi? Yo bo‘lmasa...
en: Or should we just scold them in front of everyone?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi Miryokubning og‘zidan so‘zini uzib oldi:
en: Or …” Mingboshi cut Miryoqub off.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Har nima qilamiz! — deb baqirdi.
en: “Well, do something!” he screamed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra ovozini pasaytira tushib ilova qildi: — Men ikkalasini chaqirtirib olib, Mirzaboboga berishdan ham toy-mayman! — Bir marta hokimga ariza bergan odamlarni urib bo‘lmaydi.
en: He lowered his voice and added, no less angrily, “At least bring them here and give them to Mirzabobo!” “We can’t just beat them for submitting one complaint.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Keyin ular hokimga yana qayta arz qilsalar, yo bo‘lmasa, hokimning ustidan arz qilsalar, yomon bo‘ladi.
en: If they complain to the governor again or, if not that, if they go higher up, it will be bad.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Advokatlarning arizasini bilasiz-ku! Mingboshi indayolmay qoldi.
en: You know how lawyers are!” Mingboshi had no response.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nafasi ichida edi.
en: He couldn’t breathe.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat o‘z fuqarolaridan ikkita boyga kuchi yetmaganiga hech chidayolmasdi.
en: He couldn’t fathom how these two landowners, who were his subordinates, could just be let off.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘g‘on oyoqlaridagi zo‘r-zo‘r kavishlari bilan bezovta bo‘lib yer depsinardi.
en: He started to kick the ground with his fat legs in their huge shoes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Miryoqub again set about calming mingboshi, going over to his side with that smile that was all too familiar and, with a voice which even the worst of enemies would trust, said, “The farmers themselves will give them their lesson!” Seeing that he had mingboshi’s interest, he shared with him what he had been up to in Qumariq.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub bu holni ko‘rganidan keyin uni tinchitmoqchi bo‘ldi, mingboshiga juda tanish bo‘lgan kulimsirash bilan uning yoniga o‘tdi va dushman eshitsa ishona-digan bir ovoz bilan: — Ularning adabini dehqonlarning o‘zlari berishadi!
en: He told him that he met with three broad-shouldered young men from among the poor farmers who were suffering and told them that mingboshi had nothing to do with their dry lands, that Yodgor and Umarali were the guilty ones.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi. So‘ngra mingboshining hayron bo‘lib o‘ziga tikilganini ko‘rgach, Qumariqda ko‘rib kelgan dasisalarni so‘zlab berdi.
en: When the young men asked how those two were guilty, he led them to a place called Sadaqayrag’och and showed them the vegetation there.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning so‘zidan anglashilardikim, Qumariqqa borgan vaqtida u yerga suv yetmay alamzada bo‘lib yurgan oz yerli kambag‘allardan bilagi yo‘g‘on uch yigitni chaqirib, ularning yerlariga suv tegmaslikda mingboshining hech bir aybi yo‘qligini, hamma ayb Yodgor echki bilan Umarali puchuqda ekanini so‘zlagan.
en: Sadaqayrag’och truthfully was one of mingboshi’s lands, but because it was well shaded, the cotton there hadn’t grown much nor had it sprouted seeds. All around it were Umarali’s and Yodgor’s lands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yigitlar buning sababini so‘ragan vaqtida Miryoqub ularni Sadaqayrag‘och degan joyga olib borib, ekinlarni ko‘rsatgan.
en: Because their lands had drunk up the water directed to that small plot of mingboshi’s, their crops appeared far better than his.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Chinakam o‘sha joyda mingboshining bir shapaloqqina yeri bo‘lib, soya joyda qolib ketganligidan, g‘o‘zalari uncha o‘smagan, ko‘p chigitlari chiqmay qolgan ekan. U yerning yonveridagi ko‘p yerlar Umaraliboy bilan Yodgorxo‘jaga qarar ekan.
en: He showed them the two landowners’ crops and said, “Now look, whose land is getting the most water?” The young men clenched their fists and raised them menacingly in the direction of those lands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ularning yerlari mingboshining paynovidan suvni juda bemalol ichganlari uchun ekinning ko‘rinishi nisbatan yaxshi bo‘lgan.
en: Later Miryoqub invited the men to a sit-down, having told them that he had a secret to share with them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ana o‘sha ekinlarni yigitlarga ko‘rsatib turib, «Mana, ko‘ring endi, kimning yeri ko‘p ichar ekan suvni!» degan.
en: Their lips quivering and hearts fluttering in this clandestine atmosphere, Miryoqub made them promise not to share his words with anyone.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundayoq yigitlar mushtlarini tugimlab, boylarning yerlari tomonga o‘qtalganlar, «hap siznimi!..» deganlar.
en: He then told them of the complaint that Umarali and Yodgor had submitted against mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan keyin, Miryoqub yigitlarni o‘tirishga da’vat qilib, ularga bir yashirin gap aytmoqchi bo‘lganini so‘zlagan.
en: According to Miryoqub, they wrote that mingboshi had refused water only to them. Their lands suffered, while others’ flourished.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ular yuraklariga talvasa tushib va lablari qaltirab, uning og‘ziga tikilgach, sirni hech kimga aytmasliklari to‘g‘risida ulardan qattiq va’da olgan; undan keyin Umaraliboy bilan Yodgorxo‘ja tomonidan hokimga berilgan arizadan gap ochgan.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqubning gapidan yigitlar anglaganlarkim, Umaraliboy bilan Yodgorxo‘ja yaqinda hokim to‘raga ariza berganlar va u arizada o‘z yerlarini necha yildan beri suvsiz qolayotganini, Qumariqdagi suvning faqat mingboshiga qarashli yerlar bilan boshqa ba’zi birovlarning yerlarini sug‘organini, bularning yerlariga hech bir suv oshmaganini yozganlar...
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu gapni eshitgandan so‘ng yigitlarning biri irg‘ib o‘rnidan turgan va mushtini tugimlagani holda «O‘zim tutib olib uraman, zang‘arlarni!»... deya o‘shqirgan... So‘ngra Miryoqub turib, bunday degan: «Mingboshi dodho bo‘shagan suvning siz tomonga oqishiga qarshi emas.
en: When the young men heard this, one of them shot up from his seat, raising his fists, and shouted, “I’ll find them and kill them, those greedy bastards !” To win them over once and for all, Miryoqub stood up with the young man and announced, “mingboshi is not opposed to sending his extra water to your lands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lekin o‘sha ikkoviga o‘chakishib, pastga suv bergisi kelmaydi, «O‘shalarning yeri ichadigan bo‘lsa, hammaniki qurib ketgani yaxshi», deydi.
en: He just doesn’t want his water to go to those two. He told me it would be better for everyone’s lands to dry up than give any more to them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Baribir, pastga suv berganimiz bilan sizga suv tegmaydi, hamma suvni ular ikkisi to‘sib oladi!» Bu so‘z yigitlarning
en: It doesn’t matter, though, because any water that we send down doesn’t make it to your lands, those two take it all!” These last words were salt in the wounds.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: yaralariga tuz-qalampir bo‘lib tushgan; ular uchalasi bir og‘izdan «Mingboshi dodho suvni pastga o‘tkaza bersin, ular bilan o‘zimiz gaplashamiz!» deganlar.
en: The three men said almost in one voice, “Have mingboshi give the water and we’ll deal with them!” Miryoqub called mingboshi’s mirobs before the three and ordered them to release the water.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub ularning o‘z oldilarida mingboshining chorikorlarini chaqirib, bo‘shalgan suvni pastga o‘tkazmoqqa buyruq bergan.
en: Mingboshi listened to Miryoqub’s recounting of his ruse with all the delight of a child listening to a fairy tale.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi Miryoqubning bu arzini, ertak tinglagan yosh boladay, buyuk bir zavq va nash’a bilan tinglamoqda va erta-indin ikkala boyning boshiga tushadigan hangomalarni ko‘z oldiga keltirmoqda edi.
en: He imagined the misfortunes that were about to fall on the heads of those two landowners in the coming days. He now thought that, like a child who has outgrown its clothes, Miryoqub’s moniker “sly” no longer fit him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning fikricha, o‘sgan bolaga eski kiyimi tor kelganday, Miryoqubga ham endi «epaqa» laqabi kamlik qilardi.
en: He would have to find him a new one. One thought up by villagers just wouldn’t suit him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unga boshqa bir munosib laqab topish lozim kelardikim, unday laqabni endi bu qishloq odamlari topolmasdilar, buning uchun Amir Navoiy yoki Mavlono Jomiy, yo bo‘lmasa, Shomashrabning tirilib kelishi darkor edi.
en: It would have to be something like Emir Navoiy or Mavlono Jomiy, or at least Shah Mashrab. Mingboshi lost himself in sweet thoughts about the intrigues planned in Qumariq and the master of intrigues, Miryoqub.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi Qumariqda chovrilgan u g‘alati nayranglar va u nayranglarning ustasi to‘g‘risida shunday shirin o‘ylarga ketgan, Miryoqub esa mingboshining xur-sandlik va kayf bilan mast bo‘lgan yuzlariga tikilgan bir paytda ichkaridan bir tovoq to‘la manti chiqib, dasturxonning o‘rtasidan joy oldi.
en: As Miryoqub stared at mingboshi’s face, which was intoxicated with an unprecedented pleasure, a plate full of dumplings emerged from the ichkari and was placed in the middle of the table.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub bu dargohda tez-tez ko‘rinib turadigan bu serqatiq, semiz va yog‘liq mantilarga qadrdon do‘stini qo‘rganday shirin bir kayf bilan tikildi, so‘ngra ko‘zlarini tovoqdan qo‘tarib, mingboshining yuzlariga qaragach, shu topda tovoqdagi manti bilan tovoqqa tomon egilgan yuz o‘rtasida hech qanday farq ko‘rmadi: ikkalasi ham shu qadar yog‘liq edi!
en: Miryoqub’s eyes moved over to the fat, oily, yogurt-laden dumplings, and then slowly back to mingboshi’s face, which had dropped down to the food. He suddenly noticed that there was almost no difference between the two: mingboshi’s slovenly, unkempt face was just as greasy as the dumplings.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi qo‘l yuvishni unutib, «oling-oling»ga qaramasdan, besh panjasini barobar botirib, tovoqqa hujum boshlaganini ko‘rganidan keyin, Miryoqub irg‘ib o‘rnidan turdi-da, qo‘l chayqamoq uchun ariq tomonga yugurdi.
en: Mingboshi, without a thought to washing his hands and without any offers to serve his guest, sunk both hands into the plate and began his assault. Miryoqub headed over to the canal to run some water over his hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lekin mingboshi dodhoning ajdar kepatali ishtahasini bir oz to‘xtatmoq lozim edi; shuning uchun Miryoqub uning aqlini o‘g‘irlamoq maqsadida qichiq masaladan gap ochdi:
en: To have time to eat himself, he had to slow mingboshi’s monstrous appetite; the shrewd servant stole his attention with a carefully crafted question.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — To‘yni nima qildik, xo‘jayin? — dedi u qo‘lini chayqab turib.
en: “So, master, how about that wedding of yours?” he said, shaking the water from his hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi boshini tovoqdan ko‘tarmay, og‘zida bir manti, qo‘lida ikkinchi manti bilan shoshilib javob qildi: — O‘zing bilasan!
en: Mingboshi, without lifting his head from the plate, with one dumpling in his mouth and another in his hand, hurriedly answered, “You know best!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Koyima, qizim, — dedi ona, — o‘rtog‘ingni quruq jo‘natmaysan.

uz: Zebi ko‘zlarini keng ochib qaradi: — Rost aytasizmi?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Mana, bolam, ko‘rpa qavig‘idan pul tegdi! — dedi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “Truly?” Qurvonbibi took the coins from the knot in her handkerchief and handed them to her daughter and said with all the happiness of a hunter having hit his target, “Here, my child, the money from my mats has found a use!” Zebi threw her arms around her mother’s neck; after her mother stroked her softly a few times, she nuzzled her face into Zebi’s hair.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi ikki qo‘lini onasining bo‘yniga tashladi; ona uning sochlarini ikki-uch marta yumshoqyumshoq  silagandan keyin, og‘zini u sochlarning o‘rtasiga qo‘ydi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunday qilib, ikki alamzada qo‘ngil juda qisqa bo‘lgan quvonchlarga berildilar...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Faqat bu to‘rt devor orasiga kiradigan quvonchlari o‘tkinchining nazariday bir nafasga kirib chiqadilar.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ularning kirganini zo‘rg‘a payqaganlar chiqqanini payqayolmay qoladilar.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘sha to‘rt devor ichida tug‘ilib o‘sgan, o‘sha to‘rt devorning tund nazarlaridan boshqa hech narsa ko‘rmagan va unga ko‘nikib qolgan bechoralar o‘z hollarining muncha fojialarini payqay olarmidilar?
en: Why don’t the poor women who grow up inside four walls, who don’t see anything other than the sharp looks of those permitted inside, sense the tragedy of their sheltered lives?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har qanday quvonchni o‘zlarining o‘sha tor dunyolaridan axtarmoqqa majbur bo‘lgan sho‘rliklar tashqaridan adashib kirib qolgan oriyat quvonchlariga ishonib, ko‘ngil qo‘yarmidilar?..
en: If they are so used to seeking little joys inside their four walls, can these poor things ever believe that the shameful joys which wander in from outside are part of something greater?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Odatda xufton o‘tar-o‘tmas yotog‘iga kirib, ilk sahar uyqudan uyg‘onadigan Zebi otasining kelish-kelmasini bilib, shundan keyin xotirjam uxlamoq uchun anchagacha onasi bilan gaplashib o‘tirdi.
en: Zebi usually went to sleep not long after the evening prayer and woke with the morning prayer, but that night she stayed up talking with her mother to see whether her father would return.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ular ikkalasi topgan-tutgan gaplarini bir-birlariga aytishib, uch choynak choyni tamomladilar.
en: Talking about whatever came to mind, the two went through three pots of tea.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Butun el bir uyquni urib bo‘lganda ham so‘fidan darak bo‘lmaganidan keyin ona-bola uning eshonbobo bilan birga biror joyga ketganiga hukm qildilar. Zebi ertaga o‘rtokjonini chaqirtiradigan bo‘lib, shirin xayollar bilan uyquga ketdi.
en: When the whole country had gone to sleep, there was still no word from Razzoq-sufi, so mother and daughter decided that he must have gone somewhere with his eshon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir tomondan, juda kech yotib, ikkinchi tomondan, nihoyat darajada totli tushlar bilan ko‘p rohat uxlaganligidan u ertasi kuni odatdagidan ancha kech uyg‘ondi.
en: Zebi went to her bed with the sweet dreams of her friend’s visit. She woke up much later than usual the next day because of especially satisfying dreams.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uyqudan qo‘zini ochib, tevarak-atrofga qaragach, tashqari eshikning karrakday ochilib turganiga ko‘zi tushdi.
en: When she opened her eyes, she immediately saw that the outside door was wide open.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Demak, so‘fi qaytgan edi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zining bu qadar qattiq uxlaganiga hayron bo‘ldi. Otasi odatda darvozani juda qattiq taraqlatardi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ichkaridan «labbay» deb javob berilgandan keyin to birov chiqib darvozani ochguncha, badjahl so‘fi bardosh qilolmas, qo‘lidagi tayoq bilan zo‘r berib darvozani savardi...
en: In the time between hearing someone answer his call and the door opening, the ill-tempered Razzoq-sufi often took his walking stick to the door, beating it with all his might.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Demak, butun shu taraq-turuqni eshitmagan Zebining o‘lguday qotib uxlagani ma’lum bo‘lardi.
en: Zebi must have slept like a corpse to not have heard that racket.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi Saltanatxonni chaqirish havasi yellarga uchdi...
en: Now any attempt to invite Saltanat over had gone to the winds.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi yana haftalarcha so‘fining boshi uydagi yostiqdan ko‘tarilmaydi.
en: Razzoq-sufi’s head wouldn’t rise from his pillow for another few weeks.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi yana qanchagacha yosh qizning guldek umri hovuz bo‘yida igna sanchib o‘tadi. O‘rnidan turib, bet-ko‘zini yuvdi, o‘choqqa o‘t yoqib, choydishni
en: Now the young girl, in the very bloom of her life, would spend God knows how long by the pool, needle in hand.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: qo‘ydi, so‘ngra tashqari eshikni yopib qo‘yib, sekingina uy tomonga bordi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir juft darparda yopiq bo‘lganidan uyning ichi bir oz qorong‘i edi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir ozdan so‘ng so‘fining g‘udurlagani eshitildi:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Keyincha u ham jimib ketdi. Uzoq jimlikdan so‘ng so‘fining og‘ir bir tomoq qirgani eshitildi.

en: He said with his usual authoritative voice, “Well, get to it, bring the tea!” The old woman, in a downtrodden, soft voice, answered, “Should I bring it here or will you come out?” “Who would sit in this heat!?” he screamed.

uz: — Shu yerga beraymi yo eshikka chiqasizmi? — deb so‘radi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Although Zebi believed her mother, and was relieved somewhat, her mother all the while thought, “How can I convince her of what I know to be a lie?” “That’s just how father is,” said Zebi, “if he’s in a bad mood, he always threatens to leave.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qiz bechora hali ko‘p sodda! U onasining og‘zidan nima chiqsa, darrov ishonadi!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qizning bu soddaligi qanchagacha davom etadi?

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Keyincha qizning tamom tinchlanganini ko‘rgach, Qurvonbibi ham iztiroblardan yengillanganday bo‘ldi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir kun ertalab ikkita qo‘y bilan bir arava un-guruch kelib kirgandan keyin onasining andishalik ko‘zlariga qaramasdanoq, tunov kungi ko‘z yoshlarning ma’nosiga tushundi.
en: One day after a cart delivered two sheep to their home, she, without another look at her mother’s troubled eyes, suddenly understood the meaning of Qurvonbibi’s constant tears.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh qizning ko‘ngil shishasiga bir tosh kelib tekkan kabi bo‘ldi...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nonushtadan bir oz keyin qo‘ylar kelgan bo‘lsa, tushga yetmasdanoq qassob tayyor bo‘ldi va Razzoq so‘fi etagini beliga qistirib, yenglarini shimarib tashqariga jomlarni, savatlarni tashimoqqa boshladi.
en: The sheep came just after breakfast and the butcher was ready before lunch. Razzoq-sufi, rolling up his sleeves and picking his long robe up from the ground, went out to retrieve the baskets and barrels of goods outside.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qo‘ylarning qop-qora qonlari yerlarni bo‘yamasdan turib, tashqari tomondan xursand ovozlarning:
en: The ground had not yet been covered in the blood of slaughtered sheep, when voices carried over the walls from outside.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “Congratulations on the wedding, Razzoq!” “How wonderful it will be!” “Such wealth only God can grant his humble servants!” said the well-wishers.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — To‘y qulluq bo‘lsin, so‘fi! — Juda soz bo‘libdi!
en: Now the girl began to cry with her mother.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bunday davlatni kam bandasiga beradi xudo! — degan xushomadlari ko‘tarildi.
en: As their wailing increased in strength, so did the congratulations from outside.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi onaga qo‘shilib qiz yig‘lar, qizga qo‘shilib ona yig‘lardi.
en: The whole neighborhood wished Razzoq-sufi happiness and applauded him! ...
