license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bularning yig‘ilari kuchaygan sari tashqari tomondan kelayotgan xushomadlar ham kuchayar, butun mahalla-ko‘y Razzoq so‘fining baxtini olqishlab, chapak chalardi!
en: After more extravagant wedding gifts than an average household could hope for, Qurvonbibi’s eyes ran out of tears. Zebi’s eyes, however, had still not tired.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * O‘rtaroq bir xonadonning orzu-havasli kattakon to‘yidan hashamatliroq bo‘lib o‘tgan fotiha to‘yidan keyin Qurvonbibining ko‘zlarida yig‘laydigan yosh ham qolmagan edi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining ko‘z yoshlari sira tinmadi. Bu orada Saltanatxon ikki marta kelib ketdi.
en: Saltanat had come over twice since the announcement of the wedding.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qumrixon keldi, boshqa o‘rtoqlari kelishdi, har yo‘l bilan Zebining ko‘nglini olishga, uni yupatishga urindilar.
en: Qumri and her other friends came several times and tried to comfort Zebi. To no avail!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bo‘lmadi! Ko‘z yoshlari ariqning suviday o‘zlari kelib, o‘zlari quyulardilar.
en: Tears came of their own accord, pouring out of her eyes like water flowing from a canal.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ilgariroq kunda yuz marta qizini yupatgan, uning ko‘z yoshlarini yenglari bilan artgan ona endi u yoshlarga ko‘nikib qolgan, indamasdan o‘z ishiga mashg‘ul bo‘lar, to‘y hozirliklarini ko‘rardi.
en: Her mother, who had a hundred times over dried her daughter’s tears with her sleeves, had since become accustomed to those salty drops and now silently went about her business, preparing for the wedding.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har haftada bir keladigan qo‘y, un-guruchni tashimoqdan Razzoq so‘fining qo‘llari qabardi...
en: Razzoq-sufi’s hands had blistered from carrying the flour, rice, and sheep that were delivered every week.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Toza guruchlar bilan bo‘rdoqi qo‘ylarning palovlarini yemoqdan quyuq yog‘lar me’dasiga urdi...
en: His stomach distended from daily pilaf.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yog‘liq qo‘llarini arta bermoqdan uning eski bedana mahsisi oynaday yalti-rab ketdi.
en: His boots glistened like a mirror from wiping his oily hands on them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Butun bularning orqasida ona bilan bolaning qaynoq ko‘z yoshlari quyilardi.
en: The two women shed tears only behind his back.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Butun bu noz-ne’matlar yosh qizning ko‘ngil shishasini sindirish bahosiga tushgan edi.
en: The bounty of food and gifts had, it seemed, poured out from the crack of the girl’s broken heart.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat so‘fi ko‘ngildan va uning nozik shishasidan bir narsa anglaydigan odam bo‘lmaganligidan bu kattakon ishning oqibatini xayol qilgan vaqtlarida «kelasi yilga (inshoollo!) hajga ketish nasib bo‘ladi»,
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: degan umidlar bilan xursand bo‘lardi... Birinchi marta qo‘y kelgan kundan beri butunlay esidan og‘ib qolgan Qurvonbibi fotiha to‘yidan keyin bir oz o‘ziga kelgan edi.
en: But the old man was constitutionally incapable of understanding hearts or heartbreak; the impending wedding only brought about hopes of imminent pilgrimage.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bora-bora Zebining ko‘z yoshlari ham quridi. U ham xuddi suratday jonsizgina sudralib yura boshladi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Burungiday onasining hech bir so‘zini qaytarmas, nima desa, og‘zidan chiqqan hamon bajarardi.
en: With time Zebi’s tears also dried up. She now went about her chores like before, but lifelessly, as if a shadow.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Es-hushi o‘zida bo‘lmagan bu jonsiz suratning yog‘ochday qotib qolgan qo‘llari va barmoqlari ila ro‘zg‘or ishlarini yana burungiday puxta bajarishlari — onaning qurigan ko‘zlarini ham yana yosh bilan to‘lg‘azib yuborardi.
en: As before she never disobeyed her mother, performing every command she issued, but her utter disinterest, the wooden, puppet-like hands and fingers that washed dishes and clothes filled Qurvonbibi’s eyes with tears.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining og‘zidan na bir og‘iz so‘z chiqar, na bir bayt qo‘shiq, na bir oh-voh. Bu hol onaning iztirobini besh battar oshirardi.
en: Zebi no longer spoke and, of course, didn’t sing or even hum, increasing her mother’s sorrow all the more.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Bu ketishda, qizim sho‘rlik, to‘yga yetarmikan, yo‘qmikan?» degan xayollar onaning bag‘rini tilardilar.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Her mother now thought, “Will this poor, unfortunate thing even make it to the wedding?” After Razzoq-sufi had returned home the day his eshon called him, he told his wife matter-of-factly: “I gave your daughter away to mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu orada anchagina vaqt o‘tsa ham Qurvonbibi o‘z eridan — ilgari rad qilgan mingboshiga keyincha rozilik berishining sabablarini so‘ramadi. Gapning rosti, yuragi betlab so‘rolmadi.
en: Make the preparations.” She had been in mourning ever since, but despite so much time passing she never asked her husband why he agreed to the marriage when earlier he had so adamantly refused.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “My head is spinning and I still don’t understand.” “What are you saying, Fitna?” Razzoq-sufi retorted in his usual dry and cold manner.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ha... ha... Shu yerga kelganda, Qurvonbibi bir oz dadillanib, ovozini ko‘tara tushdi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bo‘lmasa, sizning bu behuda ishingizni qildirtirmas edilar. U yoqda so‘fi achchig‘i kelib, baqirish o‘rniga, bir narsadan xursand bo‘lganday, miyig‘ida qulib turardi.
en: Otherwise you would never have done it.” Instead of becoming angry and screaming, it was as if he was glad, and a smile ran across his face.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qurvonbibi davom etdi. Uning ovozi yana ham ko‘tarila tushgan edi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Shoshmang!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Eshonbuvamga borib dod deyman!

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ori rost, bir bo‘lgan ishni endi buzdirish mumkin emasku-ya, ishqilib sizdan dod deb bir ko‘nglimni bo‘shat-masam bo‘lmaydi... — E ablah, Fitna!— dedi so‘fi kulib turib.
en: It may be too late for him to do anything, but I will make sure you never hear the end of it from him.” “Oh, you fool, Fitna!” said Razzoq-sufi laughing, “You really don’t know!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Esing yo‘qligi shu-da! Shu-da esi pastliging!

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu-da xotinliging! Qurvonbibining achchig‘i keldi:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “I’m dying from grief, and all you can do is smile and say, ‘The goat thinks of its life and the butcher—of meat.’ You think I can’t tell your eshon?!” “Go, tell him!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — «Echkiga o‘lim, qassobga yog‘!» Men o‘lolmay garangman, siz hadeb kulasiz. Ha, eshonbuvamga aytolmaymanmi?
en: Tell him!” taunted Razzoq-sufi, still laughing, “show him your stupidity so he knows too, Fitna!” “Aha!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, ayt! Ayt borib!
en: And you’re so smart!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi so‘fi yana kulib turib.
en: Just wait!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ablahligingni pirimizga ham ko‘rsat, Fitna! — Obbo, aqlli-ey!
en: Maybe you’ll start thinking once your eshon starts scolding you.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shoshmang, hali! Eshonbuvam g‘azablagandan keyin esingiz kiradi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hali yog‘liq palovlar bilan mastsiz!
en: “Enough, you fool, fine!” he shouted.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi kulishdan to‘xtab, jiddiylashdi. — Bas, deyman, ahmoq, bo‘ldi!
en: “You know nothing, yet you keep chattering away!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb qichqirdi u. — Hech narsadan xabaring yo‘q, valaqlay berasanmi? Mingboshiga bergin, deb qistab yurib, meni ko‘ndirgan eshonbuvamning o‘zlari bo‘lsa, nima deysan?
en: If you go to him, my eshon—the very one who badgered me incessantly until I agreed to give Zebi to mingboshi—what will you say?” Qurvonbibi involuntarily cried out, “Voy, take me now, God!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qurvonbibi ixtiyorsiz:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat Miryoqub «...sog‘ligiga» deganinigina anglab qoldi. So‘zning bosh qismi, g‘oliban, ichda ay-tilgan edi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sen chora nima, deb so‘raysan, — deya boyagi so‘zini davom ettirdi to‘ra. — Chorasini topishdan biz, amaldorlar, ojizmiz.
en: To’ra started to toast, but all Miryoqub heard him say was, “To the health of …,” before he swallowed the rest of the words along with the vodka.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Durust, ichimizdagi dushmanga, qora xalqqa qarshi bo‘lsa — tadbir oson. Qozoq o‘risimiz, mirshabimiz, jandarmamiz, askarimiz bor... fyusht!..

uz: Xorijdan kelayotgan yovga biz ojizmiz, nima qilishimizni bilmaymiz. Biz bilan birga bizning tomondan jang maydoniga tushgan qironlar ham bizga ishonmay boshladilar.

uz: Bu — yomon, bu juda yomon hol, Miryoqub. Kel, yana bitta ichaylik...

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Chorani aytmadingiz, to‘ra. «Chorasiz dard yo‘q», deydi bizning hakimlar...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «O‘lim bilan ishqdan boshqa hamma dardning chorasi bor» deydilar.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Safsata hammasi, safsata... Chorani bizning ichki dushmanlarimiz, ya’ni inqilobiyun degan toifa ko‘rsatadi.
en: True, if we need to repress an internal enemy or the masses, the solution is simple.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lekin o‘zicha ko‘rsatadi... — Qani, nima deydi u toifa?
en: We have our Cossacks, police, gendarmes , and soldiers.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Podshoni ham hayda, amaldorni ham hayda.
en: Just point and shoot!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mirshablarni yo‘qot, jandarmlarni o‘ldir, urushni to‘xtat, boylardan yer-suvni, fabrikachilardan fabrikalarni, zavodchilardan zavodlarni tortib olib, xalqqa ber, — deydi.
en: But when an enemy comes from the other side of the border, we have no answers, we don’t know what to do. Even our allies have stopped trusting us.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ularning «xalq» degani — qora xalq, yalang-oyoqlar...

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yurtni o‘shalar so‘rasin, deydi. Miryoqub xoxolab kuldi.
en: Come, let’s have another drink.” “You still haven’t said anything, to’ra.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Noma’qul otning tezagini yepti o‘shalar! Savodi yo‘q, omi bir yalangoyoq kelsinu so‘rasin emish...
en: We have our sayings: ‘There’s no disease without a treatment’; ‘Everything but love and death can be cured.’” “That’s all nonsense, nonsense.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Boylardan yerni tortib olib, kambag‘al ekar emish...
en: … Our internal enemies, the revolutionaries , they’ll show us the solution.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kambag‘al shuncha so‘kib urishsangiz ham yeringizga bunday bir hafsala kilib ishlamaydi-yu... xo‘jayin bo‘lmasa, ishlar emishmi?
en: But they’ll show it in their own way.” “Who are these revolutionaries?” “They’ll drive out the tsar and the nobles.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘sha urushni to‘xtatsin, degani durust...Urush chiqqandan beri yurt qimmatchilik bo‘lib ketdi. O‘ziga yarasha davlati, savdo-sotig‘i bor odamlarni jin ham urgani yo‘qqu-ya... qayta, mollarning narxi oshib, biri besh bo‘ldi.
en: Get rid of the police, kill the gendarmes, put an end to the war; they’ll take land from the rich, the factories from the managers, and give it all to the people.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ammo, shu qimmatchilik bo‘lgandan beri odamlarning ko‘ziga qarasangiz, qo‘rqib ketasiz, to‘ra.
en: By people, they mean the poor, the black masses, the penniless. Let them rule, they say.” Miryoqub laughed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Habbarakallo! Bizning hamma xavfimiz o‘sha «ko‘zlar»dan...
en: “Those people would eat horse dung, not rule!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: ko‘zlar ko‘p xunuk qaraylar. U ko‘zlarning soni-sanog‘i yo‘q.
en: They’re uneducated, and these revolutionaries say they should rule.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Germanni yengsak, ko‘zlar yuvosh-lanadi. Xudo saqlasin, agar shu xilda keta bersak

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — u ko‘zlar bizni yeb tashlashi mumkin... To‘ra jim bo‘ldi.
en: No matter how much you curse the poor, they’ll never work your land with any kind of eagerness.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub ham jim qolib, unga tikilgan edi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘ra olis xayollarga ketib turib, boshini chayqadi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra boshini og‘ir-og‘ir tebratib turib, dedi:

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xullasayn kalom, bu ulug‘ kema... bu ulug‘ kema... bu buyuk «imperiya» dahshatli to‘lqinlar ichida zulmatga, belgisizlikka, yo‘qlikka qarab ketayotir.
en: Though those who knew how to trade and were well-off to begin with haven’t had any problems. They’ve become even richer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uni to‘xtata oladigan va qutqarib qoladigan hech bir kuch ko‘rinmaydi...
en: But it’s terrifying just to look these poor in the eyes now, to’ra.” “Yes, right!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Balki, unday kuch aslida yo‘qdir o‘zi...

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bir so‘z aytdingiz, to‘ra...

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «imperi»mi, nimaydi?

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, imperiya, imperiya. — U nimasi, to‘ra?
en: If we can just beat back the Germans, then the eyes would calm down.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘ra bir oz o‘ylab turgach, podshoning devordagi suratini, so‘ngra o‘zining yelkasidagi pogonini ko‘rsatdi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Mana shu imperiya... Miryoqub hech narsa anglamadi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra to‘ra og‘ir bir nafas olgandan keyin: — Menga qara, Miryoqub, — dedi, — qo‘y endi bu gaplarni!
en: Still shaking, he said, “In short, this great ship … this great empire is stuck in a sea storm, looking on at the unknown, at oblivion .
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, qo‘ying, to‘ra, odamni xafa qiladigan gaplarni gapirmaylik. «Ertaning g‘amini eshak yeydi».

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ertaga xudo poshsho egam...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hali «Akbarali shu yerda», deding. Uylanganiga bir hafta bo‘lmay turib nega tushdi?
en: …” “You said something, to’ra: ‘Empi.’ What is that?” “Yes, empire, empire.” “What is it, to’ra?”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bironta ish bilanmi?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan keyin Miryoqub o‘zining g‘amxo‘r otaxoniga butun voqeani gapirib berdi:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Eh-he, hali shunaqa degin! — Ha, shunaqa, to‘ra.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bekorchi xarxashani

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: ko‘paytirib nima qiladi kishi? To‘ra ovozini pasaytira tushdi:

uz: — Hay-havas uchun mutloq uylanib o‘tirish shart emas.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sen o‘zimiznikisan, senga ishonib aytganda, mening bir oshnam bor: urushga ketgan ofitserning xoti-ni.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh, chiroyli narsa.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mana xo-los! Ahmoq.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Akbarali ahmoq!.. — Rost aytasiz, to‘ra, rost.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mana, men ham bittaga «qanoat» qilib o‘tayotirman-ku... hay-havaslarim qolib ketayotgani yo‘q...
en: Why make extra fuss for yourself?” To’ra lowered his voice: “There’s really no need to get married to have a little fun.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Habbarakalla, — dedi to‘ra.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xotining bitta, ayshing joyida... Keyin barmog‘i bilan «hap seni» qilib turib:

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sen, Miryoqub, yomonsan lekin...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunga ishonib, uncha-muncha erkalik qilamiz-da.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uncha-muncha...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Tog‘day-tog‘day gunohlar ham uncha-muncha bo‘lar ekan-da!

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub xoxolab kuldi:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Tog‘day-tog‘dayini endi sizdan o‘rganamiz, to‘ra, xudo xohlasa...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siz, axir, mulla odamsiz... To‘ra ham «qah-qah» solib kuldi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “You’re a dangerous one, Miryoqub.” At first Miryoqub blushed a little, but then he smiled and answered: “The rivers of Allah’s forgiveness are wide, they say, to’ra.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Believing that, we have our fun here and there, ever so rarely.” “And those mountainous sins, are they just here and there?” Miryoqub laughed.

uz: Shngra devordagi soatga qaradi: 8 dan 15 minut o‘tgan edi. O‘rnidan turdi.
en: “Those mountainous sins we’ll learn from you now, to’ra, if God wills it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sen o‘tirib tur, men kiyinib olay.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Birgalashib chiqamiz.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘ra kiyinib chiqqandan keyin Miryoqub ham o‘rnidan turdi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: If I send them all to the war to fight against the Germans, the tsar will have his victory and these villages will be rid of the misfortune of their naked, rebellious poor!” “Hear!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: And when he thought of Abdusamat mingboshi, he became animated: ‘If I could just see him, look at him, I would kiss his hands, and do whatever he asks!’” Hasanov’s opinions, particularly those about the new armed men, exacted an influence on mingboshi too.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshilikni tortib olib, el ko‘zida tamom sharmanda qiladiganday!

uz: Abdisamat bilan Yodgor echki, Umarali puchuklar yana qo‘sh karnayi bilan jar soladiganday!» — «Lekin, bachchag‘ar kofir, bir narsani bilmasdan aytmaydi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nimaga desangiz, u «zakon» kitobini ko‘p o‘qigan, hamma vaqt o‘risning ichida qaynaydi, o‘ris tilini suv qilib ichib yuborgan...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Ko‘p bo‘lsa, g‘alvasi ham ko‘proq bo‘ladi», deb o‘ylardi u. Faqat... faqat...
en: “There will be as many problems as there are men,” he thought. “But.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘nta yaxshi yigitga yaxshi ot, yaxshi sarpo, yaxshi yarog‘-aslaha berib, o‘z mahkumimni bir aylansam, iloji bo‘lsa, Abdisamat turadigan qishloqdan bir ot choptirib o‘tib qo‘ysam... bas!
en: … But …” “If I can just find ten men and with my own money give them good horses, good clothes and weapons and ride through my district, hell, even through Abdusamat’s village.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan keyin kattalar uch yigitni bittaga qoldirsalar ham mayli edi!..
en: That would be enough!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: After that, I won’t need more men!” With that he decided to start the conscription tomorrow. After three days, he had seven recruits.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: qabul qildi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Undan-bundan so‘rab, so‘ratib, iloji bo‘lmaganda... tortib olib bo‘lsa-da, hammasini yaxshi otga mindirdi, allaqaylardan ov miltiqlari topib, o‘novini yaroqlantirdi, ust-boshlarini tekisladi, o‘zi ham eng yaxshi zar choponini kiyib, tilla kamarini bog‘lab, uzun qilichini osib, saman yo‘rg‘ani minib, yo‘lga chiqdi.
en: He asked around, had others ask, and, in some cases, got physical to ensure that each of his seven had a horse, a hunting rifle, and ammunition . Then he put on his gold-brocade robe, his gold belt, hung his long sword at his side, mounted his dun mare, and set off.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: XV Ikki kun burun Qumariq qishlog‘iga yettita yigiti bilan mingboshi kelib ketgan edi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hech kimga hech narsa demasdan, to‘ppa-to‘g‘ri machitga tushib, domlani yo‘qlatdi.

uz: O‘zlari xabar topib machitga kelgan amin va ellikboshilar hayron bo‘ldilar. «Nimaga bizga hech narsa demaydi mingboshi dodho?» deb bir-birlaridan so‘rashdilar.
en: Those amins and ellikboshis who had found out about mingboshi’s arrival by other means were in shock: “Why didn’t he call us?” they asked one another.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ellikboshilardan biri yugurganicha borib domla-imomga xabar berdi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domla-imom yaqindagina uylangan yoshroq bir mullavachcha bo‘lganligidan «Mingboshi chaqirayotir», degach, ancha tashvishga tushdi.
en: Because the imam had not long ago been but an unmarried student, when he heard that the mingboshi was summoning him, he began to panic.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Salla-choponini kiyib, machitga tomon borarkan, o‘yladi: «Nima uchun yo‘qlatgan bo‘lsa?» Mingboshining uni izlatishga zohiriy bir sabab yo‘q edi. Shuning uchun turli xayollarga borib ko‘rdi: «Tunov kun, shaharga tushganimda, mudarris domlaning o‘g‘illariga qattiqroq tegishib qo‘yuvdim...
en: He put on his turban and robe and headed for the mosque, thinking, “Why in the world would he come here?” There was no obvious reason why mingboshi should be looking for him, so the imam naturally found himself engrossed in his imagination.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zi ham, bachchag‘ar, ipak sallani chambarak qilib o‘rab, yomon ko‘zga ilashadigan bo‘pti-da!
en: “The day before last when I went to the city, I had a little fun with the madrasa director’s son.

uz: Ustimdan arz qilgan bo‘l-sa-ya, haromibachcha?» «Yo... burungi imomat qilgan joyimda vahiy16 yerni Sadriddin boy bilan chiqishib, ikki-uch yil o‘zim yolg‘iz tasarruf qilib edim.
en: … But he brought it on himself: he put on a silk turban to attract my eyes. That little bitch couldn’t have complained about me, could he?” “Or maybe this is because I spent the income from those waqf lands on myself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mahalladan bitta-yarimtasi shuni qo‘zg‘adimikin». «Yo bo‘lmasa, o‘tgan hafta qovun sayilida yangicha maktab ochgan toshkentlik no‘g‘oy domlaga yo‘liqib qolib, ancha qattiq so‘kib edim.
en: Did someone raise a fuss about that?” “Or maybe because last week, when picking melons, I came across one of those Tatar teachers of a new-method school and cursed him.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu bizning mingboshiga Abdisamat mingboshi itob qilib yozdimikin?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Keyin maktabning asl sohibi Abdisamat mingboshi ekanini 16 V a h i y – vaqf.
en: But wait, later when I found out that the school belonged to Abdusamat, I went back and made up with the Tatar teacher.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: bilib, haligi no‘g‘oy domla bilan murosaga ham bordimku-ya...
en: It’s too bad I didn’t know from the start … oh well!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har qalay, boshda ahvoldan bexabar, qattiq gapirib qo‘yib edim...
en: It must be all that ellikboshi Abdurahmon’s fault, son of a bitch!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Attang!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Noinsof! Bo‘lmasa, jimgina o‘tirib edim.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: But I did go apologize to the teacher, I made up with the damn jadid, though.

uz: Albatta, dedim, no‘g‘oy ham — musulmon, ahli sunnat, toshkentlik ham — musulmon, ahli sunnat...
en: I told him, ‘Of course, Tatars are Muslims, Sunnis, Tashkenters are Muslims, Sunnis.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hammamiz bir odam.

uz: Dunyoviy ilmlarni o‘qish ham shariatimizda bor, chunonchi, janobi hasti payg‘ambarimiz «utlubu-dilmu valavkana bissi», ya’ni «Chin mulkida, ya’ni Xitoyda bo‘lsa ham ilm talabida bo‘lg‘il», deganlar.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Bu «hadisi sahih», dedim. Jadid domla xursand bo‘lib ketdi: «Shunday haqiqiy ulamolar bo‘lsa, millat taraqqiy qiladi», dedi.
en: The natural sciences are permitted by Sharia too, and our prophet said that even in China their science is valuable.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu «Millat» degan so‘z tufaylidan yana jindik munozara qilib olishdik.
en: A very apt hadith!’ The jadid teacher was glad.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Abdurahmon ponsod nog‘oy domladan «Millatingiz nima?» deb so‘rab qoldi, no‘g‘oy domla avval «Islom millati», dedi, undan keyin negadir «Islom va turk millati», deb «turk» degan toifani ham qo‘shib qo‘ydi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Men chidayolmadim: «Yo‘q, dedim, musulmon odamdan «millating nima?» deb so‘ralsa, «Millatim Ibrohim Halillullo» deb javob berishi vojib.
en: He said, ‘If all of our ʿulama were like you, the nation would make great progress.’ It was that ‘nation’ word that set us off again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Dinimiz — islom, millatimiz — millati Ibrohim Halillullo.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Turk» degan toifa O‘zgan taraflarida bor, o‘zlari elatiyadan, bizning sartiyadek kasirul-adad17 emas, uning millatga hech bir dahli yo‘q!» dedim.
en: At first, he said Islam, then he said Islamic and Turkic, adding Turkic for some reason. I couldn’t stand it anymore.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Undan keyin hasti Ibrohim Halillullo to‘g‘risida xasti So‘fi Olloyordan dalil keltirdim: Halillullo uchun yondirdilar nor, Qadam qo‘ymay o‘shal o‘t bo‘ldi gulzor.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Jadid domla turib «Ibrohim payg‘ambar — yahudiylar payg‘ambari, hatto to‘rt kitobdan biriga ham ega bo‘lgan emas», dedi. «Tavba, de, eshak!» deb baqirdim.
en: ‘No,’ I told him, ‘if you ask a Muslim what his nation is, it is incumbent upon him to say the nation of Ibrahim.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ortiqcha qizib ketibman. Keyin pushaymon bo‘ldim ku-ya...
en: Over in O’zgan there is a people called Turks, they are from Eilat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: There aren’t as many of them as sarts, and you certainly couldn’t call them a nation!’ Then, to support my point about the prophet Ibrahim, I cited from Sufi Olloyor: They built a great fire to burn Ibrahim, But before he could step in, the fire turned to green pastures.’ “The jadid teacher responded that ‘Ibrahim was the prophet of the Jews and didn’t have even one of the four books.’ ‘Repent, you ass!’ I screamed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi foydasi yo‘q. Afsus!
en: I became heated.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Afsus!» Imom domla kelgandan so‘ng, ko‘p o‘tmasdan, mingboshi machitdan chiqdi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Otiga otlanib turib, ellikboshi bilan bir-ikki og‘iz gaplashdi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Oh, woe is me!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Guzarda o‘tirgan besh-olti kishi hayron bo‘lishib, bir-birlariga qarashdilar.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimaga aminni chaqirtirmasdan, imom domlani chaqirtiradi?

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimaga imom domla kelar-kelmas, jo‘nab qoladi? — Nimaga bu safar yigiti ko‘p?
en: The people in the market were astounded and looked at one another.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimaga qishlog‘iga qaytib ketmasdan, daryo tomonga o‘tdi? — Nimaga guzarda o‘tirganlarga hech narsa demay o‘tdi?
en: “What was he doing here if he could come and leave so quickly?” they asked each other in vain.

en: “Why did he have them bring the imam instead of the amin?” “Why did he leave as soon as the imam came?” “Why does he have so many men with him for the journey?” “Why did he go towards the river and not back to the village?” “Why did he pass us and not say anything?”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimaga?
en: “Why?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nimaga?..

uz: Nimaga?.. Duv-duv gap ketdi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Machit tomonda imom ko‘rindi. Uning yuziga tikildilar.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “Let’s get you a cup.” “I’d be happy to!” said the imam, stopping.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Boshinglar qichimaganda, tilinglar qichib turmasa bo‘lmaydi-da, a? Guzardan kulgi ko‘tarildi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qichig‘ini bosib o‘ting, deymiz-da, domla! — dedi kal Hasan.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yana kuldilar.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Guzar odamlari uning gapiga ishonib yetmadilar, Hasan kal dedi:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bizdek fuqaro yolg‘on aytganda, ishonmagan odam bir-ikki marta zo‘raki yo‘talib qo‘ysin. Amaldor bilan domla-imom yo obro‘yi katta

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: boylar yolg‘on aytsa, ishonmagan odam kavishini qo‘lga olib tursin: «O‘g‘ri ketdi» bo‘lmay iloji yo‘q! Yana kuldilar.
en: But when an official or an imam lies, we should all pick up our shoes and walk home barefoot.” The crowd laughed again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Narida ko‘prik boshida domlaga Umaraliboy duch keldi. — Ha, domla, Akbarali nima dedi?
en: The imam went around them, but ran into Umarali the rich at the head of the bridge.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Mingboshi dodho hech narsa deganlari yo‘q. «Jamoatning namozga yurishi qalay?» deb so‘radi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Ma’nisi yo‘q», dedim. «Ellikboshiga aytaman, ko‘proq haydab beradi».

uz: Shu xolos. Umarali qahqaha solib kuldi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Umrida bir marta peshonasi sajda ko‘rganmikin, so‘ramadingizmi? — Katta odam.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Men nima deyolaman. — Xayr, domla!

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “Did you ask him if he had ever once put his forehead to a prayer rug?” “He’s an important person.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi boy. Yo‘lga tushdi.
en: What could I say to him?”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Keyin orqasiga qayrilib kuldi va dedi: — Zamonaning oxir bo‘lgani shu-da, taqsir.
en: “Good bye, imam!” said Umarali and went on his way.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Benamoz rais bo‘lib, namozdan qolganni tergaydi! Uch kundan keyin juma namoziga juda ko‘p odam yig‘ildi.
en: Then he turned back, laughed and added, “This really is the end of days, sir.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Umuman, machit bilan hech bir aloqasi bo‘lmagan kishilar ham qoq yerga belbog‘larini yozib, faqat peshonalariga yarasha joyni to‘shadilar, imomdan burun bosh ko‘tardilar, imom «ollohu-akbar» deb sajdaga egilganda, bular qiyomga ko‘tarildilar...
en: An impious leader demanding piety of the rest of us!” Three days later on Friday, a massive crowd gathered for the prayer. Even those who had never attended before found places for their foreheads to touch the rugs.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Saflarda pix-pix kulishlar ketdi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Salom berilar-berilmas, yo‘talga zo‘r berib o‘rinlaridan turgan «namozxonlar»ni so‘fining, yog‘lanmagan aravaniki singari, ingichka va g‘ashga tegadigan ovozi to‘xtatdi:
en: They bowed and lifted their heads too early, before the imam. As the imam said, “God is great” and bent in prayer, they sat up.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xaloyiq! Yaqin-yaqin kelib, imom domlaning va’ziga quloq solinglar!
en: Subdued laughter and whispering began.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xalq orasida o‘tirgan amin va ellikboshilar ham ularning belgilab qo‘yilgan kishilar so‘fining so‘zla-rini ilib oldilar:
en: Impatient coughing sounded out among the “faithful” who were ready to leave, when the thin voice of an angry Sufi rose, sounding like the creak of unoiled wheels.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, jamoat!
en: “People!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domlaning so‘zlarini eshitish zarur! Yuqorida ayvonning ichkarisida o‘tirgan domla saf oralab tashqariga chiqdi.
en: Come closer and hear the imam’s sermon!” The amins and ellikboshis seated among the people knew they had to support the Sufi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Panjara eshik oldida to‘xtab, gap boshladi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi o‘sha kungi kelishida, shahardan berilgan ta’limotga muvofiq, hamma machitlarda to‘xtalgan, jumadan so‘ng odamlarga va’z aytib, «ularni tinch ti-riklik bilan shug‘ullanishga va har xil fitnafasodlarga  berilmaslikka» chaqirish vazifasini machit imomlari zimmasiga yuklab ketgan edi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bizning dom-la, so‘z topolmasdan tutilibroq va qiynalibroq boshlasa-da, keyincha jo‘nashib ketdi, qavmining hammasi
en: You must listen to the imam!” The imam stepped outside the mosque, stopping by the grated door, and began to speak to the large crowd.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: deyarlik savodsiz qishloq odamlaridan iborat bo‘lganiga qaramasdan, «balog‘ati arab va fasovati fors»ni mumkin qadar ko‘p ishlatdi, eshon So‘figa juda muxlis bo‘lganligidan uning ma’nilik baytlaridan anchasini har yer-har yerga kistirib o‘tdi.
en: Several days earlier mingboshi had gone around to all the mosques and told the imams there that they should emphasize the need to maintain peace and not listen to the evil temptations that lead to discord and eventually to hell.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir qancha vaqt zo‘r berib, shahardagi hokim to‘ralarni, o‘zimizning «Mulla Akbarali dodho»ni, shular qatorida
en: The imam started with considerable difficulty, unable to find the right words, but he eventually came into his own.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — garchi boshqa mahkumning ulug‘i bo‘lsa-da — «farosatlik, hushyor, donishmand, saxiy va muruvvatmand» hukumatdorlardan mulla Abdisamat mingboshini maqtab o‘tdi.
en: Though his audience was largely illiterate, he made sure to season his speech with the perfection of Arabic and the elegance of Persian.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «No‘g‘oy domla eshitsin», deb yangi zamon maktablaridan, unda Qur’onning tajvid bilan maxrajiga to‘g‘rilab o‘qitilishidan, u maktabda o‘qigan bolalarning «Shariatu imon»ni kattalardan yaxshiroq bilganlaridan, ozod bo‘lishiga yaqin Misr ohangida salovat o‘qiganlaridan, uni eshitgan odam yig‘lamay o‘tolmaganidan, hatto... hatto garchi u maktabning domlasi bolalarga «Yer mudavvar, ya’ni bamisoli soqqa yoki yong‘oq va yoki tarvuz — dumaloq», degan bo‘lsa ham, bu da’voning shariati Mustafoga uncha xilof kelmaganidan, ya’ni, eshon So‘fi Olloyor, Amir Navoiy, Mavlono Fuzuliy, eshoni Haziniy ab’yotlarida falakning gardishi, ya’ni aylanishi xususida ko‘p so‘zlaganidan gapirdi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bosh qizib, gap qozoni qaynagandan so‘ng domlamiz aljiy boshladilar.
en: And he added his favorite lines from his eshon wherever he could.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: In the process, he praised the governor and mayors, the great learned mullah Akbarali mingboshi , and the equally erudite Abdusamat mingboshi: “These perspicacious, conscientious, wise, generous, and munificent men.” “Just let that jadid teacher hear me now,” he thought as he began to praise new-method schools, where they learn the Qur’an alongside the natural sciences, where young students know the teachings of the faith better than adults, where students sing from the Qur’an so well that a passerby cannot but break down and cry, where even … even the teacher can say to his pupils that the world is round like a walnut or a watermelon and his teaching is not against the Sharia of the Prophet because great thinkers like Sufi Olloyor, Emir Navoiy, Mavlono Fuzuli, and Eshon Hazaniy all spoke of the revolutions of the heavens. Just as a pot boils over a fire, so the imam became heated and began to bubble over, words flowing out of his mouth one
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Gaplar poyma-poy kela boshladi.
en: after another in a meaningless babble.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Undan keyin qavmning namozga kam yurganiga, boylarning zakot va sadaqa xususida shariat amridan chetlashganlariga, qishloq odamlari orasida «xamr», ya’ni aroq ichadiganlarning qo‘payganiga o‘tdi...
en: He started to talk about how the people weren’t going to Friday prayers, how the rich weren’t giving alms, how people in the village had given themselves over to vodka.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hech kimni qoldirmay, so‘ka boshladi. Endi bu ruhoniy gramofonni to‘xtatish qiyin edi.
en: Now it would be tough to stop this spiritual gramophone.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domla koyisa yonidagisi, albatta, xursand bo‘lardi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domlaning o‘tkir tillaridan faqat ellikboshilar bilan aminlargina qutulib qoldilar.
en: Only the ellikboshis and amins remained safe from his tongue.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domla so‘zni tamom qilgandan keyin odamlar yana o‘rinlaridan tura boshlagan edilarki, ayvonning ichidan Umaraliboyning xirqiroq ovozi ko‘tarildi.
en: When the imam had finally finished and people got up to leave, the raspy voice of Umarali rang out from the porch of the mosque.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Domla yaxshi aytdilar!

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Balli domlaga! — dedi boy.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Benamozlarning kasofatidan hammayoq qimmatchilik bo‘lib ketayotir! — Xotinbozning kasofatidan-chi, xotinbozning?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi birov pastdan. — Boybuva o‘z qilmishlaridan ham gapirsin jindak!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Eshitaylik! — dedi yana birov.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Imom domlaning qo‘llariga darra olib beramiz endi, benamozlarning jazosini beradi! — dedi ichkaridan tashqariga chiqayotgan Yodgorxo‘ja.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sudxo‘rdan! — dedi pastdagilardan biri.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Pul meniki!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kimga qanday shart bilan bersam — ixtiyor o‘zimda! Senga nima, o‘g‘ri?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi Yodgorxo‘ja.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘zing o‘g‘ri, hammani o‘g‘ri deb bilasan! — Nima, nima?
en: What’s it to you, thief?” spat Yodgor.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “Oh, now the thief is calling others thieves!” “What, what?” “Shut up already!” “You know, sir,” interjected Umarali, “everything is the fault of these officials .
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hovliqma! — Bilasizmi, taqsir, — dedi Umaraliboy, — hamma balo amaldorlarimizning yomonligida.
en: That Akbarali, he’s never once prayed, his wives are all promiscuous, he’s an amoral drunk!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Mingboshimiz Akabarali bo‘lsa, peshonasini bir umr sajda ko‘rgan bo‘lmasa, xotinlari buzuq bo‘lsa, o‘zi piyanista, buzuq odam bo‘lsa! Boshqalardan koyib bo‘ladimi?
en: Why are we cursing others?” “Hey, Umarali, don’t say that,” said the imam, “don’t slander our great Akbarali.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hay, Umaraliboy, unday demang! — dedi imom.
en: The people know no misery thanks to him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Mulla Akbarali dodhoga til tegizmang.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U kishidan fuqaro hech qanday bir yomonlik ko‘rgan emas. Uncha-muncha chakki yurishlari bo‘lsa, amaldor ham podshoday gap, podsholarga buyuradi o‘zi...
en: And if he has his fun now and then … well, that’s what’s allowed for rulers.” “I have nothing against Abdusamat,” added Umarali.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Men mulla Abdisamatga hech narsa demayman, — dedi Umaraliboy.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Mulla Abdisamat bo‘lsa hamma jon deydi!
en: “There’s no official like Abdusamat!” continued Umarali.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi Yodgorxo‘ja.
en: “But is Akbarali even a man?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Mulla Abdisamatdek amaldor yo‘q!

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb davom etdi Umaraliboy. — Akbarali odammi?
en: If I were him, I would close all these ­indecent
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sipomi? Amaldormi?
en: divan tradition.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning o‘rnida men bo‘lsam, guzardagi samovarlarni taqa-taq berkitdirardim. Hamma benamoz shu yerga yig‘iladi.
en: He resided in present-day Iraq and served in the courts of both the Safavids and Ottomans.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Namoz o‘qimaganni yozda darralatardim, qishda — muz teshib, suvga pishardim.
en: Eshon Hazaniy is most likely a fictional character, the imam’s Sufi master.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Shuning uchun xudo senga amal bermaydi-da! — dedi birov pastdan.

en: The two co-wives comfort me day and night. They’re so polite and always soothing, always telling me, ‘Don’t do this, my dear!’ Sultonxon, who tried to keep mingboshi away from me with all her might, is now repeating the other two’s words in my ear every night.

en: To’xtasin, hiding his pistol under his shirt, cursed the two guards vehemently , but the three ultimately left as quickly as they had come. They went down the narrow street on the left side of the mosque straight to Mamaturdi’s house.

uz: U yerda Mamaturdi bo‘lmaganidan «biror joyda berkinib yotgandir», deb uyning har tomonini qidira boshlaydilar.

uz: Xotin bechora boyvachchaning qo‘lida oppoq to‘pponchani ko‘rgandan keyin qo‘rqib, ko‘chaga chiqib ketadi va ovozining boricha baqirib «dod» demoqqa boshlaydi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “If I ask that rascal Hakimjon, what kind of ideas will he get?” The Qumariq matter had really thrown him between two fires: on the one side were the people who were clearly in the right, but on the other were the two landowners, who had money and esteem.

uz: Attang, attang...» Nima qilishini bilmasdan ichkariga kirib, tashqariga chiqib, hovliga o‘tib, ko‘chada aylanib, kech kirguncha xayol surib yurdi.

en: In the front row the governor, noyib to’ra, the garrison commander, the head of police, and the priest were seated. In the third row on the far side was an old Muslim in a snow-white, tall turban; he was the mosque’s thin-voiced imam.
