license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir tomonda — zakunchi, bir tomonda — tilmoch; boshqa hech kim yo‘q.
en: On one side of the court was the lawyer; and on the other, the translator. No one else was permitted in.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi ikki konvoyning yalang‘och qilichi o‘rtasida zalga kirib keldi; ustida qora barqut paranji, qora chimmat, oyog‘ida qora amirkon mahsikavish  bilan sud qarshisiga kelib to‘xtadi.
en: Zebi came into the courtroom in between her two escorts with their unsheathed swords. She went to the front of the court, covered from head to toe in a velvet paranji, black face veil, and black leather boots without galoshes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu omonsiz suddan va bu yaltiragan yalang‘och qilichlardan ko‘ra uning o‘sha qora qiyofasi qo‘rqinch edi: o‘rta asrlardagi Ispaniya inkvizitsiya mahkamalarining qora aboli va sirli kardinallariga o‘xshardi...
en: Her dark countenance was far more terrifying than the glinting swords or the court’s imminent judgment. She looked like one of those black-clad cardinals of the Spanish Inquisition.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Pop qaradi, boshini chayqadi; domla qaradi, «astafg‘urullo» o‘qib, soqolini silkitdi.
en: The priest looked at her and shook his head. The imam looked and stroked his beard as he said “Allah forbid” in Arabic.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sud raisi, nihoyat, tilmochga yuzlandi:
en: The judge addressed the translator.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Aytingiz, aybdor yuzini ochsin. Tilmoch bu buyruqni Zebiga tushuntirib berdi.
en: “Tell the accused to uncover her face.” The translator explained the demand to Zebi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Voy, o‘la qolay!
en: “Oh, no! God take me!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuncha nomahramning oldida yuzimni ochamanmi?
en: I have to show my face to all these nomahram people?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Undan ko‘ra o‘lganim yaxshi emasmi? Bu so‘z tarjima qilib berilgach, pastdagilarning hammasi deyarlik, sud hay’atidan bir necha kishi yengilgina kulib oldilar.
en: It would be better to die!” When the translator relayed her words, those seated below, almost to a man, and even a few of the court delegation cracked smiles.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ulardan ikki kishi ayrildi: birinchisi — nihoyatda semiz va yo‘g‘on gavdali garnizon boshlig‘i; bu odam, tovuqning qaqag‘lashiga yaqin bir tovush bilan ovozi boricha va birdaniga qahqah soldi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hamma unga tomon o‘girildi. Sud raisi chinqiroq chaldi.
en: The fat-torsoed garrison commander surpassed them, crowing like a rooster.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Garnizon boshlig‘i yonidagi ro‘molchasini olib, yuzko ‘zlarini arta boshladi...
en: Everyone turned to him. He quickly shut his mouth and started to wipe his face with a handkerchief .
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkinchisi — imom dom-la; bu kishi o‘zlarining ingichka — hushtak singari ovozlari bilan, ixtiyorsiz «masha-ollo!..» deb yubordilar. Hamma u kishiga tomon evrilgach, qip-qizarib va ham...
en: Then the imam, in his thin, whistle-like voice, involuntarily let out a “Allah has willed it.” And when everyone turned to him, he blushed bright red and lowered his head in embarrassment.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: qo‘rqib boshlarini quyi soldilar. — Siz bu ayolga tushuntirib aytingiz; yuzini ochmasa bo‘lmaydi.
en: “Explain to the woman that it is unacceptable to give testimony with a covered face.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sudning qoidasi shu.
en: This is the rule of the court.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Paranji ostida aybdordan boshqa kishining hozir bo‘lishiga yo‘l qo‘y-maslik uchun biz uning yuzini ochtirishga majburmiz.
en: We are obliged to compel her to uncover her face in order to ensure that another person has not taken her place.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aytingiz, qarshilikdan foyda yo‘q! Zebi xuddi o‘yinda sherigiga achchiq qilgan boladay teskari burilib oldi.
en: Tell her there is no point in resisting!” Like a child upset with her playmate’s cheating in a game, Zebi turned away from the court.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U indamay turganligidan sud raisi yana so‘z oldi: — Yaxshilab tushuntiringiz, yuzini ochmasa, sud majlisini olib borolmayman.
en: “Explain,” the judge started again, “that I cannot begin the trial unless she uncovers her face.” “Fine, then, don’t begin,” said Zebi to the translator.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Olib bormasa mayliga...
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi Zebi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bilganini qilsin! Tilmoch o‘zi kulib, qip-qizarib turib, tarjima qildi: Sud raisi ovozini ko‘tara tushdi:
en: “Let him do what he knows best!” The translator laughed, then turned red from his breach of decorum.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Harbiy sud masxarami bu kishiga?
en: He translated what she said.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aytingiz, yaxshilik bilan ochsinlar.
en: The judge raised his voice.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bo‘lmasa kuch bilan ochtiramiz! — Voy, sho‘rim!
en: “Is she mocking the court?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuncha erkak o‘tirsa-ya! O‘lganim ming marta yaxshiroq!
en: Tell her to remove the veil voluntarily or it will be done forcibly!” “Oh, dear God!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra ovozini pasaytiribroq tirkadi: — Otamning piriday kap-katta sallalik domla o‘tiribdilar.
en: With all these men seated here?!” she protested, “It would be a thousand times better to die!” Then she lowered her voice.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qanday yuzim bilan qarayman?.. Sud raisi endi bu safar muloyim gapirdi:
en: “There is a respected man of faith here like my father’s eshon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Aytingiz, sud tomonga qarab, domlaga orqasini o‘girib tursin! Zebi yana indamadi.
en: How can I look at him with a bare face?” The judge responded calmly this time.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domla o‘tirgan joyidan bir oz ko‘tarila tushib: — Hechqisi yo‘q, qizim!
en: “Tell her: ‘Address the court and turn your back to the imam.’” Zebi again didn’t speak.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi. — Men qaramayman!
en: The imam stood up.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Mana bular-chi? — dedi Zebi.
en: “There is nothing to fear, my child!” he said, “I will not look!” “What about the others?” asked Zebi, indicating the members of the court.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sud hay’atini ko‘rsatdi. Endi bu safar domla o‘rnidan turib tilmochga yuzlandi:
en: The imam moved closer to the front of the court and addressed himself to the translator.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Eshoni mirzo!
en: “Honored sir!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Menga ijozat berilsa, shu ayolga ikki og‘iz nasihat qilsam. — Marhamat, taqsir!
en: If you’ll allow it, I have some advice for the woman.” “Please!” The imam went to Zebi’s side and began to whisper to her.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domla Zebining yoniga borib, nasihatga boshladi.
en: Zebi, though her resolve had weakened, argued with him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi, borgan sari susayib bo‘lsa-da, domlaning har bir so‘ziga javob qaytarardi. Oxirda, domla o‘z din-doshlari o‘rtasida mashhur bo‘lgan bir e’tiqod masalasini ochdi:
en: The imam soon turned to a disputed matter of the faith, but as the words began to emerge from his mouth, he immediately regretted them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Kofir bilan itning farqi yo‘q.
en: He stopped mid-sentence and tried other arguments.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Itdan qochmaysizmi? Shunday bo‘lsa, kofirdan ham qochmasangiz bo‘ladi.
en: When those didn’t work, so as not to test the court’s patience, he was forced to return to that disputed matter.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu joiz?
en: Forced!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domla shunday joyda bu xil gaplarni gapirishdan juda qo‘rqadi.
en: For that reason, he spoke quietly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuning uchun boshda boshqa so‘zlar bilan Zebiga ta’sir qilishga urindi.
en: “There is no difference between an infidel and a dog.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U urinishlardan tezroq bir natija chiqmagandan keyin majlis ahlini mahtal qilib qo‘ymaslik uchun bu masalani ochishga majbur bo‘ldi.
en: Would you cover your face in front of a dog? You wouldn’t, so you wouldn’t cover in front of an infidel either.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Majbur!.. Shu uchun so‘ngi so‘zlarni juda past ovoz bilan aytgan edi.
en: It’s permitted to uncover in front of them.”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi unadi:
en: Zebi was convinced.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bo‘lmasa, siz o‘zingiz nariroqqa borib o‘tiring! — Xo‘p, qizim, xo‘p, — dedi domla.
en: “So you’ll sit far away?” “Yes, my daughter, yes,” he said.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘rt-besh qator orqaga borib o‘tirdi.
en: He went back five rows and sat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hammaning ko‘zi domlada ekan, Zebi chimmatini yuzidan oldi va sudga tomon evrilgan holda bir qo‘lini yana yuziga parda qildi. — Mana, qila qol so‘rog‘ingni!
en: While everyone’s eyes followed the imam, Zebi removed the veil and turned towards the judge, shielding her face with one hand.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hozir bo‘lganlar o‘rtasida «bu sodda musulmon qizi-ni uyaltirmaslik uchun» ko‘zini boshqa tomonga burib o‘tirganlar bilan birga ikki ko‘zini undan uzmagan va allanimalar deb o‘zicha so‘zlanib, lablarini tez-tez qimirlatganlar ham bor edi...
en: “Now, on with the questioning!” Some in the court averted their eyes to not embarrass “this simple Muslim girl,” while others kept their eyes trained on her, following the quick movements of her lips.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aybdorning kimligi surishtirilgach, sud darhol o‘rnidan turib, aybnomani o‘qidi.
en: Once they established the accused’s identity, the court secretary stood up and read the indictment.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Undan keyin yana kalta savol-javoblar ketdi.
en: Then began a trading of short questions and answers.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu daf’a ularning adadi orta tushdi: — Aybnomani eshitdingizmi?
en: The number of questions and answers this time increased quite a bit.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “Did you hear the indictment?” “Yes.” “Did mingboshi ask for the water?” “Yes, he asked for it.” “Was he drunk?” “He had drunk a lot of vodka.” “Who gave him the water?” “I did.” “The water in the teapot?” “Yes.” “This teapot?” “Yes.” “Whose teapot was it?” “Mine.” “Yours?” “Yes, mine.” “Did you know what kind of water was inside?” “I knew.” “What kind of water?” “Holy water.” “For whom was the water blessed?” “For me.” “Why did they bless the water for you?” The 1988 publication’s imam says the following: “These men are infidels.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha... — Mingboshi suvni o‘zi so‘radimi?
en: There is no need to hide your face from them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, o‘zi so‘radi... — Mastmidi?
en: It is permitted to uncover in front of them!”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ko‘p aroq ichib edi. — Suvni kim berdi?
en: “So that I would get pregnant.” Everyone other than the imam laughed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: “Why did you give this water to mingboshi?” “He was very thirsty and it was close by on the shelf.” “Did you know that there was poison in the teapot?” Zebi laughed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Men berdim. — Choynaqdamidi?
en: “You’re a strange one.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: (Zebi addressed the Russian informally; you cannot address a Russian with respect). How would I have known?” “So you killed your husband?” Zebi answered seriously, elongating her words for emphasis.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha... — Mana bu choynakmi?
en: “Noooo!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha... — Kimning choynagi bu?
en: I would die if I killed him.” In that last answer was the innocent sincerity of any girl speaking to a mahram friend.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Meniki. — Siznikimi?
en: The tone of “God take me!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, meniki. — Ichida qanday suv borligini bilarmidingiz?
en: How could you say such a thing?” But how could Zebi know that the judge was not a child?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bilardim. — Qanaqa suvidi?
en: How could she know that these men would never understand something that was as clear as the moon?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Irim suvidi. — Kimga qilingan irim.
en: “There are Muslims along with Russians here; they all know that I couldn’t have killed mingboshi,” thought Zebi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Menga... — Nima uchun irim qildirardingiz?
en: “They already know and yet it’s strange that they keep asking.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Farzand bo‘lsin, deb... Pastda o‘tirganlarning domladan boshqalari, so‘ngra sud hay’atidan bir-ikki kishi, zakunchi va tilmoch yengilgina kulib qo‘ydilar.
en: Or are they playing the fool?” When the judge stood up to speak, Zebi thought, “Well, the questioning must be over.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nega u suvni mingboshiga berdingiz? — Juda tashna bo‘lib so‘ragan edi, shundoqqina tokchadan olib uzatdim.
en: I guess now I’ll have to find my way home when they release me.” “Sit,” the judge told Zebi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Choynakda zahar borligini bilarmidingiz?
en: She slowly and carefully sat down.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi kuldi.
en: The judge began speaking.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qiziq ekansan (o‘rusni sizlab bo‘lmaydi), men qaerdan bilay? — Demak, eringizni o‘zingiz o‘ldirdingiz?
en: “The case is so clear that, in my opinion, there is no need to continue the trial.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi qattiqroq va cho‘zibroq javob berdi: — Yo‘-o‘-q!..
en: The accused has herself admitted to the crime with her very answers.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘libmanmi o‘z erimni o‘ldirib. Uning bu so‘nggi javobidan qiz bolaning o‘z o‘rtog‘iga o‘zini oqlab gapiradigan sodda gaplaridagi gunohsiz ohang boridi: Voy, o‘la qoling, men shunaqa dermidim?» Zebi sud raisining bola emasligini qanday bilsin?
en: After closing statements, we will adjourn to deliberate the sentence.” The questions and answers to Zebi were repeated and the examination record was read aloud in translation.

uz: Domlaning bu savolida xuddi gunoh qilgan odamning ochiq bezovtaligi sezilardi: «Meni qamamasmikin?» deganday...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: As if he had asked, “They won’t lock me up?” The translator probably sensed this and answered coldly.

uz: Tilmoch muni payqadi, shekilli, quruq va sovuq javob berdi: — Bora bering.

en: The translator shook his head and said quietly in Russian: “What a mess, what a mess!” After the Friday prayer, the impatient faithful inside all stood up at once and began to leave.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bezobrazie, bezobrazie!20 — deb so‘zlandi.

en: He sustained only the minimum of interaction required by his position, saying nothing other than greetings during the time he was outside of his home, like a new bride. He cleared his throat a few times and in his thin, raspy voice said enough to fulfill his official obligation to the court.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Hakimjon grabbed the gate out of shock and used it to stabilize himself: “Was this the same man talking as before or someone else?” he thought as he stared at Razzoq-sufi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat ne choraki, u kishi berib o‘rganmaganlar, olib o‘rganganlar; «O‘rgangan ko‘ngul o‘rtansa qo‘ymas», deydi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: If a beggar came to the lodge, the eshon would look at his empty hand and ask, ‘what happened to your offering?’ “I have to tell the girl’s poor mother what happened!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Humming a cheerful melody, the eshon began swaying his head to and fro. He opened his mouth to sing: This ephemeral world is ours for five days, only five days, ho-ov, Break your Sufi oath, break it quickly now, ho-ov!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qo‘llari ixtiyorsiz balandga ko‘tarildi, mushtlari o‘z-o‘zicha tugumlandi...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: And that fist was so powerful that Razzoq-sufi only had time to think: “Oh, if only yesterday I had …” By the time he went out on the street, having left his tea untouched, Razzoq -sufi no longer recognized himself.
